## 1. Required outcome and what the refactor did not justify

The resource/schema refactor did not require losing incremental mutation
processing, local environment lookups, background Library work, parse reuse or
responsive playback. Those avoidable regressions must be recovered. Some new
capabilities necessarily add work; some later ownership changes repair actual
correctness defects. That does not justify repeated global work or unbounded
publication. Recovery must preserve the useful integrations while restoring
the old computational limits and observable behavior.

The order below overrides older prose that put new R1/R2 assignments before
R6. The original migration remains the design authority for current public
schema16 state, resource authoring, the shared renderer and honest coverage.
Its older small-cohort testing sequence does not override the human's later
instruction to work in big batches and validate those batches afterward.

Required outcomes:

1. Restore the implemented Opus algorithms verbatim wherever their public
   inputs still match. Adapt only the records, identities, values and ownership
   that actually changed. Reuse original helpers and tests rather than
   inventing another renderer, scheduler, cache framework or admission service.
2. Preserve every current required source assignment, actual owner/occurrence,
   condition/item/grant/spatial lifecycle, private capture and native clock.
3. Integrate ready pending patches after checking their actual remaining hunks;
   do not reapply already integrated patches or promote unreviewed proposals.
4. Finish every existing R1–R8 obligation and account for the whole actual
   queue, including duties outside the stopped run. Keep external art/data and
   human review explicit. No new feature inventory is added by this plan.
5. Establish a current playable checkpoint with recovered responsiveness,
   honest whole-inventory evidence and separate human visual/audio review.

## 3. Restoration rule: three different kinds of work

| Class | How to handle it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| **V — old code can be reused literally** | Copy the complete original block and its dependency closure; retain unrelated current code. Only move an import/name if its current location actually changed. | Library worker/generation and row budget algorithm; parse reuse; preserved source-cache mechanisms. |
| **A — old algorithm, current public data** | Keep the Opus algorithm and complexity. Adapt schema16 actor/item/sensory/removal records and exact current owners. Show original and full adapted code separately. | Incident entity capture, sensory mutation indexing, local residue/source closure, sparse tile order/invalidation. |
| **N — new capability or correctness fix** | There is no old equivalent to paste. Preserve its semantics; remove avoidable repeated work within existing owners. Name unresolved design rather than pretending an unsafe rollback is restoration. | Actual actor histories; current ResourceLoader request ownership; new item memberships; source-owned asynchronous Shader work. |

Already preserved fast paths require no rewrite: staged binary admission,
cue tolerance and candidate reuse; ordinary-frame no future-world copies;
disabled ordinary live source cuts; empty-group preparation reuse; changed-map
media prioritization; actor pose/source reuse; fixed shadow targets and retained
unchanged actors; light-ranking versus flicker; ground CPU buffers; proxy
change-only writes; private source clocks; selected-perspective Studio reading.
Keep these on the preservation checklist and prove they survive the combined
change. Do not make their reimplementation into extra work.

L8 runtime sheet-bundle playback was not active at9b73. Its offline experiment
must not be described as a lost runtime optimization or made a prerequisite for
recovering the real regressions. A later packaging project remains separate.

## 12. Parallel execution and review rules

When implementation is explicitly resumed, use three same-task source lanes:

| Lane | Initial file ownership | Review and handoff |
|---|---|---|
| Core mutation/world | SDK reducer/audience/transitions, compiler/timeline, world/environment metadata/item relevance | Own A1–A3/A7 and tile order/dirty repair. Preserve full current canonical results and existing staged clocks; hand exact interface changes to preparation lane. |
| Preparation/history/renderer | Existing source admission/metadata/selection/body traversal/native inputs/effect withdrawal | Own A8–A12 and external material withdrawal. No independent scheduler/source framework; retain actual owner drain/fences and source-private clocks. |
| Studio/ready patches | Library/catalog/Journal parse reuse, Studio cache/Follow/inspection and assigned harness patches | Own A4–A6 and corresponding B fixes. Coordinate Journal/Protocol interface with core; no whole-file overwrite of shared SDK code. |

Root integrates cross-file changes, keeps recovery first, owns the source/
package checkpoint and final R1–R8/queue accounting. A same-task reviewer tracks
plan adherence throughout implementation. Anti-slop and anti-OOP reviews inspect
the combined source, not just a passing count. Reviewers must flag detours into
tiny test repairs while recovery source work remains executable.

Testing must never monopolize the project. A runner reads a frozen source/package
cut; agents continue disjoint source work or prepare reviewable unapplied
patches/scratch proposals while that reader is active. Publish those changes
between reader processes or into the next frozen cut. Do not mutate files being
qualified, launch overlapping Godot/GPU consumers or rebuild shared outputs
under readers. Use existing runner ownership/cancellation tools; no new queue
framework. A validator's unrelated delay is not a reason to idle all source
lanes.

Commit only coherent reviewable explicit paths; preserve raw failed receipts
and actual package/source boundaries. No push/merge, binary art addition,
engine/Factory source writes or other-chat communication is authorized here.

### A.1 — `presentation/ability_documents.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/ability_documents.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## The record tables the presentation build writes from the abilities source
## (build/presentation/abilities/docs/): read in place of the old authoring
## documents they replace, under the same names, so every reader keeps its
## code. A document is reused while its file is unchanged. The setting
## source_data/abilities_build (default ROOT) points a check at another build.
const ROOT := "res://build/presentation/abilities/"
## The old documents the abilities source owns (plus spells/<id>.json).
const DOCUMENTS := [
    "catalog/condition_recipes.json", "catalog/condition_media.json", "catalog/action_playback_rates.json",
    "catalog/body_action_recipes.json", "catalog/body_action_bindings.json", "catalog/shove_recipes.json",
    "catalog/action_deliveries.json", "catalog/attack_recipes.json", "catalog/damage_context.json",
    "catalog/healing_context.json", "catalog/death_context.json", "catalog/death_save_context.json",
    "catalog/life_state_context.json", "catalog/number_style.json", "catalog/badge_style.json",
    "catalog/bolt_style.json", "catalog/dart_style.json", "catalog/movement_context.json",
    "catalog/movement_reaction_context.json", "catalog/forced_movement_context.json",
    "catalog/forced_movement_profile.json", "catalog/equipment_context.json", "catalog/interruptions.json",
    "catalog/body_release_media.json", "catalog/entity_lifecycle_media.json", "catalog/item_attachments.json",
    "catalog/shove_feedback.json", "catalog/relocation_actions.json", "catalog/body_materials.json",
    "catalog/action_materials.json", "catalog/action_intakes.json",
    "native_effects/index.json", "native_effects/responses.json", "sandbox/feedback.json",
    "condition_lifecycles.json", "values.json",
]
static var _documents: Dictionary = {}
static var _mutex := Mutex.new()

static func owns(path: String) -> bool:
    return path in DOCUMENTS or (path.begins_with("spells/") and path.ends_with(".json"))

static func root() -> String:
    return str(ProjectSettings.get_setting("source_data/abilities_build", ROOT))

static func file(path: String) -> String:
    return root().path_join("docs").path_join(path.get_basename() + ".res")

static func exists(path: String) -> bool:
    return FileAccess.file_exists(file(path))

## The document's data (a Dictionary, or an Array for a list document), or
## null when the build has no such document or it is not a record table.
static func read(path: String) -> Variant:
    var source := file(path)
    var exists := FileAccess.file_exists(source)
    var stamp := [FileAccess.get_modified_time(source), FileAccess.get_size(source)] if exists else []
    _mutex.lock();var known: Array = _documents.get(source, []);_mutex.unlock()
    if not known.is_empty() and known[0] == stamp:return known[1]
    var data: Variant = null
    var document: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(source, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) if exists else null
    if document != null and document.get("is_list") != null:data = document.items if document.is_list else document.data
    else:push_error("The abilities build has no record table " + source + " (run tools/build_presentation.gd)")
    _mutex.lock();_documents[source] = [stamp, data];_mutex.unlock()
    return data

static func invalidate() -> void:
    _mutex.lock();_documents = {};_mutex.unlock()
```


### A.2 — `presentation/background_release.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/background_release.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Dropping the last reference to large data (decoded images, a retired view's
## tables) frees megabytes and thousands of Variants; on the main thread it took
## 2-6 ms. These references are dropped on a worker instead. They must not be
## the only owners of Nodes (Nodes are freed explicitly, never by refcount).
static var _tasks: Array[int] = []
static var _joins_at_exit := false

static func release(values: Array) -> void:
    for i in range(_tasks.size() - 1, -1, -1):
        if WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_tasks[i]):
            WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_tasks[i]); _tasks.remove_at(i)
    if values.is_empty(): return
    if not _joins_at_exit:
        # Whatever owner released them, every release finishes before the
        # scene tree, and with it the scripts of what they free, shuts down.
        (Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree).root.tree_exiting.connect(func(): join(), CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
        _joins_at_exit = true
    _tasks.append(WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): values.clear(), false, "Release retired data"))

## A retiring subtree keeps its ordinary teardown: deletion still runs its
## _exit_tree. Once the whole subtree has left the tree, its script nodes'
## containers (and `extra` data it shared, such as a replaced recording index)
## are taken from it. They are dropped on a worker on the next frame, after its
## Nodes, and any viewport textures they own, were freed on the main thread.
static func release_after_exit(root: Node, extra: Array = []) -> void:
    root.tree_exited.connect(func():
        var held := extra
        for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
            if node.get_script() != null: held.append_array(detach_tables(node))
        if root.get_script() != null: held.append_array(detach_tables(root))
        (Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree).process_frame.connect(func(): release(held), CONNECT_ONE_SHOT), CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)

## Waits for every pending release; the owner calls it before it exits.
static func join() -> void:
    for task in _tasks: WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(task)
    _tasks.clear()

## Takes a script node's container members, leaving empty ones of the same type.
static func detach_tables(node: Object) -> Array:
    var held := []
    for property in node.get_property_list():
        if not property.usage & PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE: continue
        var value = node.get(property.name)
        if value is Dictionary and not value.is_empty():
            held.append(value)
            node.set(property.name, Dictionary({}, value.get_typed_key_builtin(), value.get_typed_key_class_name(), value.get_typed_key_script(),
                value.get_typed_value_builtin(), value.get_typed_value_class_name(), value.get_typed_value_script()))
        elif value is Array and not value.is_empty():
            held.append(value)
            node.set(property.name, Array([], value.get_typed_builtin(), value.get_typed_class_name(), value.get_typed_script()))
    return held
```


### A.3 — `presentation/body_sources.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/body_sources.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Native body metadata admission. The presentation build
## (tools/build_presentation.gd) writes the index and its layer and clip
## Resources; a fresh catalog cache explicitly admits that index.
const Index=preload("res://presentation/resources/body_source_index.gd")
const Layer=preload("res://presentation/resources/body_source_layer.gd")
const Clip=preload("res://presentation/resources/body_source_clip.gd")
const INDEX="res://build/presentation/characters/body-sources/index.res"
const KEY="__body_source_admission"
static var _current:Index
static var _current_path:String=""
static var _attempted:bool=false
static var _admission_mutex:Mutex=Mutex.new()

static func invalidate()->void:
    _admission_mutex.lock()
    _current=null;_current_path="";_attempted=false
    _admission_mutex.unlock()

static func _current_index(path:String)->Index:
    _admission_mutex.lock()
    if not _attempted or path!=_current_path:
        _current=ResourceLoader.load(path,"",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE) as Index if FileAccess.file_exists(path) else null
        if _current==null:push_error("No built characters body sources at "+path+": run tools/build_presentation.gd -- --only=characters")
        _current_path=path;_attempted=true
    var result:Index=_current
    _admission_mutex.unlock()
    return result

static func admission(cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    if cache.has(KEY):return cache[KEY]
    var path:String=ProjectSettings.get_setting("source_data/body_source_index",INDEX)
    var index:Index=_current_index(path)
    if index==null:return {}
    var loaded={};loaded.make_read_only()
    var result={"index":index,"loaded":loaded};result.make_read_only()
    cache[KEY]=result
    return result

static func index(cache:Dictionary)->Index:
    return admission(cache).get("index")

static func layer_path(rig:String,category:String,cache:Dictionary)->String:
    var current:Dictionary=admission(cache)
    return "" if current.is_empty() else current.index.layers.get(rig,{}).get(category,"")

static func prepared_layer(path:String,cache:Dictionary)->Layer:
    # Sampling may borrow admitted refs only. Even initial index admission is
    # excluded here: no marker read, ResourceLoader or cache mutation.
    return cache.get(KEY,{}).get("loaded",{}).get(path) as Layer

static func prepare_layer(path:String,cache:Dictionary)->Layer:
    return _load(path,cache,"category") as Layer

static func prepare_clip(layer:Layer,name:String,cache:Dictionary)->Clip:
    return _load(layer.clip_sources.get(name,""),cache,"clip") as Clip

static func layer(rig:String,category:String,cache:Dictionary)->Layer:
    # Explicit preparation compatibility for standalone source fixtures.
    return prepare_layer(layer_path(rig,category,cache),cache)

static func _load(path:String,cache:Dictionary,kind:String)->Resource:
    if path.is_empty():return null
    var current:Dictionary=admission(cache)
    var measured:bool=cache.has("__actor_source_profile")
    if current.loaded.has(path):
        if measured:
            var admission_metrics:Dictionary=cache.__actor_source_profile
            var field:String=kind+"_cache_hits"
            admission_metrics[field]=int(admission_metrics.get(field,0))+1
        return current.loaded[path]
    # Revision-specific paths are immutable. Share this physical metadata owner;
    # no scene, Texture2D or mutable occurrence dependency is present here.
    var started:int=Time.get_ticks_usec() if measured else 0
    var resource=ResourceLoader.load(path,"",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE)
    if measured:
        # Native CACHE_REUSE may return a previously loaded Resource or wait
        # for another loader. This measures that call, not disk-cold I/O.
        var elapsed:int=Time.get_ticks_usec()-started
        var metrics:Dictionary=cache.__actor_source_profile
        var prefix:String=kind+"_resource_load_"
        metrics[prefix+"calls"]=int(metrics.get(prefix+"calls",0))+1
        metrics[prefix+"usec"]=int(metrics.get(prefix+"usec",0))+elapsed
        if not metrics.has(prefix+"paths"):metrics[prefix+"paths"]={}
        var row:Dictionary=metrics[prefix+"paths"].get(path,{"calls":0,"usec":0})
        row.calls+=1;row.usec+=elapsed
        metrics[prefix+"paths"][path]=row
    if resource==null:return null
    var loaded:Dictionary=current.loaded.duplicate();loaded[path]=resource;loaded.make_read_only()
    var next={"index":current.index,"loaded":loaded};next.make_read_only();cache[KEY]=next
    return resource

static func descriptor(path:String,slot:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var current:Dictionary=cache.get(KEY,{})
    if current.is_empty():return {}
    var owner:Array=current.index.source_owners.get(path,[])
    if owner.is_empty():return {}
    var resource:Layer=prepared_layer(owner[0],cache)
    if resource==null:return {}
    var clip:Clip=current.loaded.get(resource.clip_sources.get(owner[1],"")) as Clip
    if clip==null:return {}
    var slots:Dictionary=clip.descriptors
    return slots.get(slot,slots.get("*",{}))

static func prepare_descriptor(path:String,slot:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    # Media/world preparation workers explicitly admit the selected metadata.
    var current:Dictionary=admission(cache)
    if current.is_empty():return {}
    var owner:Array=current.index.source_owners.get(path,[])
    if owner.is_empty():return {}
    var resource:Layer=prepare_layer(owner[0],cache)
    if resource==null or prepare_clip(resource,owner[1],cache)==null:return {}
    return descriptor(path,slot,cache)

static func header(path:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var current:Dictionary=admission(cache)
    if current.is_empty():return {}
    var owner:Array=current.index.source_owners.get(path,[])
    if owner.is_empty():return {}
    var resource:Layer=prepare_layer(owner[0],cache)
    return {} if resource==null else resource.headers.get(path,{})

## Gear looks are keyed by the server item id's family (the item whose looks
## it wears) and the visual variant the server sends.
static func equipment(item:Dictionary,slot:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var selected:Index=index(cache)
    if selected==null:return {"ok":false,"error":{"kind":"authoring","message":"Body source index has not been built"}}
    var gear:Array=selected.gear.get(str(item.get("item_id","")),[])
    var key:Array=["" if gear.is_empty() else gear[0],item.visual_variant_id,slot]
    if selected.equipment.has(key):return {"ok":true,"value":selected.equipment[key]}
    return {"ok":false,"error":{"kind":"authoring","message":selected.equipment_errors.get(key,"No built item visual: "+str([item.get("item_id"),item.visual_variant_id,slot]))}}
```

### A.4 — `presentation/characters.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/characters.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
const CharacterGeometry = preload("res://presentation/character_geometry.gd")
const Catalog = preload("res://source_catalog.gd")
const BodySources=preload("res://presentation/body_sources.gd")
# Passive adapter from canonical player data to the existing authoring owners.
# The caller owns the cache; keep it on the same thread as its reader.
const VISUAL_SLOT = {"MELEE_MAIN":"weapon_melee_main", "MELEE_OFF":"weapon_melee_off",
    "RANGED_MAIN":"weapon_ranged_main", "RANGED_OFF":"weapon_ranged_off",
    "Head":"helmet", "Body":"body_armor", "Hands":"gauntlets", "Feet":"boots",
    "Cloak":"cloak", "Backpack":"backpack"}
const WEAPON_SET = {"MELEE_MAIN":"melee", "MELEE_OFF":"melee", "RANGED_MAIN":"ranged", "RANGED_OFF":"ranged"}
const EFFECT_SLOTS = ["weaponGlow", "aura", "slash", "effect", "effect2", "effect3"]

static func _read(path: String, cache: Dictionary) -> Variant:
    return Catalog.read_file(path, cache)

static func _error(message: String) -> Dictionary:
    return {"ok":false, "error":{"kind":"authoring", "message":message, "retryable":false}}

## The server's creature id inside a ContentRef identity key (pack:creature:id@version).
static func content_id(ref: Variant) -> String:
    var text:String=str(ref)
    return text.get_slice(":",2).get_slice("@",0) if text.count(":")>=2 else text

static func rig_id(actor: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> String:
    var admitted=BodySources.index(cache)
    if admitted==null:return ""
    var creature:Variant=actor.get("creature_content_ref")
    return admitted.root_rig if creature==null else admitted.creature_rigs.get(content_id(creature),"")

static func rigs(cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var admitted=BodySources.index(cache)
    return {} if admitted==null else admitted.rigs

static func resolve(actor: Dictionary, state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not actor.get("present", true) or actor.get("last_visual_position") == null \
        or actor.get("spatial_disposition", "present") != "present" \
        or actor.get("remains_disposition", "intact") == "disintegrated":
        return {"ok":true, "value":null}
    var selected = structure(actor,cache)
    if not selected.ok:return selected
    var position: Array = actor.last_visual_position
    var tile_key = "%d,%d" % [position[0], position[1]]
    var tile: Dictionary = state.get("tiles", {}).get(tile_key, {})
    if not tile.has("elevation_steps"): return _error("No disclosed elevation for actor tile " + tile_key)
    var appearance: Dictionary = actor.appearance
    return {"ok":true, "value":{"id":actor.uuid, "kind":"actor", "rig":selected.value.rig,
        "position":position.duplicate(), "base_height_steps":tile.elevation_steps, "visual_height":0.0,
        "scale":float(appearance.visual_scale), "scale_x":float(appearance.visual_scale_x),
        "appearance":appearance.duplicate(true), "equipment_layers":selected.value.equipment_layers,
        "facing":"SW", "life_state":actor.life_state}}

static func structure(actor:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    # The compiler compares these same constructor operands without inventing
    # a support tile or resolving position on every ordinary actor after-value.
    var id=rig_id(actor,cache)
    var available:Dictionary=rigs(cache)
    if id.is_empty() or not available.has(id):return _error("No authored rig for actor "+str(actor.get("uuid")))
    var selected=_select_layers(actor,available[id],id==BodySources.index(cache).root_rig,cache)
    if not selected.ok:return selected
    return {"ok":true,"value":{"rig":id,"appearance":actor.appearance,"equipment_layers":selected.value}}

static func _layer(category: String, tint: int = 0xFFFFFF, alpha: float = 1.0) -> Dictionary:
    return {"category":category, "tint":tint, "alpha":alpha}

static func _select_layers(actor: Dictionary, rig: Dictionary, modular: bool, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var selected: Dictionary = {}
    if not modular:
        var generated_shadow = _generated_creature_shadow(actor,rig,cache)
        var transient: Dictionary = {}
        for clip in rig.clips.values():
            for layer in clip.get("layers", []): transient[layer.slot] = true
        for slot in rig.slot_order:
            if slot=="shadow" and generated_shadow: continue
            if slot in EFFECT_SLOTS or transient.has(slot): continue
            var categories: Array = rig.slot_categories[slot]
            if categories.size() != 1: return _error("Fixed rig slot requires one authored category: " + slot)
            selected[slot] = _layer(categories[0], 0xFFFFFF, float(rig.get("shadow_alpha", 1.0)) if slot == "shadow" else 1.0)
    else:
        var appearance: Dictionary = actor.appearance
        if appearance.presentation_kind != "layered": return _error("Root rig requires layered actor appearance")
        # The built appearance mapping: AppearanceConfig fields and equipment slots -> rig slots and parts.
        var mapping: Dictionary = BodySources.index(cache).appearance
        var visual_slots: Dictionary = mapping.equipment_slots
        var weapon_sets: Dictionary = mapping.weapon_sets
        # Modular shadows are generated from original component geometry.
        selected.body = _layer(appearance.body_category, int(appearance.skin_tint))
        if appearance.head_category != null: selected.head = _layer(appearance.head_category, int(appearance.hair_tint))
        if appearance.has_beard: selected.beard = _layer(mapping.flag_parts.has_beard, int(appearance.beard_tint))
        var loadout: Dictionary = actor.visual_loadout
        for item in loadout.layers:
            if not visual_slots.has(item.slot): continue
            if weapon_sets.has(item.slot) and weapon_sets[item.slot] != loadout.active_weapon_set: continue
            if item.equipped_visual_policy == "hidden": continue
            var authored = BodySources.equipment(item,visual_slots[item.slot],cache)
            if not authored.ok: return authored
            for layer in authored.value:
                if layer.render_layer in EFFECT_SLOTS: continue
                var value = _layer(layer.sprite_key, int(layer.tint_rgb))
                value.equipment = true
                value.item_uuid = item.item_uuid
                selected[layer.render_layer] = value
    for effect in actor.get("presentation_layers",[]):
        var slot: String=effect.slot
        var value=_layer(effect.category)
        value.effect=effect
        selected[slot]=value
    var result: Array = []
    for slot in selected:
        if slot not in rig.slot_order or selected[slot].category not in rig.slot_categories[slot]:
            return _error("Unsupported authored rig layer " + slot + "/" + selected[slot].category)
    for slot in rig.slot_order:
        if selected.has(slot):
            selected[slot].slot = slot
            selected[slot].source_path=BodySources.layer_path(rig_id(actor,cache),selected[slot].category,cache)
            if selected[slot].source_path.is_empty():return _error("No imported body category: "+selected[slot].category)
            result.append(selected[slot])
    return {"ok":true, "value":result}

static func _equipment(item: Dictionary, slot: String, _visuals: Dictionary, _appearances: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary={}) -> Dictionary:
    return BodySources.equipment(item,slot,cache)

static func _generated_creature_shadow(actor:Dictionary,rig:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->bool:
    return rigs(cache).get(rig_id(actor,cache),rig).get("generated_shadow",false)

static func _sheet_path(slot:String,sheet:String,_resources:Dictionary,_components:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->String:
    var admitted=BodySources.index(cache)
    if admitted==null:return ""
    var source:Dictionary=admitted.sheets.get(sheet,{})
    return source.get(slot,source.get("default",""))

static func prepare_layers(row:Dictionary,rig:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    # Category selection is thin. Exact clip geometry is admitted by its own
    # preparation consumer; every actor borrows the same path map.
    var result:Array=row.equipment_layers.duplicate(true)
    for layer in result:
        var resource=BodySources.prepare_layer(layer.source_path,cache)
        if resource==null:return _error("Cannot admit body category: "+layer.source_path)
        layer.source_ref=resource
        var effect:Dictionary=layer.get("effect",{})
        var noise:Variant=effect.get("palette",{}).get("noiseSheet")
        if noise!=null:
            var noise_path:String=_sheet_path(layer.slot,str(noise),{},{},cache)
            if BodySources.prepare_descriptor(noise_path,layer.slot,cache).is_empty():return _error("Cannot admit body noise source: "+str(noise))
        if effect.has("sourceSheet"):
            layer.paths={}
            var path:String=_sheet_path(layer.slot,effect.sourceSheet,{},{},cache)
            if BodySources.prepare_descriptor(path,layer.slot,cache).is_empty():return _error("Cannot admit body sourceSheet: "+effect.sourceSheet)
            for clip in rig.clips:layer.paths[clip]=path
        else:
            layer.paths=resource.paths_by_slot.get(layer.slot,{})
        if layer.paths.is_empty():return _error("No admitted body clips for selected category: "+layer.category)
    return {"ok":true,"value":result}

static func layers(row:Dictionary,rig:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->Array:
    # Standalone fixtures and the pre-prepared startup compatibility path use
    # this wrapper. Ordinary publication consumes the explicit worker result.
    var prepared:Dictionary=prepare_layers(row,rig,cache)
    if not prepared.ok:push_error(prepared.error.message);return []
    return prepared.value

static func sheet_paths(actor:Dictionary,clips:Array,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var id:String=rig_id(actor,cache)
    var available:Dictionary=rigs(cache)
    if not available.has(id):return _error("No authored rig for actor "+str(actor.get("uuid")))
    var rig:Dictionary=available[id]
    var selected:Dictionary=_select_layers(actor,rig,id==BodySources.index(cache).root_rig,cache)
    if not selected.ok:return selected
    for layer in selected.value:
        layer.source_ref=BodySources.prepare_layer(layer.source_path,cache)
        if layer.source_ref==null:return _error("Cannot admit body category: "+layer.source_path)
    var paths:Dictionary={};var colours:Dictionary={};var geometry_slots:Dictionary={}
    var normal_sets:Dictionary={};var gpu_only:Dictionary={}
    var source_refs:Dictionary={"original":[],"gentle":[],"reference":[]};var native_refs:Array=[]
    var source_seen:Dictionary={"original":{},"gentle":{},"reference":{}};var native_seen:Dictionary={}
    for clip in clips:
        if not rig.clips.has(clip):return _error("Rig has no authored clip "+id+"/"+clip)
        for layer in selected.value:
            var effect:Dictionary=layer.get("effect",{})
            var noise:Variant=effect.get("palette",{}).get("noiseSheet")
            if noise!=null:
                var noise_path:String=_sheet_path(layer.slot,str(noise),{},{},cache)
                if noise_path.is_empty():return _error("No imported body noise source: "+str(noise))
                if not noise_path.is_empty():
                    paths[noise_path]=true;colours[noise_path]=true
                    var noise_descriptor:Dictionary=BodySources.prepare_descriptor(noise_path,layer.slot,cache)
                    if noise_descriptor.is_empty():return _error("Cannot admit body noise source: "+str(noise))
                    for profile in source_refs:
                        var reference:Dictionary=noise_descriptor.get("source_records",{}).get(profile,{})
                        if not reference.is_empty() and not source_seen[profile].has(reference.source_id):
                            source_seen[profile][reference.source_id]=true;source_refs[profile].append(reference)
            var descriptor:Dictionary={}
            if effect.has("sourceSheet"):
                var colour:String=_sheet_path(layer.slot,effect.sourceSheet,{},{},cache)
                descriptor=BodySources.prepare_descriptor(colour,layer.slot,cache)
                if descriptor.is_empty():return _error("Cannot admit body sourceSheet: "+effect.sourceSheet)
            else:
                if not layer.source_ref.clip_sources.has(clip):continue
                var source=BodySources.prepare_clip(layer.source_ref,clip,cache)
                if source==null:return _error("Cannot admit body clip: "+layer.category+"/"+clip)
                descriptor=source.descriptors.get(layer.slot,{})
            if descriptor.is_empty():continue
            for profile in source_refs:
                var reference:Dictionary=descriptor.source_records[profile]
                if not source_seen[profile].has(reference.source_id):
                    source_seen[profile][reference.source_id]=true;source_refs[profile].append(reference)
            var native_reference:Dictionary=descriptor.native_record
            if not native_reference.roles.is_empty() and not native_seen.has(native_reference.source_id):
                native_seen[native_reference.source_id]=true;native_refs.append(native_reference)
            var path:String=descriptor.path
            paths[path]=true;colours[path]=true
            paths.merge(descriptor.companions);gpu_only.merge(descriptor.companions)
            normal_sets.merge(descriptor.normal_sets)
            if effect.is_empty() and not descriptor.companions.is_empty():geometry_slots[path]=layer.slot
    for path in colours:gpu_only.erase(path)
    normal_sets.make_read_only()
    for records in source_refs.values():records.make_read_only()
    source_refs.make_read_only();native_refs.make_read_only()
    return {"ok":true,"value":paths,"gpu_only":gpu_only,"cpu_required":colours,"geometry_slots":geometry_slots,
        "normal_sets":normal_sets,"source_records":source_refs,"native_records":native_refs}

static func rest_sample(actor: Dictionary, rig: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var index: Dictionary = _read("catalog-index.json", cache)
    var clip = "Idle"
    var terminal: bool = actor.life_state in ["dead", "dying", "stable"]
    if actor.life_state == "dead":
        var death: Dictionary = _read(index.death_context, cache)
        clip = death.bodyClip
        for context in rig.get("body_contexts", []):
            if context.role == "death" and context.qualifier.kind == "default" and context.body.actor.enabled:
                clip = context.body.actor.clip
                break
    elif actor.life_state in ["dying", "stable"]:
        var lifecycle: Dictionary = _read(index.life_state_context, cache)
        clip = lifecycle.bodyPoses[actor.life_state].bodyPose
    if not rig.clips.has(clip): return _error("Rig has no authored resting clip " + clip)
    var source: Dictionary = rig.clips[clip]
    return {"ok":true, "value":{"clip":clip, "source_seconds":float(source.frames)/float(source.fps) if terminal else 0.0}}
```

### A.5 — `presentation/environment_media.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/environment_media.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Source enumeration for disclosed live rows. This is metadata preparation;
# no rasterization, geometry inference, or Godot scene/texture creation occurs.
const Catalog = preload("res://source_catalog.gd")
const WorldRows = preload("res://presentation/world.gd")
const Placement = preload("res://placement.gd")
const EncounterMedia=preload("res://presentation/encounter_media.gd")

static func record_paths(record: Dictionary, paths: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> void:
    if record.is_empty(): return
    paths[record.path] = true
    for field in ["geometry_region","hit_mask","door_partition"]:
        if record.has(field): paths[record[field].path] = true
    if record.has("normal"): paths[record.normal.region.path] = true
    for role in record.get("roles",[]):
        if role.selection.kind == "mask": paths[role.selection.mask.region.path] = true
    if record.has("water"):
        paths[Catalog.environment_resources(cache).resources[record.water.ripple].path] = true

static func animation_pages(row: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Only the explicit finite workshop destruction bank needs its entire page
    # closure. Ordinary live after-values retain row_paths' selected endpoint.
    # Enumerate source records, not time steps, so authored irregular clocks and
    # every camera pose remain covered without inventing a playback phase.
    var paths = {}
    var errors: Array = []
    var bank_id = Catalog.bank_for(row,true,cache)
    if bank_id.is_empty(): return {"paths":paths,"errors":errors}
    var bank: Dictionary = Catalog.bank_data(bank_id,cache)
    var layouts = Catalog.texture_layouts(cache)
    for frames in bank.surface_frames_by_pose.values():
        for frame in frames:
            var record = Catalog.receiving_normal(frame,cache)
            for region in [record.get("geometry_region",{}),record.get("normal",{}).get("region",{})]:
                var layout: Dictionary = layouts.get(region.get("path",""),{})
                if not layout.has("pages"): continue
                var selected = Catalog._layout_region(region,layouts)
                if selected.is_empty(): errors.append("Invalid animation texture page region: "+str(region))
                else: paths[selected.path] = true
    return {"paths":paths,"errors":errors}

static func row_paths(row: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Live source selection depends on these authored selectors, not ID/contact.
    # Repeated tiles/walls in large rooms share a finite original source set.
    var key = JSON.stringify([row.kind,row.get("material"),row.get("asset"),row.get("orientation"),
        row.get("state"),row.get("boundaries",[]),row.get("views"),row.get("lit_animation"),
        row.get("destroyed",false),row.get("outcome")])
    if not cache.has("__live_media_sources"): cache.__live_media_sources = {}
    if cache.__live_media_sources.has(key): return cache.__live_media_sources[key]
    var paths = {}
    for quarter in range(4):
        var source: Dictionary = row.duplicate()
        if source.has("views"): source.asset = source.views[Placement.pose(source.orientation,quarter)]
        record_paths(Catalog.environment(source,quarter,cache),paths,cache)
        if row.kind == "door": record_paths(Catalog.door_frame(source,quarter,cache),paths,cache)
    if row.has("lit_animation"):
        var assets = Catalog.environment_resources(cache)
        if not cache.has("__live_fixture_frames"): cache.__live_fixture_frames = {}
        for frame in assets.animations[row.lit_animation].frames:
            var path: String = assets.resources[frame].path
            paths[path] = true
            if not cache.__live_fixture_frames.has(path):cache.__live_fixture_revision=int(cache.get("__live_fixture_revision",0))+1
            cache.__live_fixture_frames[path] = true
    cache.__live_media_sources[key] = paths
    return paths

static func _collect(state: Dictionary, paths: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> void:
    var rows = WorldRows.rows(state,cache)
    for row in rows.visual_rows:
        paths.merge(row_paths(row,cache))
        # Hidden corners and Ctrl picks use the original straight members.
        for member in row.get("wall_members",[]): paths.merge(row_paths(member,cache))

static func _cell(object: Dictionary) -> String:
    return WorldRows.cell_key(object.placement.position)

static func _index(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not cache.has("__environment_demand_index"):
        cache.__environment_demand_index = {"tiles":{},"objects":{},"visual":{},"cells":{},"tile_paths":{},"cell_paths":{},
            "contacts":{},"senses":null,"tile_materials":{},"changed_row_builds":0,"plans":0,"paths_dirty":true,"paths":{}}
    return cache.__environment_demand_index

static func _update(index: Dictionary, tiles: Dictionary, objects: Dictionary, removed: Array,
        senses: Variant, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var changed_paths = {}
    var contacts: Dictionary = senses.get("objects",{}) if senses != null else {}
    var cells = {}
    for key in tiles:
        var tile: Dictionary = tiles[key]
        var material: String = tile.surface.base_material
        index.tiles[key] = tile
        # WorldRows terrain rows have fixed orientation/boundaries; row_paths
        # selects their sheets only by base material. Contact/elevation/light
        # still reach the world renderer, but cannot change this source closure.
        if index.tile_materials.get(key)==material: continue
        index.paths_dirty=true
        index.tile_materials[key] = material
        var paths = {}
        _collect({"tiles":{key:tiles[key]},"objects":{},"senses":senses},paths,cache)
        index.tile_paths[key] = paths
        changed_paths.merge(paths)
        index.changed_row_builds += 1
    for id in removed:
        if not index.objects.has(id): continue
        var old_cell = _cell(index.objects[id])
        cells[old_cell] = true
        index.cells[old_cell].erase(id)
        index.objects.erase(id); index.visual.erase(id)
    for id in objects:
        var visual = contacts.get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
        if index.objects.get(id)==objects[id] and index.visual.get(id)==visual: continue
        if index.objects.has(id):
            var old_cell = _cell(index.objects[id])
            index.cells[old_cell].erase(id); cells[old_cell] = true
        var cell = _cell(objects[id])
        if not index.cells.has(cell): index.cells[cell] = {}
        index.cells[cell][id] = objects[id]
        index.objects[id] = objects[id]; index.visual[id] = visual
        cells[cell] = true
    # Sense-only commits can switch a registered fixture animation. No terrain
    # or wall-source selection depends on the full visible-tile list.
    if index.contacts != contacts:
        for id in index.objects:
            var visual = contacts.get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
            if index.visual.get(id)==visual: continue
            index.visual[id] = visual; cells[_cell(index.objects[id])] = true
    index.contacts = contacts;index.senses=senses
    for cell in cells:
        var members: Dictionary = index.cells[cell]
        if members.is_empty():
            index.cells.erase(cell)
            if index.cell_paths.erase(cell):index.paths_dirty=true
            continue
        var paths = {}
        _collect({"tiles":{},"objects":members,"senses":senses},paths,cache)
        var previous:Dictionary=index.cell_paths.get(cell,{})
        if previous.keys()!=paths.keys():
            paths.make_read_only();index.cell_paths[cell]=paths;index.paths_dirty=true
        changed_paths.merge(paths)
        index.changed_row_builds += members.size()
    return changed_paths

static func _all_paths(index: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not index.get("paths_dirty",true):return index.paths
    var paths = {}
    # Terrain source selection is keyed solely by base material above. Merge
    # its first disclosed closure once, preserving the original path order.
    var materials = {}
    for key in index.tile_paths:
        var material: String = index.tile_materials[key]
        if materials.has(material): continue
        materials[material] = true
        paths.merge(index.tile_paths[key])
    for closure in index.cell_paths.values(): paths.merge(closure)
    paths.make_read_only();index.paths=paths;index.paths_dirty=false
    return paths

static func _extend_paths(paths:Dictionary,extra:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var added:bool=false
    for path in extra:
        if not paths.has(path):added=true;break
    if not added:return paths
    if paths.is_read_only():paths=paths.duplicate()
    paths.merge(extra)
    return paths

static func _first_use(initial: Dictionary, times: Dictionary, paths: Dictionary, at_ms: float) -> void:
    for path in paths:
        if not initial.has(path): times[path] = minf(float(times.get(path,at_ms)),at_ms)

static func _timeline(initial: Dictionary, times: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not initial.is_read_only():initial = initial.duplicate()
    var by_time = {}
    for path in times:
        var at_ms: float = times[path]
        if at_ms <= 0:
            if not initial.has(path):
                if initial.is_read_only():initial=initial.duplicate()
                initial[path]=true
            continue
        if not by_time.has(at_ms): by_time[at_ms] = {}
        by_time[at_ms][path] = true
    var keys: Array = by_time.keys(); keys.sort()
    var changes: Array = []
    initial.make_read_only()
    var cumulative: Dictionary = initial
    for at_ms in keys:
        cumulative = cumulative.duplicate()
        cumulative.merge(by_time[at_ms])
        cumulative.make_read_only()
        changes.append({"at_ms":at_ms,"paths":cumulative})
    return {"initial":initial,"changes":changes}

static func required_at(schedule: Dictionary, local_ms: float, fallback: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    # Older/unassessed plans retain the complete readiness gate. Source loading
    # still owns the full group union; only its first-use gate is time-specific.
    if not schedule.has("initial") or not schedule.has("changes"): return fallback
    var paths: Dictionary = schedule.initial
    for change in schedule.changes:
        if float(change.at_ms) > local_ms + 0.000001: break
        paths = change.paths
    return paths

static func _role_records(paths:Dictionary,fixtures:Dictionary,previous:Dictionary,retained:Dictionary,reuse:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    for set in reuse.previous:
        if is_same(set.paths,paths) and set.fixture_revision==reuse.fixture_revision:
            reuse.current.append(set)
            for record in set.records:retained[record.source_id]=record
            return set
    var records:Array=[]
    for path in paths:
        var fixture:bool=fixtures.has(path)
        var identity:StringName=StringName("environment:"+path+"#fixture:"+str(int(fixture)))
        var record:Dictionary=retained.get(identity,previous.get(identity,{}))
        if record.is_empty():
            var role:Array=[Catalog.media_path(path),1,int(fixture),1];role.make_read_only()
            var roles:Dictionary={path:role};roles.make_read_only()
            record={"source_id":identity,"roles":roles};record.make_read_only()
        retained[identity]=record;records.append(record)
    records.make_read_only()
    var sizes:Dictionary=EncounterMedia.source_sizes(paths,reuse.cache);sizes.make_read_only()
    var absolute:Dictionary={};var cpu:Dictionary={};var selected_fixtures:Dictionary={}
    for record in records:
        for path in record.roles:
            absolute[path]=record.roles[path][0];cpu[path]=true
            if fixtures.has(path):selected_fixtures[path]=true
    var ordered:Array=absolute.keys();ordered.make_read_only()
    for values in [absolute,cpu,selected_fixtures]:values.make_read_only()
    var gpu:Dictionary={};gpu.make_read_only()
    var family:Dictionary={"paths":absolute,"environment":cpu,"fixtures":selected_fixtures,"cpu_required":cpu,
        "gpu_only":gpu,"ordered_paths":ordered,"source_sizes":sizes};family.make_read_only()
    var set:Dictionary={"paths":paths,"fixture_revision":reuse.fixture_revision,"records":records,"source_sizes":sizes,"family":family,
        "source_headers":EncounterMedia.source_headers(paths,reuse.cache)}
    reuse.current.append(set)
    return set

static func plan(state: Dictionary, groups: Array, cache: Dictionary, origin_state: Dictionary = {}, final_state: Dictionary = {}, partial: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
    var required = {}
    var upcoming = {}
    var environment_timeline = {}
    if state.is_empty(): return {"required":required,"upcoming":upcoming,"fixtures":{},"disclosed":{},"environment_timeline":environment_timeline,
        "required_records":[],"upcoming_records":[],"source_sizes":{},"source_headers":{}}
    var phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
    var phases = {"initial_update":0.0,"all_paths":0.0,"commit_updates":0.0}
    var index = _index(cache)
    index.plans += 1
    # Only the session's immutable canonical owner can prove continuity. A
    # shallow worker snapshot alone cannot prove the previous full operation
    # was planned. Optional/non-session/interleaved plans invalidate this proof.
    var skip_initial: bool = groups.size()<=2 and not origin_state.is_empty() and is_same(index.get("final_owner",{}),origin_state)
    index.erase("final_owner")
    var senses: Variant = state.senses
    if not skip_initial:
        for key in index.tiles.keys():
            if not state.tiles.has(key):
                index.tiles.erase(key); index.tile_paths.erase(key); index.tile_materials.erase(key);index.paths_dirty=true
        var removed: Array = []
        for id in index.objects:
            if not state.objects.has(id): removed.append(id)
        _update(index,state.tiles,state.objects,removed,senses,cache)
    phases.initial_update = (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
    required = _all_paths(index)
    phases.all_paths += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    var disclosed: Dictionary = required
    var applied_world_delta:bool=false
    for group_index in range(groups.size()):
        var paths: Dictionary = required if group_index==0 else upcoming
        var initial: Dictionary = disclosed
        if group_index>0:
            phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
            initial = _all_paths(index)
            paths=_extend_paths(paths,initial)
            phases.all_paths += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
        phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
        var group: Dictionary = groups[group_index]
        var first_use = {}
        for key in group.get("staged_tiles",{}):
            if not index.tiles.has(key):
                var staged_paths = {}
                _collect({"tiles":{key:group.staged_tiles[key]},"objects":{},"senses":senses},staged_paths,cache)
                paths=_extend_paths(paths,staged_paths)
                _first_use(initial,first_use,staged_paths,float(group.get("staged_tile_at_ms",{}).get(key,0.0)))
        for commit in group.get("commits",[]):
            var delta: Dictionary = commit.delta
            if delta.get("tiles",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects_removed",[]).is_empty() and not delta.get("set",{}).has("senses"): continue
            applied_world_delta=true
            senses = delta.get("set",{}).get("senses",senses)
            # Existing paths were included at group entry. Add only changed
            # closures, preserving the exhaustive within-group union.
            var changed_paths = _update(index,delta.get("tiles",{}),delta.get("objects",{}),delta.get("objects_removed",[]),senses,cache)
            paths=_extend_paths(paths,changed_paths)
            _first_use(initial,first_use,changed_paths,float(commit.get("at_ms",0.0)))
        if group.has("id"): environment_timeline[group.id] = _timeline(initial,first_use)
        if group_index==0:required=paths
        else:upcoming=paths
        phases.commit_updates += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    if groups.size()<=2 and not final_state.is_empty() and not origin_state.is_empty(): index.final_owner = final_state
    elif partial and not origin_state.is_empty() and not applied_world_delta:
        # Initial synchronization establishes this exact canonical origin.
        # Staged source enumeration does not advance the index; the full
        # continuation can reuse it without walking the room again.
        index.final_owner=origin_state
    var fixtures = {}
    required.make_read_only();upcoming.make_read_only()
    for paths in [required,upcoming]:
        for path in paths:
            if cache.get("__live_fixture_frames",{}).has(path): fixtures[path] = true
    # The same producer owns finite physical source-role refs. An opening cut
    # borrows the previous complete map; only full continuation retires extras.
    var previous:Dictionary=cache.get("__environment_source_records",{})
    var retained:Dictionary=previous.duplicate() if partial else {}
    var reuse:Dictionary={"previous":cache.get("__environment_source_sets",[]),"current":[],"fixture_revision":int(cache.get("__live_fixture_revision",0)),"cache":cache}
    var required_set:Dictionary=_role_records(required,fixtures,previous,retained,reuse)
    var upcoming_set:Dictionary=_role_records(upcoming,fixtures,previous,retained,reuse)
    cache.__environment_source_sets=reuse.current
    var sizes:Dictionary=required_set.source_sizes
    var headers:Dictionary=required_set.source_headers
    if not upcoming_set.paths.is_empty():
        var previous_sizes:Dictionary=required_set.get("size_union",{})
        if is_same(previous_sizes.get("upcoming"),upcoming_set.source_sizes):
            sizes=previous_sizes.value;headers=previous_sizes.headers
        else:
            sizes=sizes.duplicate();sizes.merge(upcoming_set.source_sizes);sizes.make_read_only()
            headers=headers.duplicate();headers.merge(upcoming_set.source_headers);headers.make_read_only()
            required_set.size_union={"upcoming":upcoming_set.source_sizes,"value":sizes,"headers":headers}
    retained.make_read_only();cache.__environment_source_records=retained
    return {"required":required,"upcoming":upcoming,"required_records":required_set.records,"upcoming_records":upcoming_set.records,"source_sizes":sizes,"source_headers":headers,
        "required_family":required_set.family,"upcoming_family":upcoming_set.family,
        "fixtures":fixtures,"disclosed":disclosed,"environment_timeline":environment_timeline,
        "diagnostics":{"plans":index.plans,"changed_row_builds":index.changed_row_builds,"skipped_initial":skip_initial,"phases":phases}}

static func finish_handoff(groups:Array,final_state:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->void:
    if final_state.is_empty():return
    # The selected display prefix has its own immutable source cuts. Advance
    # only remaining authoritative world deltas in this private selector index
    # so the next operation can borrow its exact canonical starting owner.
    var index:Dictionary=_index(cache)
    var senses:Variant=index.senses
    for group in groups:
        for commit in group.get("commits",[]):
            var delta:Dictionary=commit.delta
            if delta.get("tiles",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects_removed",[]).is_empty() and not delta.get("set",{}).has("senses"):continue
            senses=delta.get("set",{}).get("senses",senses)
            _update(index,delta.get("tiles",{}),delta.get("objects",{}),delta.get("objects_removed",[]),senses,cache)
    # Retain the selected final source union with its private canonical owner.
    # The next operation borrows it; it does not rebuild a room-sized union on
    # the opening path merely because this operation changed a few cells.
    _all_paths(index)
    index.final_owner=final_state
```

### A.6 — `presentation/native_source_admission.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/native_source_admission.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Godot 4.7's particle compiler is shared by loaded ShaderMaterials and
## generated ParticleProcessMaterials. Keep those two admission paths apart.
## Existing instances continue sampling; this owns no presentation clock.
static var loading_path:String=""
static var loading_owner:Dictionary={}
static var loading_revision:int=0
static var settling:bool=false
static var mutation_frame:int=-1
static var loads_started:int=0
static var _material_job:Dictionary={}
static var _prepared_material_owners:Dictionary={}
static var material_profile:Dictionary={}

static func _drawn()->void:
    settling=false

static func _poll()->void:
    if not _material_job.is_empty():
        if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_material_job.task):return
        WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_material_job.task)
        if _material_job.owner.get("native_source_revision",0)==_material_job.revision:
            _material_job.owner.native_material_programs[_material_job.packet]=true
        _prepared_material_owners[_material_job.packet.get_instance_id()]=weakref(_material_job.packet)
        material_profile={"materials":_material_job.materials.size(),"worker_ms":_material_job.elapsed_ms}
        _material_job={}
        settling=true
        RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(_drawn,CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
    if loading_path.is_empty():return
    var status:int=ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(loading_path)
    if status==ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:return
    if status==ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
        var resource:Resource=ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(loading_path)
        if loading_owner.get("native_source_revision",0)==loading_revision:loading_owner[loading_path]=resource
    elif loading_owner.get("native_source_revision",0)==loading_revision:
        if not loading_owner.has("native_load_errors"):loading_owner.native_load_errors={}
        loading_owner.native_load_errors[loading_path]="Native resource preparation failed: "+loading_path
    loading_path="";loading_owner={}
    # A loaded scene may leave generated particle materials on Godot's dirty
    # list. Let its normal draw flush complete before construction/adaptation.
    settling=true
    RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(_drawn,CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)

static func can_mutate()->bool:
    _poll()
    return loading_path.is_empty() and _material_job.is_empty() and not settling

static func begin_mutation()->bool:
    if not can_mutate():return false
    mutation_frame=Engine.get_process_frames()
    return true

static func prepare(paths:Array,cache:Dictionary,fresh:bool=false)->Dictionary:
    _poll()
    var pending:int=0;var errors:Array=[]
    for path in paths:
        if cache.has(path):continue
        if cache.get("native_load_errors",{}).has(path):
            errors.append(cache.native_load_errors[path]);continue
        if not fresh and loading_path.is_empty() and _material_job.is_empty() and not settling and ResourceLoader.has_cached(path):
            cache[path]=load(path)
            continue
        pending+=1
        if not loading_path.is_empty() or not _material_job.is_empty() or settling or mutation_frame==Engine.get_process_frames():continue
        var error:Error=ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path,"",false,ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE_DEEP if fresh else ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE)
        if error!=OK:
            errors.append("Native resource preparation failed: "+str(path));continue
        loading_path=path;loading_owner=cache;loading_revision=int(cache.get("native_source_revision",0));loads_started+=1
    return {"ready":pending==0 and errors.is_empty(),"pending":pending,"errors":errors,
        "loading":loading_path,"settling":settling}

static func prepare_materials(packet:Resource,materials:Array[Material],cache:Dictionary)->bool:
    _poll()
    if not cache.has("native_material_programs"):cache.native_material_programs={}
    if cache.native_material_programs.has(packet):return true
    var prior:WeakRef=_prepared_material_owners.get(packet.get_instance_id())
    if prior!=null and is_same(prior.get_ref(),packet):
        cache.native_material_programs[packet]=true
        return true
    if materials.is_empty():
        cache.native_material_programs[packet]=true
        return true
    if not can_mutate() or mutation_frame==Engine.get_process_frames():return false
    for identity in _prepared_material_owners.keys():
        if _prepared_material_owners[identity].get_ref()==null:_prepared_material_owners.erase(identity)
    # The one source admission owner excludes any concurrent native load,
    # constructor or program rewrite until this worker and its draw fence end.
    # Only retained prototype Material RIDs are initialized; no Node, instance
    # parameters, animation or source clock is touched on the worker.
    _material_job={"packet":packet,"materials":materials,"owner":cache,"revision":cache.get("native_source_revision",0),"elapsed_ms":0.0,"task":-1}
    _material_job.task=WorkerThreadPool.add_task(_prepare_material_programs.bind(_material_job),false,"Native prototype programs")
    return false

static func _prepare_material_programs(job:Dictionary)->void:
    var started:int=Time.get_ticks_usec()
    for material in job.materials:material.get_rid()
    job.elapsed_ms=(Time.get_ticks_usec()-started)/1000.0
```

```gdscript
## Optional resource candidates from disclosed choices, selection and displayed records.

static func create() -> Dictionary:

        "owner_preview":{},"owner_result":{},"owner_rows":{},"owner_contacts":{},
        "actor_sources":{},"object_sources":{},"source_revision":0,"owner_source_revision":-1}

static func _outfit(actor: Dictionary) -> Array:

static func owners(data: Dictionary, state: Dictionary, preview: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:

    var contacts: Dictionary=senses.get("objects",{})

static func _cancelled(control: Dictionary) -> bool:
    control.mutex.lock()

static func cancel(data: Dictionary) -> void:
    if not data.control.is_empty():

static func request(data: Dictionary, key: Array, actor_uuid: String, behavior: String,
        state: Dictionary, budget_bytes: int, source_files: Dictionary = {}, preview: Dictionary = {}, eligible: Array = [], hints: Dictionary = {}, profile: String = "", behaviors: Array = []) -> void:

    for id in hints.objects:

    for path in retained.get("environment",{}):
        if shared_environment.has(path):continue
        retained.bytes-=int(retained.source_sizes.get(path,0))*(2 if retained.cpu_required.has(path) else 1)
        for field in ["paths","cpu_required","gpu_only","source_sizes"]:retained[field].erase(path)
    if not retained.is_empty():retained.environment=shared_environment;retained.object_paths=shared_objects;retained.bank_paths=shared_banks;retained.banks=shared_banks.keys()

        "state":{"actors":actors,"objects":objects,"tiles":{},"senses":senses},
        "budget_bytes":budget_bytes,"source_files":source_files.duplicate(),"recipients":recipients,"eligible":eligible.duplicate(),"exact_recipients":hints.exact,
        "disclosed_objects":data.disclosed_objects.duplicate(),"profile":profile,"behaviors":behaviors.duplicate()}

static func _start(data: Dictionary) -> void:
    if data.closed or data.task>=0 or data.pending.is_empty(): return

    data.jobs+=1

static func poll(data: Dictionary) -> bool:

    data.disclosed_objects={};data.actor_sources={};data.object_sources={}

static func _actor_paths(actor: Dictionary, clips: Array, result: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if clips.is_empty(): return {}
    var sources=Characters.sheet_paths(actor,clips,cache)
    if not sources.ok: result.errors.append(sources.error.message);return {}
    var paths: Dictionary=sources.value.duplicate()
    result.paths.merge(sources.value);result.cpu_required.merge(sources.cpu_required);result.gpu_only.merge(sources.gpu_only)
    result.normal_sets.merge(sources.get("normal_sets",{}))
    for path in sources.geometry_slots:
```
