```gdscript
        for optical in NativeSupport.required_paths(path,sources.geometry_slots[path],cache).values():
            result.paths[optical]=true
            paths[optical]=true
            if cpu.has(optical):result.cpu_required[optical]=true
            elif not result.cpu_required.has(optical):result.gpu_only[optical]=true
    return paths

static func _responses(actor: Dictionary, result: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> void:
    if actor.get("life_state")=="dead":return
    var rig: Dictionary=Authoring.rigs(cache).get(Characters.rig_id(actor,cache),{})
    var clips=[]
    for role in ["damage","death"]:
        var body: Dictionary=Authoring.body(role,actor,{},cache).get("actor",{})
        if body.get("enabled",true) and body.has("clip") and rig.get("clips",{}).has(body.clip):clips.append(body.clip)
    var paths: Dictionary=_actor_paths(actor,clips,result,cache)
    var key: Array=paths.keys();key.sort();key.make_read_only()
    if not cache.has("__selection_response_families"):cache.__selection_response_families={}
    if not cache.__selection_response_families.has(key):cache.__selection_response_families[key]=cache.__selection_response_families.size()
    result.actor_sources[actor.uuid]={"signature":_outfit(actor),"family":cache.__selection_response_families[key]}

static func _break_banks(row: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Array:
    # Enumerate actual registered alternatives, without choosing a destruction
    # outcome or altering the disclosed object. Some banks are state-specific.
    var index: Dictionary=Catalog.environment_index(cache)
    if row.kind=="wall":
        var walls: Dictionary=index.wall_destructions
        return [walls[row.material]] if walls.has(row.material) else []
    if row.kind not in ["prop","door","trap"]:return []
    var group: String={"prop":"props","door":"doors","trap":"traps"}[row.kind]
    var owner: Dictionary=index[group][row.asset]
    var banks={}
    for field in ["destructions","destructions_without_attachments"]:
        for state in owner.get(field,{}):
            if state==row.get("state","default") or (row.kind=="door" and state.begins_with(row.state+".")):
                banks[owner[field][state]]=true
    return banks.keys()

static func plan(request: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary, control: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result={"paths":{},"cpu_required":{},"gpu_only":{},"environment":{},"source_sizes":{},"source_files":{},
        "errors":[],"skipped":0,"bytes":0,"actors":[],"banks":[],"object_paths":{},"bank_paths":{},"onset_paths":{},"native_selection":{},"actor_sources":{},"object_sources":{},"normal_sets":{}}
    var state: Dictionary=request.state
    var caster: Dictionary=state.actors.get(request.actor_uuid,{})
    if caster.is_empty() or _cancelled(control):return result
    var recipe: Dictionary=NativeSpells.recipe({"behavior_id":request.behavior},cache)
    if _cancelled(control):return result
    if recipe.is_empty():
        # A choice names resources, not a received fact. Resolve only its authored
        # body clip; never infer conditions, recipients or gameplay outcomes.
        var clips={}
        var behaviors: Array=request.get("behaviors",[])
        if behaviors.is_empty():behaviors=[request.behavior]
        for behavior in behaviors:
            var body: Dictionary=Authoring.action({"kind":"action","behavior_id":behavior},cache,caster).get("actor",{})
            if body.get("enabled",true) and body.has("clip"):clips[body.clip]=true
            if behavior=="action.move":
                # Locomotion is authored through movement/rig contexts rather
                # than a body-action recipe. Reuse the encounter source owner's
                # finite closure before the first click, including connectors
                # and condition poses, without predicting any movement outcome.
                var index:Dictionary=Catalog.read_file("catalog-index.json",cache)
                var rig:Dictionary=Characters.rigs(cache)[Characters.rig_id(caster,cache)]
                for clip in EncounterMedia._priority_clips(caster,rig,index,cache):clips[clip]=true
                var pose:Dictionary=Authoring.ConditionPose.select(caster,Characters.rig_id(caster,cache),"move",cache)
                if not pose.is_empty():clips[pose.clip]=true
        if not clips.is_empty():
            _actor_paths(caster,clips.keys(),result,cache)
            result.actors.append({"uuid":request.actor_uuid,"clips":clips.keys()})
            result.onset_paths=result.paths.duplicate()
        return _finish_plan(request,result,{},cache,control)
    # Admit only the selected passive feedback operand. Its actual release
    # remains exclusively driven by a received authoritative damage fact.
    if recipe.get("damage")!=null and Catalog.residue_asset(cache).is_empty():
        result.errors.append("Cannot load selected asset metadata: particles.region.blood")
    result.native_selection=NativeSpells.selection(request.behavior,cache)
    var rigs: Dictionary=Authoring.rigs(cache)
    var actor_order: Array=[request.actor_uuid]
    actor_order.append_array(state.actors.keys().filter(func(id):return id!=request.actor_uuid))
    for id in actor_order:
        if _cancelled(control):return result
        var actor: Dictionary=state.actors[id]
        var rig: Dictionary=rigs.get(Characters.rig_id(actor,cache),{})
        if rig.is_empty():continue
        var clips={}
        var rest=Characters.rest_sample(actor,rig,cache)
        if rest.ok:clips[rest.value.clip]=true
        if id==request.actor_uuid:
            var cast: Dictionary=recipe.get("cast",{})
            if cast.get("enabled",true) and cast.has("actionClip"):clips[cast.actionClip]=true
            var recovery: Dictionary=cast.get("recovery",{})
            if recovery.get("enabled",false):clips[recovery.bodyClip]=true
            # Read raw layer metadata; Palette.prepare would decode a sheet.
            var layers: Array=cast.get("effects",[]).duplicate()
            for field in ["weaponGlow","aura"]:
                if cast.get(field)!=null:layers.append(cast[field])
            var casting: Dictionary=actor.duplicate()
            casting.presentation_layers=actor.get("presentation_layers",[]).duplicate()
            for layer in layers:
                if layer.get("enabled",true) and not layer.get("hidden",false):casting.presentation_layers.append(layer)
            if cast.has("actionClip"):_actor_paths(casting,[cast.actionClip],result,cache)
        var available: Array=clips.keys().filter(func(clip):return rig.clips.has(clip))
        _actor_paths(actor,available,result,cache)
        result.actors.append({"uuid":id,"clips":available})
    # These sources are needed for the opening cast and current occluders.
    # Response/death/destruction candidates below remain useful later work.
    result.onset_paths=result.paths.duplicate()
    for id in request.get("recipients",[]):
        if _cancelled(control):return result
        if recipe.get("damage")!=null and state.actors.has(id):_responses(state.actors[id],result,cache)
    var disclosed: Dictionary=state.duplicate()
    disclosed.objects=request.get("disclosed_objects",state.objects)
    var rows=WorldRows.rows(disclosed,cache)
    var bank_paths={}
    for row in rows.rows:
        if _cancelled(control):return result
        if recipe.get("damage")==null or row.get("destroyed",false):continue
        var selected_banks: Array=_break_banks(row,cache)
        result.object_sources[row.id]={"item":disclosed.objects[row.id].item,"banks":selected_banks}
        if not state.objects.has(row.id):continue
        var object_paths={}
        for bank_id in selected_banks:
            if bank_paths.has(bank_id):object_paths.merge(bank_paths[bank_id]);continue
            result.banks.append(bank_id)
            var paths={}
            var bank: Dictionary=Catalog.bank_data(bank_id,cache)
            for pose in bank.get("surface_frames_by_pose",{}):
                var frames: Array=bank.surface_frames_by_pose[pose]
                for index in frames.size():
                    if _cancelled(control):return result
                    var surface: Dictionary=frames[index].duplicate()
                    var region: Dictionary=bank.frames_by_pose[pose][index] if bank.has("frames_by_pose") else {"path":bank.path,"rect":[index*bank.cell[0],bank.rows.find(pose)*bank.cell[1],bank.cell[0],bank.cell[1]]}
                    if row.kind=="door" and bank.has("leaf_path"):
                        region={"path":bank.leaf_path,"rect":[index*bank.cell[0],bank.rows.find(pose)*bank.cell[1],bank.cell[0],bank.cell[1]]}
                    surface.merge({"path":region.path,"rect":region.rect,"native_size":bank.cell})
                    EnvironmentMedia.record_paths(Catalog.texture_layout(Catalog.receiving_normal(surface,cache),cache),paths,cache)
            bank_paths[bank_id]=paths;object_paths.merge(paths)
        result.environment.merge(object_paths);result.object_paths[row.id]=object_paths
    result.paths.merge(result.environment);result.cpu_required.merge(result.environment)
    for id in state.actors:
        if _cancelled(control):return result
        if recipe.get("damage")!=null and not request.get("exact_recipients",false) and id not in request.get("recipients",[]) and (request.get("eligible",[]).is_empty() or id in request.eligible):
            _responses(state.actors[id],result,cache)
    return _finish_plan(request,result,bank_paths,cache,control)

static func _finish_plan(request: Dictionary, result: Dictionary, bank_paths: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary, control: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    for path in result.cpu_required:result.gpu_only.erase(path)
    var profile: String=request.get("profile","")
    result.normal_sets.make_read_only()
    result.paths=Characters.CharacterGeometry.for_profile(result.paths,result.normal_sets,profile,cache,"selection_paths")
    result.onset_paths=Characters.CharacterGeometry.for_profile(result.onset_paths,result.normal_sets,profile,cache,"selection_onset")
    result.cpu_required=Characters.CharacterGeometry.for_profile(result.cpu_required,result.normal_sets,profile,cache,"selection_cpu")
    result.gpu_only=Characters.CharacterGeometry.for_profile(result.gpu_only,result.normal_sets,profile,cache,"selection_gpu")
    var estimates=EncounterMedia.estimates(result.paths,result.cpu_required,result.gpu_only,cache)
    result.source_headers=cache.get("__encounter_headers",{}).duplicate()
    var accepted={};var cpu={};var gpu={};var environment={}
    for path in result.paths:
        if _cancelled(control):return result
        var estimate: Dictionary=estimates[path]
        if not estimate.has("bytes") or result.bytes+int(estimate.bytes)>request.budget_bytes:
            result.skipped+=1;continue
        accepted[path]=Catalog.media_path(path);result.bytes+=int(estimate.bytes)
        result.source_sizes[path]=int(estimate.gpu_bytes)
        if result.cpu_required.has(path):cpu[path]=true
        if result.gpu_only.has(path):gpu[path]=true
        if result.environment.has(path):environment[path]=true
    result.paths=accepted;result.cpu_required=cpu;result.gpu_only=gpu;result.environment=environment
    var onset:Dictionary={}
    for path in result.onset_paths:
        if accepted.has(path):onset[path]=true
    result.onset_paths=onset
    for id in result.object_paths:
        var retained_paths={}
        for path in result.object_paths[id]:
            if accepted.has(path):retained_paths[path]=true
        result.object_paths[id]=retained_paths
    for bank in bank_paths:
        var retained_paths={}
        for path in bank_paths[bank]:
            if accepted.has(path):retained_paths[path]=true
        result.bank_paths[bank]=retained_paths
    result.source_files=Catalog.source_snapshot(cache)
    return result

static func _work(request: Dictionary, result: Dictionary, control: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> void:
    var started=Time.get_ticks_usec()
    Catalog.adopt_snapshot(cache,request.source_files)
    var value=plan(request,cache,control)
    if _cancelled(control):return
    result.key=request.key;result.value=value;result.elapsed_ms=(Time.get_ticks_usec()-started)/1000.0;result.complete=true
```


### A.8 — `presentation/world.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:presentation/world.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Adapter from disclosed SDK geometry into existing authored placement rows.
const Catalog = preload("res://source_catalog.gd")

static func cell_key(position: Array) -> String:
    return "%d,%d" % [position[0],position[1]]

static func rows(state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var world = Catalog.environment_world(cache)
    var index = Catalog.environment_index(cache)
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses") != null else {}
    var result: Array = []
    var missing: Array = []
    for tile in state.tiles.values():
        var material: String = tile.surface.base_material
        if not world.terrain.has(material): missing.append("terrain:"+material); continue
        result.append({"id":tile.tile_uuid,"kind":"terrain","material":material,"position":tile.position,
            "base_height_steps":tile.elevation_steps,"layer":0,"orientation":"east","boundaries":[]})
    for id in state.objects:
        var object: Dictionary = state.objects[id]
        var place: Dictionary = object.placement
        var item: Dictionary = object.item
        var direction: String = place.get("boundary_direction") if place.get("boundary_direction") != null else (place.get("orientation") if place.get("orientation") != null else "east")
        var row = {"id":id,"position":place.position,"base_height_steps":place.base_height_steps,
            "orientation":direction,"boundaries":[direction] if place.kind=="boundary" else [],"layer":1,"item_id":item.item_id}
        if index.doors.has(item.item_id):
            var opened: bool = item.get("is_open",false)
            var swing: String = item.door_swing if item.get("door_swing") != null else "inward"
            if item.get("integrity")=="destroyed":
                # Destruction clears collision independently of the open flag.
                # The retained pre-destruction pose selects the authored wreck.
                var remnant: Dictionary = item.remnant_state if item.get("remnant_state") != null else {}
                opened = remnant.get("door_open",opened)
                if remnant.get("door_swing") != null: swing = remnant.door_swing
                row.destroyed = true
                row.outcome = item.destruction_outcome
            row.merge({"kind":"door","asset":item.item_id,"state":"open."+swing if opened else "closed"})
        elif index.props.has(item.item_id):
            var owner = index.props[item.item_id]
            # Prop owners name the backend field and use its JSON value as the
            # bank key (for example is_open -> "false" / "true" for chests).
            var mode := "default"
            if owner.has("state_field"):
                var value = item.get(owner.state_field)
                if value != null: mode = JSON.stringify(value) if value is bool else str(value)
            row.merge({"kind":"prop","asset":item.item_id,"state":mode})
        elif index.traps.has(item.item_id):
            row.merge({"kind":"trap","asset":item.item_id,"state":"activated" if item.get("is_engaged",false) else "ready"})
        elif item.get("boundary_structure") != null:
            var structure: Dictionary = item.boundary_structure
            # Doors and fences without art of their own draw the material's wall pieces (environment source stand-ins).
            if structure.structure in ["wall","retaining_wall","door","fence"] and world.has(structure.material+"_wall_straight"):
                row.merge({"kind":"wall","material":structure.material,"top_height_steps":place.top_height_steps})
            elif structure.structure in ["cliff","embankment"]:
                row.merge({"kind":"cliff","material":structure.material,"top_height_steps":place.top_height_steps})
            else: missing.append("structure:"+item.item_id); continue
        elif world.props.has(item.item_id):
            var prop: Dictionary = world.props[item.item_id]
            var views: Dictionary = prop.body_by_pose
            if prop.has("state_field") and item.get(prop.state_field,false): views = prop.get("active_body_by_pose",views)
            row.merge({"kind":"resource","views":views,"asset":views.e})
            if prop.has("lit_animation") and item.get("is_lit") == true and senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false):
                row.lit_animation = prop.lit_animation
        else:
            missing.append("object:"+item.item_id)
            continue
        if item.get("integrity")=="destroyed" and row.kind in ["prop","wall"]:
            row.destroyed = true
            if item.get("destruction_outcome") != null: row.outcome = item.destruction_outcome
        result.append(row)
    return {"rows":result,"visual_rows":join_walls(result,world),"unresolved":missing}

static func cached_rows(state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary, retained: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # SDK after-values are immutable. Keep only this world's current records;
    # changes are still resolved through the original source adapter above.
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses") != null else {}
    var old: Dictionary = retained.get("records",{})
    var records = {}; var result: Array = []; var walls: Array = []; var missing: Array = []
    var changed = old.size()!=state.tiles.size()+state.objects.size()
    var resolved = 0
    var boundary_dirty = retained.get("object_ids",[])!=state.objects.keys() or not retained.has("boundaries")
    retained.object_ids = state.objects.keys()
    for kind in ["tiles","objects"]:
        for id in state[kind]:
            var source: Dictionary = state[kind][id]
            var key = kind+":"+id
            var sight: bool = kind=="objects" and senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
            var record: Dictionary = old.get(key,{})
            if record.is_empty() or not is_same(record.source,source) or record.sight!=sight:
                if kind=="objects" and (record.is_empty() or not is_same(record.source,source)): boundary_dirty = true
                var input = {"tiles":{},"objects":{},"senses":senses}
                input[kind][id] = source
                var derived = rows(input,cache)
                var row: Dictionary = derived.rows[0] if not derived.rows.is_empty() else {}
                if record.is_empty() or row!=record.row or derived.unresolved!=record.missing: changed = true
                # Reuse equal projections when HP/resources change without art.
                elif not row.is_empty(): row = record.row
                record = {"source":source,"sight":sight,"row":row,"missing":derived.unresolved}
                resolved += 1
            records[key] = record
            missing.append_array(record.missing)
            if record.row.is_empty(): continue
            result.append(record.row)
            if record.row.kind=="wall": walls.append(record.row)
    retained.records = records
    retained.resolved = resolved
    # Preserve insertion order too: it is the old equal-projection floor tie.
    var ids = records.keys()
    if retained.get("ids",[])!=ids: changed = true
    retained.ids = ids
    if changed or not retained.has("result"):
        if retained.get("walls",[])!=walls:
            var joined = join_walls(walls,Catalog.environment_world(cache))
            var assembly = {}
            for row in walls: assembly[row.id] = {}
            for row in joined: assembly[row.id] = row
            retained.assembly = assembly
            retained.walls = walls
        var visual: Array = []
        for row in result:
            var assembled: Dictionary = retained.get("assembly",{}).get(row.id,row)
            if not assembled.is_empty(): visual.append(assembled)
        retained.result = {"rows":result,"visual_rows":visual,"unresolved":missing}
    if boundary_dirty: retained.boundaries = boundary_index(state)
    retained.changed = changed
    return retained.result

# These indexes and result arrays belong to the publication owner. A preparation
# task may borrow them read-only until it finishes, including after cancellation.
# Patches own only changed records/cells. apply_changes is the ownership handoff;
# no presenter may mutate source rows or keep a result array as a private snapshot.
const ROW_INDEXES = ["tile_rows","object_rows","missing","wall_cells","assembly",
    "boundaries","boundary_cells","lit_candidates","negative","terrain_materials","object_ranks"]

static func projected_index(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, index: String, key: String, fallback: Variant = null) -> Variant:
    if patch.writes[index].has(key): return patch.writes[index][key]
    if patch.full or patch.removes[index].has(key): return fallback
    return base.get(index,{}).get(key,fallback)

static func projected_row(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, kind: String, id: String) -> Dictionary:
    return projected_index(base,patch,"tile_rows" if kind=="tiles" else "object_rows",id,{})

static func _write_index(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, index: String, key: String, value: Variant) -> void:
    patch.removes[index].erase(key)
    if not patch.full and base.get(index,{}).has(key) and base[index][key]==value:
        patch.writes[index].erase(key)
    else: patch.writes[index][key] = value

static func _erase_index(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, index: String, key: String) -> void:
    patch.writes[index].erase(key)
    if not patch.full and base.get(index,{}).has(key): patch.removes[index][key] = true

static func _private_cell(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, index: String, key: String, fallback: Variant) -> Variant:
    if not patch.writes[index].has(key):
        patch.writes[index][key] = projected_index(base,patch,index,key,fallback).duplicate()
        patch.removes[index].erase(key)
    return patch.writes[index][key]

static func _wall_cell(row: Dictionary) -> String:
    return JSON.stringify([row.position,row.material,row.base_height_steps,row.top_height_steps])

static func _projected_visual(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, id: String) -> Dictionary:
    var row: Dictionary = projected_index(base,patch,"object_rows",id,{})
    return projected_index(base,patch,"assembly",id,row) if not row.is_empty() else {}

static func prepare_changes(state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary, base: Dictionary, changes: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Pure projection against immutable accepted after-values and the borrowed
    # published base. The source cache is owned by this one preparation task.
    var full: bool = changes.get("full",false) or not base.has("row_slots")
    var patch = {"full":full,"writes":{},"removes":{},"order":changes.get("order",[]),
        "canonical_changes":{},"visual_changes":{},"changed_tiles":{},"changed_objects":{},
        "resolved":0,"changed":full,"rebuild_rows":full,"rebuild_visual":full,"missing_changed":full,
        "next_object_rank":0 if full else base.get("next_object_rank",0)}
    for index in ROW_INDEXES: patch.writes[index] = {}; patch.removes[index] = {}
    var tile_keys: Dictionary = changes.get("tiles",{}).duplicate()
    var object_keys: Dictionary = changes.get("objects",{}).duplicate()
    if full:
        for key in state.tiles: tile_keys[key] = true
        for id in state.objects: object_keys[id] = true
    # Order operations are an accepted mutation log, including remove/re-add
    # with an equal final row. Content equality cannot recover this fact.
    for operation in patch.order:
        if operation.kind=="tiles": tile_keys[operation.id] = true
        else: object_keys[operation.id] = true
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses")!=null else {}
    if changes.get("senses",false) and not full:
        for id in base.lit_candidates:
            if bool(base.lit_candidates[id])!=bool(senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false)):
                object_keys[id] = true
    var world: Dictionary = Catalog.environment_world(cache)
    var affected_walls = {}; var affected_boundaries = {}; var visual_objects = {}
    for key in tile_keys:
        var old: Dictionary = {} if full else base.tile_rows.get(key,{})
        var row = {}; var token: String = "tiles:"+key
        var old_missing: Array = [] if full else base.missing.get(token,[])
        var missing: Array = []

        if not old.is_empty(): _erase_index(base,patch,"terrain_materials",old.id)
        if state.tiles.has(key):

            var material: String = tile.surface.base_material
            if tile.elevation_steps<0: _write_index(base,patch,"negative",token,true)
            if world.terrain.has(material):
                row = {"id":tile.tile_uuid,"kind":"terrain","material":material,"position":tile.position,

        if not missing.is_empty(): _write_index(base,patch,"missing",token,missing)
        if old!=row:
            patch.canonical_changes[token] = row
            if not old.is_empty(): patch.visual_changes[old.id] = {}
            if not row.is_empty(): patch.visual_changes[row.id] = row
            if old.is_empty() or row.is_empty() or old.id!=row.id:
                patch.rebuild_rows = true; patch.rebuild_visual = true
        if old!=row or old_missing!=missing:
            patch.changed = true; patch.changed_tiles[key] = true
        if old_missing!=missing: patch.missing_changed = true
        patch.resolved += 1
    for id in object_keys:
        var old: Dictionary = {} if full else base.object_rows.get(id,{})
        var row = {}; var token: String = "objects:"+id
        var old_missing: Array = [] if full else base.missing.get(token,[])
        var missing: Array = []
        _erase_index(base,patch,"missing",token); _erase_index(base,patch,"negative",token)
        _erase_index(base,patch,"lit_candidates",id)
        if state.objects.has(id):
            var object: Dictionary = state.objects[id]
            var derived = rows({"tiles":{},"objects":{id:object},"senses":senses},cache)
            if not derived.rows.is_empty(): row = derived.rows[0]
            missing = derived.unresolved
            if object.placement.base_height_steps<0: _write_index(base,patch,"negative",token,true)
            if world.props.has(object.item.item_id) and world.props[object.item.item_id].has("lit_animation"):
                _write_index(base,patch,"lit_candidates",id,senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false))
            if old==row: row = old
            _write_index(base,patch,"object_rows",id,row)
            if full:
                _write_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",id,patch.next_object_rank)
                patch.next_object_rank += 1
        else:
            _erase_index(base,patch,"object_rows",id); _erase_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",id)
        if not missing.is_empty(): _write_index(base,patch,"missing",token,missing)
        if old!=row:
            patch.canonical_changes[token] = row; visual_objects[id] = true
            if old.is_empty() or row.is_empty(): patch.rebuild_rows = true
            for value in [old,row]:
                if value.get("kind")!="wall": continue
                var cell = _wall_cell(value)
                affected_walls[cell] = true
                _private_cell(base,patch,"wall_cells",cell,{}).erase(id)
            if row.get("kind")=="wall":
                _private_cell(base,patch,"wall_cells",_wall_cell(row),{})[id] = row
            _erase_index(base,patch,"assembly",id)
        if old!=row or old_missing!=missing:
            patch.changed = true; patch.changed_objects[id] = true
        if old_missing!=missing: patch.missing_changed = true
        # Incident-cell arrays are copied only when this object's membership or
        # order can affect them. No nested array in the borrowed base is edited.
        var cells: Array = _boundary_cells(state.objects[id]) if state.objects.has(id) else []
        var previous: Array = [] if full else base.boundary_cells.get(id,[])
        for cell in previous: affected_boundaries[cell] = true
        for cell in cells: affected_boundaries[cell] = true
        if cells!=previous:
            for cell in previous: _private_cell(base,patch,"boundaries",cell,[]).erase(id)
            for cell in cells: _private_cell(base,patch,"boundaries",cell,[]).append(id)
            if cells.is_empty(): _erase_index(base,patch,"boundary_cells",id)
            else: _write_index(base,patch,"boundary_cells",id,cells)
        patch.resolved += 1
    if not full:
        for operation in patch.order:
            if operation.kind!="objects": continue
            if operation.remove: _erase_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",operation.id)
            elif state.objects.has(operation.id):
                _write_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",operation.id,patch.next_object_rank)
                patch.next_object_rank += 1
    if changes.has("order_reset"):
        # Exhaustive order discovery is confined to the compatibility wrapper.
        patch.order_reset = changes.order_reset
        patch.next_object_rank = 0
        for id in patch.order_reset.objects:
            _write_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",id,patch.next_object_rank)
            patch.next_object_rank += 1
    if not patch.order.is_empty() or patch.has("order_reset"):
        patch.changed = true; patch.rebuild_rows = true; patch.rebuild_visual = true
        patch.missing_changed = true
    for cell in affected_boundaries:
        var members: Array = _private_cell(base,patch,"boundaries",cell,[])
        members.sort_custom(func(a,b):return projected_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",a,0)<projected_index(base,patch,"object_ranks",b,0))
        if members.is_empty(): _erase_index(base,patch,"boundaries",cell)
    for cell in affected_walls:
        var members: Dictionary = projected_index(base,patch,"wall_cells",cell,{})
        if not full:
            for id in base.wall_cells.get(cell,{}): visual_objects[id] = true
        if members.is_empty(): _erase_index(base,patch,"wall_cells",cell); continue
        for id in members:
            visual_objects[id] = true; _write_index(base,patch,"assembly",id,{})
        for row in join_walls(members.values(),world): _write_index(base,patch,"assembly",row.id,row)
    for id in visual_objects:
        var old: Dictionary = {} if full else base.assembly.get(id,base.object_rows.get(id,{}))
        var row: Dictionary = _projected_visual(base,patch,id)
        if old==row: continue
        patch.visual_changes[id] = row
        if old.is_empty() or row.is_empty(): patch.rebuild_visual = true
    if patch.rebuild_rows or patch.rebuild_visual or patch.missing_changed:
        _prepare_result(base,patch)
    return patch

static func _projected_order(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary, kind: String) -> Array:
    if patch.has("order_reset"): return patch.order_reset[kind]
    var index: String = "tile_rows" if kind=="tiles" else "object_rows"
    var ordered = {}
    if not patch.full:
        for id in base[index]:
            if not patch.removes[index].has(id): ordered[id] = true
    for id in patch.writes[index]: ordered[id] = true
    for operation in patch.order:
        if operation.kind!=kind: continue
        ordered.erase(operation.id)
        if not operation.remove and projected_index(base,patch,index,operation.id)!=null: ordered[operation.id] = true
    return ordered.keys()

static func _prepare_result(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary) -> void:
    # An actual membership/order change has an explicit larger preparation job.
    # Publication only installs these completed arrays and their slot indexes.
    var tile_order: Array = _projected_order(base,patch,"tiles")
    var object_order: Array = _projected_order(base,patch,"objects")
    # Keep displaced outer values until the existing candidate retirement.
    # The result shell is separate because publication edits its fields.
    patch.retired=base.duplicate()
    if base.has("result"):patch.retired.result=base.result.duplicate()
    if patch.rebuild_rows:_prepare_indexes(base,patch,tile_order,object_order)
    var result: Array = []
    if patch.rebuild_rows:
        var slots = {}
        for kind in ["tiles","objects"]:
            for id in (tile_order if kind=="tiles" else object_order):
                var row: Dictionary = projected_row(base,patch,kind,id)
                if row.is_empty(): continue
                slots[kind+":"+id] = result.size(); result.append(row)
        patch.prepared_rows = result; patch.prepared_row_slots = slots
        patch.tile_order = tile_order; patch.object_order = object_order
    if patch.rebuild_visual:
        var visual: Array = []; var slots = {}
        # Assembly-only membership changes can leave canonical row slots intact.
        for kind in ["tiles","objects"]:
            for id in (tile_order if kind=="tiles" else object_order):
                var row: Dictionary = projected_row(base,patch,kind,id) if kind=="tiles" else _projected_visual(base,patch,id)
                if row.is_empty(): continue
                slots[row.id] = visual.size(); visual.append(row)
        patch.prepared_visual = visual; patch.prepared_visual_slots = slots
    if patch.missing_changed:
        var missing: Array = []
        var has_missing: bool = not patch.writes.missing.is_empty() or (not patch.full and not base.missing.is_empty())
        if has_missing:
            for key in tile_order: missing.append_array(projected_index(base,patch,"missing","tiles:"+key,[]))
            for id in object_order: missing.append_array(projected_index(base,patch,"missing","objects:"+id,[]))
        patch.prepared_missing = missing

static func _prepare_indexes(base:Dictionary,patch:Dictionary,tile_order:Array,object_order:Array)->void:
    # Membership/order already requires a new canonical row owner. Complete
    # touched indexes here, beside those arrays, so adoption never replays the
    # accepted mutation log or inserts hundreds of records on the draw frame.
    patch.prepared_indexes={}
    var ordered:Dictionary={}
    for operation in patch.order:ordered[operation.kind]=true
    for index in ROW_INDEXES:
        var kind:String="tiles" if index=="tile_rows" else "objects" if index=="object_rows" else ""
        var reorder:bool=not kind.is_empty() and (ordered.has(kind) or patch.has("order_reset"))
        if not patch.full and patch.writes[index].is_empty() and patch.removes[index].is_empty() and not reorder:continue
        var values:Dictionary
        if not kind.is_empty():
            values={}
            for id in (tile_order if kind=="tiles" else object_order):
                # Empty rows still own canonical insertion positions and
                # missing-art metadata, even though render arrays omit them.
                values[id]=projected_row(base,patch,kind,id)
        else:
            values=patch.writes[index] if patch.full else base[index].duplicate()
            if not patch.full:
                for key in patch.removes[index]:values.erase(key)
                values.merge(patch.writes[index],true)
        patch.prepared_indexes[index]=values

static func apply_changes(base: Dictionary, patch: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Owner-only, after the borrowing task has completed. The caller validates
    # its displayed revision before this handoff; this function cannot reject.
    if patch.full:
        base.clear()
        base.result = {"rows":[],"visual_rows":[],"unresolved":[]}
        base.row_slots = {}; base.visual_slots = {}
    if patch.rebuild_rows:
        for index in patch.prepared_indexes:base[index]=patch.prepared_indexes[index]
    else:
        for index in ROW_INDEXES:
            for key in patch.removes[index]: base[index].erase(key)
            base[index].merge(patch.writes[index],true)
    if patch.rebuild_rows:
        base.result.rows = patch.prepared_rows; base.row_slots = patch.prepared_row_slots
        base.tile_order = patch.tile_order; base.object_order = patch.object_order
    else:
        for token in patch.canonical_changes: base.result.rows[base.row_slots[token]] = patch.canonical_changes[token]
    if patch.rebuild_visual:
        base.result.visual_rows = patch.prepared_visual; base.visual_slots = patch.prepared_visual_slots
    else:
        for id in patch.visual_changes: base.result.visual_rows[base.visual_slots[id]] = patch.visual_changes[id]
    if patch.missing_changed: base.result.unresolved = patch.prepared_missing
    base.next_object_rank = patch.next_object_rank
    base.changed = patch.changed; base.changed_tiles = patch.changed_tiles; base.changed_objects = patch.changed_objects
    base.resolved = patch.resolved
    return base.result

static func update_rows(state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary, retained: Dictionary, changes: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Compatibility/source-oracle entry point. Normal preparation supplies exact
    # order operations and uses prepare_changes/apply_changes at the handoff.
    changes = changes.duplicate()
    if retained.has("tile_rows") and not changes.get("full",false):
        var tile_order: Array = state.tiles.keys(); var object_order: Array = state.objects.keys()
        if retained.get("tile_order",[])!=tile_order or retained.get("object_order",[])!=object_order:
            changes.order_reset = {"tiles":tile_order,"objects":object_order}
    return apply_changes(retained,prepare_changes(state,cache,retained,changes))

static func _boundary_cells(object: Dictionary) -> Array:
    var direction: Variant = object.placement.get("boundary_direction")
    if object.item.get("supported_by_uuid")!=null or object.item.get("boundary_structure")==null or direction==null: return []
    var offset: Array = {"north":[0,1],"south":[0,-1],"east":[1,0],"west":[-1,0]}[direction]
    var position: Array = object.placement.position
    return [cell_key(position),cell_key([position[0]+offset[0],position[1]+offset[1]])]

static func boundary_index(state: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {}
    var directions = {"north":[0,1],"south":[0,-1],"east":[1,0],"west":[-1,0]}
    for id in state.get("objects",{}):
        var object: Dictionary = state.objects[id]
        var direction: Variant = object.placement.get("boundary_direction")
        if object.item.get("supported_by_uuid")!=null or object.item.get("boundary_structure")==null or direction==null: continue
        var position: Array = object.placement.position
        var delta: Array = directions[direction]
        for cell in [cell_key(position),cell_key([position[0]+delta[0],position[1]+delta[1]])]:
            if not result.has(cell): result[cell] = []
            result[cell].append(id)
    return result

static func current_ids(state: Dictionary, boundaries: Dictionary, visible_cells: Dictionary = {}, patch: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    # Sparse form of visibility(): only already-disclosed, currently observed
    # identities. Missing IDs mean remembered, never newly invented scenery.
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses")!=null else {}
    var result = {}
    visible_cells.clear()
    for position in senses.get("visible",[]):
        var cell = cell_key(position)
        visible_cells[cell] = true
        if state.tiles.has(cell): result[state.tiles[cell].tile_uuid] = true
        var incident: Array = boundaries.get(cell,[]) if patch.is_empty() else projected_index({"boundaries":boundaries},patch,"boundaries",cell,[])
        for id in incident:
            if state.objects.has(id): result[id] = true
    for id in senses.get("objects",{}):
        if state.objects.has(id) and senses.objects[id].get("visual",false): result[id] = true
    return result

static func join_walls(rows: Array, world: Dictionary) -> Array:
    # One authored corner can depict two backend edges. Keep the original rows
    # intact for commands; this is only grid-to-art assembly at world revisions.
    var cells = {}
    for row in rows:
        # A corner is one intact source. A destroyed edge must retain its own
        # authored endpoint instead of borrowing the other edge's state.
        if row.kind != "wall" or row.get("destroyed",false): continue
        var key = JSON.stringify([row.position,row.material,row.base_height_steps,row.top_height_steps])
        if not cells.has(key): cells[key] = []
        cells[key].append(row)
    var corners = {}
    var joined = {}
    for members in cells.values():
        if members.size()!=2: continue
        members.sort_custom(func(a,b):return a.id<b.id)
        var a: Dictionary = members[0]
        var b: Dictionary = members[1]
        if not world.has(a.material+"_wall_corner"): continue
        for faces in world.wall_corner_faces.values():
            if not (a.orientation in faces and b.orientation in faces) or a.orientation==b.orientation: continue
            var corner: Dictionary = a.duplicate(true)
            corner.boundaries = faces.duplicate()
            corner.wall_members = members.duplicate(true)
            corners[a.id] = corner
            joined[b.id] = true
            break
    var visual: Array = []
    for row in rows:
        if not joined.has(row.id): visual.append(corners.get(row.id,row))
    return visual

static func visible_actor(actor: Dictionary, state: Dictionary, staged: bool = false) -> bool:
    if not actor.get("present",true) or actor.get("last_visual_position") == null \
        or actor.get("spatial_disposition","present")!="present" \
        or actor.get("remains_disposition","intact")=="disintegrated": return false
    var senses: Variant = state.get("senses")
    var contact: Dictionary = senses.entities.get(actor.uuid,{}) if senses != null else {}
    # The server retires Dead actors from living-creature sensory contacts.
    # Like the original scene adapter, retain their witnessed corpse pose at
    # the disclosed last position; never retain an unseen living actor.
    return staged or actor.uuid in state.audience.controlled or contact.get("visual",false) or actor.get("life_state")=="dead"

static func visibility(state: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Current sight is separate from the last-observed map. Never grow the map
    # from `seen`, a light radius, or an object's remembered activation state.
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses") != null else {}
    var visible = {}
    for position in senses.get("visible",[]): visible[cell_key(position)] = true
    var result = {}
    for tile in state.get("tiles",{}).values():
        result[tile.tile_uuid] = visible.has(cell_key(tile.position))
    var directions = {"north":[0,1],"south":[0,-1],"east":[1,0],"west":[-1,0]}
    for id in state.get("objects",{}):
        var object: Dictionary = state.objects[id]
        var current: bool = senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
        var direction: Variant = object.placement.get("boundary_direction")
        # Native boundary disclosure also observes either incident support.
        # An inserted object needs its own sight grant, as in the projector.
        if not current and object.item.get("supported_by_uuid") == null and object.item.get("boundary_structure") != null and direction != null:
            var position: Array = object.placement.position
            var delta: Array = directions[direction]
            current = visible.has(cell_key(position)) or visible.has(cell_key([position[0]+delta[0],position[1]+delta[1]]))
        result[id] = current
    return result

static func ground_background(state: Dictionary, staged: Dictionary = {}) -> bool:
    # A base-zero floor is a single background band only while nothing can be
    # painted below it. Remembered lower supports are still part of the map.
    for tile in state.get("tiles",{}).values():
        if tile.elevation_steps < 0: return false
    for object in state.get("objects",{}).values():
        if object.placement.get("base_height_steps",0) < 0: return false
    var actors: Dictionary = state.get("actors",{}).duplicate()
    actors.merge(staged,true)
    for id in actors:
        var actor: Dictionary = actors[id]
        if not visible_actor(actor,state,staged.has(id)): continue
        var tile: Dictionary = state.get("tiles",{}).get(cell_key(actor.last_visual_position),{})
        if tile.get("elevation_steps",0) < 0: return false
    return true
```


### A.9 — `sdk/audience.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:sdk/audience.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Public sensory after-values only. No native visibility or light calculation.

const OPTIONAL_EFFECT_FIELDS = ["anchor_position", "anchor_elevation_steps", "anchor_entity_uuid", "anchor_item_uuid", "sustainer_item_uuid", "concentration_slot_uuid", "area_geometry"]
const EFFECT_COLLECTIONS = ["positions", "visible_volume_positions", "upper_volume_surfaces", "suppressions", "construction_sections"]

static func success(value: Variant) -> Dictionary:
    return {"ok": true, "value": value}

static func failure(message: String) -> Dictionary:
    return {"ok": false, "error": {"kind": "reducer", "message": message}}

static func point_key(point: Array) -> String:
    return "%d,%d" % [point[0], point[1]]

static func parse_cell_key(key: String) -> Dictionary:
    var cell: Array = _wire_cell(key, {})
    return success(cell[0]) if not cell.is_empty() else failure("Sensory cell key requires two integer coordinates")

# One parse per wire cell key and event: [point key, [x, y]], or [] unless the
# key is two (edge-trimmed) integers. Light and hazard maps usually share every
# key and the composed view reuses the same parse. A canonical spelling is
# already its own point key; any other accepted spelling is reformatted.
static func _wire_cell(key: String, parsed: Dictionary) -> Array:
    var cell: Variant = parsed.get(key)
    if cell != null: return cell
    var fields: PackedStringArray = key.split(",")
    var result: Array = []
    if fields.size() == 2 and (fields[0].is_valid_int() or fields[0].strip_edges().is_valid_int()) \
            and (fields[1].is_valid_int() or fields[1].strip_edges().is_valid_int()):
        var x: int = int(fields[0])
        var y: int = int(fields[1])
        var canonical: bool = fields[0].length() <= 10 and fields[1].length() <= 10 and str(x) == fields[0] and str(y) == fields[1]
        result = [key if canonical else point_key([x, y]), [x, y]]
    parsed[key] = result
    return result

# The current producer spells every cell key canonically: "x,y" with no sign,
# padding or leading zero. One native scan proves that for a whole map (each
# such key is its own point key). Small maps keep the per-key parse.
const NONCANONICAL_CELL = "(*LF)(?m)^(?!(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,8}),(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$)"

static func _canonical_cells(cells: Dictionary) -> bool:
    if cells.size() < 16: return false
    var keys: Array = cells.keys()
    for key in keys:
        if typeof(key) != TYPE_STRING: return false
    # A trailing canonical line keeps the last key an internal, checked line.
    var text: String = "\n".join(PackedStringArray(keys)) + "\n0,0"
    return text.count("\n") == keys.size() and RegEx.create_from_string(NONCANONICAL_CELL).search(text) == null

# Two exact integers: point_key and its integer parse round-trip this point.
static func _integer_cell(point: Variant) -> bool:
    return point is Array and point.size() == 2 and typeof(point[0]) == TYPE_INT and typeof(point[1]) == TYPE_INT \
        and absi(point[0]) < 1000000000000000 and absi(point[1]) < 1000000000000000

static func compare(a: Variant, b: Variant) -> int:
    if a is Array and b is Array:
        for i in range(mini(a.size(), b.size())):
            var order = compare(a[i], b[i])
            if order != 0: return order
        return -1 if a.size() < b.size() else (1 if a.size() > b.size() else 0)
    if a == b: return 0
    return -1 if a < b else 1

static func points_union(first: Array, second: Array) -> Array:
    # Admitted points contain two integers. Sort numeric axes natively instead
    # of calling the recursive Variant comparator for every pair of points.
    # Keep full wire precision and the last input point at each coordinate.
    var columns = {}
    for collection in [first, second]:
        for point in collection:
            if not columns.has(point[0]): columns[point[0]] = {}
            columns[point[0]][point[1]] = point
    var xs: Array = columns.keys()
    xs.sort()
    var result: Array = []
    for x in xs:
        var column: Dictionary = columns[x]
        var ys: Array = column.keys()
        ys.sort()
        for y in ys: result.append(column[y])
    return result

static func modes_signature(modes: Array) -> String:
    # Python's randomized hash is an implementation cache, not wire identity.
    var signature: Array = []
    for mode in modes: signature.append([mode.sense_type, int(mode.range_feet)])
    signature.sort_custom(func(a, b): return compare(a, b) < 0)
    return JSON.stringify(signature)

static func resolve(observer: String, supplied: Variant) -> Dictionary:
    if supplied == null:
        return success({"controlled": [observer], "observers": [observer], "revision": 0})
    var observers = {}
    var controlled = {}
    for identity in supplied.observers: observers[identity] = true
    for identity in supplied.controlled: controlled[identity] = true
    if supplied.observers.is_empty() or observers.size() != supplied.observers.size() or controlled.size() != supplied.controlled.size() or supplied.revision < 0:
        return failure("Audience requires unique observers/controlled actors and a nonnegative revision")
    if observer not in supplied.observers:
        return failure("The stream observer must belong to its audience")
    return success(supplied.duplicate(true))

static func reduce_senses(expected_observer: String, previous: Variant, event: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result = _reduce_senses_retained(expected_observer, previous, event)
    if result.ok: result.value = result.value.duplicate(true)
    result.erase("wire_cells")
    return result

# Internal folds retain immutable prior leaves. Public value-in/value-out helpers
# above/below detach their result; the reducer already owns its transaction copy.
static func _reduce_senses_retained(expected_observer: String, previous: Variant, event: Dictionary, cells: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    if event.observer_uuid != expected_observer:
        return failure("sensory update belongs to a different observer")
    if event.initial:
        if event.passive_perception == null or event.visual_access == null:
            return failure("initial sensory update requires capability after-values")
        previous = {"position": event.observer_position.duplicate(), "visible": [], "seen": [],
            "entities": {}, "objects": {}, "effective_light_levels": {}, "paths_dirty": false,
            "passive_perception": event.passive_perception, "sense_modes_hash": "[]",
            "sense_modes": [], "visual_access": event.visual_access, "hazardous_cells": {}, "spatial_effects": {}}
    if previous == null:
        return failure("sensory delta requires a previously recorded initial state")
    # Reject invalid after-values before changing the fold-local coordinate
    # lookups. A caller retry must not inherit part of a rejected observation.
    var lights = {}
    var hazards = {}
    var wire_cells = {}
    # A canonically keyed map already is its own point-keyed map (only read
    # and merged below); others are parsed and validated key by key.
    if _canonical_cells(event.effective_light_levels_changed):
        for light in event.effective_light_levels_changed.values():
            if light < 0 or light > 4 or float(light) != floor(float(light)):
                return failure("Unknown recorded light level")
        lights = event.effective_light_levels_changed
    else:
        for key in event.effective_light_levels_changed:
            var cell: Array = _wire_cell(key, wire_cells)
            if cell.is_empty(): return failure("Sensory cell key requires two integer coordinates")
            var light = event.effective_light_levels_changed[key]
            if light < 0 or light > 4 or float(light) != floor(float(light)):
                return failure("Unknown recorded light level")
            lights[cell[0]] = light
    if _canonical_cells(event.hazardous_cells_changed): hazards = event.hazardous_cells_changed
    else:
        for key in event.hazardous_cells_changed:
            var cell: Array = _wire_cell(key, wire_cells)
            if cell.is_empty(): return failure("Sensory cell key requires two integer coordinates")
            hazards[cell[0]] = event.hazardous_cells_changed[key]
    var indexed = _member_cells(previous, expected_observer, cells)
    var result: Dictionary = previous.duplicate()
    # Retained member leaves are immutable. Detach a collection only when this
    # event edits it; public reduce_senses/observe still deep-detach their result.
    for fields in [["entities","entity_contacts_changed","entity_contacts_removed"],
            ["objects","object_contacts_changed","object_contacts_removed"],
            ["spatial_effects","spatial_effects_changed","spatial_effects_removed"]]:
        if not event[fields[1]].is_empty() or not event[fields[2]].is_empty():
            result[fields[0]] = previous[fields[0]].duplicate()
    if not lights.is_empty() or not event.visible_cells_removed.is_empty():
        result.effective_light_levels = previous.effective_light_levels.duplicate()
    if not hazards.is_empty() or not event.visible_cells_removed.is_empty():
        result.hazardous_cells = previous.hazardous_cells.duplicate()
    # Presence distinguishes current authoritative emptiness from an archived
    # protocol that never supplied optical source observations.
    if previous.has("light_sources") or event.has("light_sources_changed") or event.has("light_sources_removed"):
        result.light_sources = previous.get("light_sources", {})
        result.light_source_removals = previous.get("light_source_removals", {})
        if not event.get("light_sources_changed", {}).is_empty() or not event.get("light_sources_removed", {}).is_empty():
            result.light_sources = result.light_sources.duplicate()
            result.light_source_removals = result.light_source_removals.duplicate()
        for identity in event.get("light_sources_removed", {}):
            result.light_sources.erase(identity)
            result.light_source_removals[identity] = event.light_sources_removed[identity]
        for identity in event.get("light_sources_changed", {}):
            result.light_sources[identity] = event.light_sources_changed[identity].duplicate(true)
            result.light_source_removals.erase(identity)
    for point in event.visible_cells_removed:
        var key = point_key(point)
        result.effective_light_levels.erase(key)
        result.hazardous_cells.erase(key)
    result.visible = _update_cells(indexed.visible, event.visible_cells_added, event.visible_cells_removed)
    result.seen = _update_cells(indexed.seen, event.seen_cells_added, [])
    for identity in event.entity_contacts_removed: result.entities.erase(identity)
    if not event.entity_contacts_changed.is_empty():result.entities.merge(event.entity_contacts_changed.duplicate(true), true)
    for identity in event.object_contacts_removed: result.objects.erase(identity)
    if not event.object_contacts_changed.is_empty():result.objects.merge(event.object_contacts_changed.duplicate(true), true)
    for identity in event.spatial_effects_removed: result.spatial_effects.erase(identity)
    if not event.spatial_effects_changed.is_empty():result.spatial_effects.merge(event.spatial_effects_changed.duplicate(true), true)
    if not lights.is_empty():result.effective_light_levels.merge(lights,true)
    if not hazards.is_empty():result.hazardous_cells.merge(hazards,true)
    if event.sense_modes_changed and event.sense_modes != null:
        result.sense_modes = event.sense_modes.duplicate(true)
        result.sense_modes_hash = modes_signature(result.sense_modes)
    if event.observer_position_changed: result.position = event.observer_position.duplicate()
    if event.passive_perception_changed and event.passive_perception != null:
        result.passive_perception = event.passive_perception
    if event.visual_access_changed and event.visual_access != null:
        result.visual_access = event.visual_access
    result.paths_dirty = previous.paths_dirty or event.paths_dirty
    indexed.source = result
    var reduced: Dictionary = success(result)
    reduced.wire_cells = wire_cells
    return reduced

static func observe(previous: Dictionary, audience: Dictionary, event: Dictionary, cursor: int) -> Dictionary:
    var result = _observe_retained(previous, audience, event, cursor)
    if result.ok: result.value = result.value.duplicate(true)
    result.erase("wire_cells")
    return result

static func _observe_retained(previous: Dictionary, audience: Dictionary, event: Dictionary, cursor: int, cells: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    if event.observer_uuid not in audience.observers:
        return failure("Sensory observation does not belong to this audience")
    var reduced = _reduce_senses_retained(event.observer_uuid, previous.members.get(event.observer_uuid), event, cells)
    if not reduced.ok: return reduced
    var result: Dictionary = previous.duplicate()
    for field in ["members", "contact_cursors", "effect_cursors", "effect_absences"]:
        result[field] = previous[field].duplicate()
    result.members[event.observer_uuid] = reduced.value
    var current: Dictionary = reduced.value
    var visible_cells: Dictionary = _member_cells(current,event.observer_uuid,cells).visible
    var before: Variant = previous.members.get(event.observer_uuid)
    for identity in event.entity_contacts_changed:
        result.contact_cursors[event.observer_uuid + "," + identity] = cursor
    for identity in event.object_contacts_changed:
        result.contact_cursors[event.observer_uuid + "," + identity] = cursor
    for identity in event.spatial_effects_changed:
        var observed: Dictionary = event.spatial_effects_changed[identity]
        var witnessed = not observed.visible_volume_positions.is_empty() or not observed.upper_volume_surfaces.is_empty()
        for point in observed.positions:
            if _has_cell(visible_cells,point): witnessed = true; break
        if witnessed: result.effect_cursors[event.observer_uuid + "," + identity] = cursor
    var known = {}
    var snapshots: Array = previous.members.values()
    snapshots.append(current)
    for senses in snapshots:
        for identity in senses.spatial_effects:
            known[identity] = points_union(known.get(identity, []), senses.spatial_effects[identity].positions)
    for identity in known:
        var observed: Variant = current.spatial_effects.get(identity)
        var present: Array = observed.positions if observed != null else []
        for point in known[identity]:
            if not _has_cell(visible_cells,point): continue
            var key: String = identity + "," + point_key(point)
            if result.effect_absences.get(key, -1) > cursor: continue
            if point in present:
                result.effect_absences.erase(key)
            else:
                var prior: Variant = before.spatial_effects.get(identity) if before != null else null
                var apparent = false
                for senses in previous.members.values():
                    if senses.spatial_effects.has(identity) and senses.spatial_effects[identity].apparent_presence:
                        apparent = true; break
                if apparent or (prior != null and point in prior.positions):
                    result.effect_absences[key] = cursor
    var observed_result: Dictionary = success(result)
    observed_result.wire_cells = reduced.wire_cells
    return observed_result

static func contacts(perception: Dictionary, objects: bool) -> Dictionary:
    return _contacts_retained(perception, objects).duplicate(true)

static func _contacts_retained(perception: Dictionary, objects: bool) -> Dictionary:
    var selected = {}
    var ranks = {}
    for observer in perception.members:
        var values: Dictionary = perception.members[observer].objects if objects else perception.members[observer].entities
        for identity in values:
            var contact: Dictionary = values[identity]
            var rank = [1 if contact.visual else 0, perception.contact_cursors.get(observer + "," + identity, -1)]
            if not ranks.has(identity) or compare(rank, ranks[identity].rank) > 0 or (rank == ranks[identity].rank and observer < ranks[identity].observer):
                ranks[identity] = {"rank": rank, "observer": observer}
                selected[identity] = contact
    return selected

# Only sensory updates change object contacts in a composed view. Re-evaluate
# changed identities across observers, retaining the original full-walk key order.
# Entity contacts remain exhaustive because spatial/observation facts edit them.
static func _object_contacts_after(perception: Dictionary, previous: Dictionary, event: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var changed: Dictionary = event.object_contacts_changed.duplicate()
    for identity in event.object_contacts_removed: changed[identity] = true
    # Entity and object observations share the observer/identity cursor table.
    # An overlapping identity can therefore change an object's winner too.
    for identity in event.entity_contacts_changed:
        if previous.has(identity): changed[identity] = true
    if changed.is_empty(): return previous
    var selected: Dictionary = previous.duplicate()
    for identity in changed:
        var winner: Variant = null
        var best_visual = -1
        var best_cursor = -1
        var best_observer = ""
        for observer in perception.members:
            var contact: Variant = perception.members[observer].objects.get(identity)
            if contact == null: continue
            var visual = 1 if contact.visual else 0
            var cursor: int = perception.contact_cursors.get(observer + "," + identity, -1)
            if winner == null or visual > best_visual or (visual == best_visual and (cursor > best_cursor or (cursor == best_cursor and observer < best_observer))):
                winner = contact; best_visual = visual; best_cursor = cursor; best_observer = observer
        if winner == null: selected.erase(identity)
        else: selected[identity] = winner
    var result = {}
    for observer in perception.members:
        for identity in perception.members[observer].objects:
            if not result.has(identity): result[identity] = selected[identity]
    return result

static func join_effect(first: Dictionary, second: Dictionary) -> Variant:
    if first.owner_revision == null or first.owner_revision != second.owner_revision: return null
    var left: Dictionary = first.duplicate(true)
    var right: Dictionary = second.duplicate(true)
    for key in EFFECT_COLLECTIONS + OPTIONAL_EFFECT_FIELDS: left.erase(key); right.erase(key)
    if left != right: return null
    var result: Dictionary = first.duplicate(true)
    for key in OPTIONAL_EFFECT_FIELDS:
        if first[key] != null and second[key] != null and first[key] != second[key]: return null
        result[key] = first[key] if first[key] != null else second[key]
    var protections = {}
    for row in first.suppressions: protections[row.provider_uuid] = row.duplicate(true)
    for row in second.suppressions:
        var prior: Variant = protections.get(row.provider_uuid)
        if prior != null:
            left = prior.duplicate(true); right = row.duplicate(true)
            left.erase("positions"); right.erase("positions")
            if left != right: return null
        var combined: Dictionary = row.duplicate(true)
        combined.positions = points_union(row.positions, prior.positions if prior != null else [])
        protections[row.provider_uuid] = combined
    var ids: Array = protections.keys()
    ids.sort()
    result.suppressions = []
    for identity in ids: result.suppressions.append(protections[identity])
    var upper = {}
    for row in first.upper_volume_surfaces + second.upper_volume_surfaces:
        upper[JSON.stringify([row.position, row.lower_height_planes])] = row
    result.upper_volume_surfaces = upper.values()
    result.upper_volume_surfaces.sort_custom(func(a, b): return compare([a.position, a.lower_height_planes], [b.position, b.lower_height_planes]) < 0)
    result.construction_sections = first.construction_sections.duplicate(true)
    for section in second.construction_sections:
        if section not in result.construction_sections: result.construction_sections.append(section.duplicate(true))
    result.positions = points_union(first.positions, second.positions)
    result.visible_volume_positions = points_union(first.visible_volume_positions, second.visible_volume_positions)
    return result

static func effects(perception: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var selected = {}
    var ranks = {}
    for observer in perception.members:
        for identity in perception.members[observer].spatial_effects:
            var observed: Dictionary = perception.members[observer].spatial_effects[identity]
            var rank = [observed.owner_revision if observed.owner_revision != null else -1, perception.effect_cursors.get(observer + "," + identity, -1)]
            if not ranks.has(identity) or compare(rank, ranks[identity].rank) > 0 or (rank == ranks[identity].rank and observer < ranks[identity].observer):
                ranks[identity] = {"rank": rank, "observer": observer}
                selected[identity] = observed
    var observers: Array = perception.members.keys()
    observers.sort()
    var result = {}
    for identity in selected:
        var merged: Dictionary = selected[identity].duplicate(true)
        for observer in observers:
            var row: Variant = perception.members[observer].spatial_effects.get(identity)
            if row != null:
                var joined: Variant = join_effect(merged, row)
                if joined != null: merged = joined
        var positions: Array = []
        for point in merged.positions:
            if not perception.effect_absences.has(identity + "," + point_key(point)): positions.append(point)
        if not positions.is_empty() or not merged.visible_volume_positions.is_empty() or not merged.upper_volume_surfaces.is_empty():
            merged.positions = points_union([], positions)
            result[identity] = merged
    return result

static func tile_observers(perception: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var owners: Dictionary = _tile_owners(perception)
    var selected = {}
    for key in owners: selected[key] = owners[key][0]
    return selected

# The owning observer of each visible cell key, with one admitted point there.
static func _tile_owners(perception: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var selected = {}
    var observers: Array = perception.members.keys()
    observers.sort()
    for observer in observers:
        var senses: Dictionary = perception.members[observer]
        for point in senses.visible:
            var key = point_key(point)
            var previous: Variant = selected.get(key)
            if previous == null: selected[key] = [observer, point]
            elif senses.effective_light_levels.get(key, 1) > perception.members[previous[0]].effective_light_levels.get(key, 1):
                previous[0] = observer
    return selected

static func view(perception: Dictionary, observer: String) -> Variant:
    var result: Variant = _view_retained(perception, observer)
    return result.duplicate(true) if result != null else null

static func _light_sources_retained(perception: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var revisions = {}
    var supplied = false
    for member in perception.members.values():
        supplied = supplied or member.has("light_sources") or member.has("light_source_removals")
        for identity in member.get("light_source_removals", {}):
            revisions[identity] = maxi(revisions.get(identity, -1), member.light_source_removals[identity])
        for identity in member.get("light_sources", {}):
            revisions[identity] = maxi(revisions.get(identity, -1), member.light_sources[identity].revision)
    if not supplied: return {}
    var sources = {}
    var observers: Array = perception.members.keys()
    observers.sort()
    for observer in observers:
        for identity in perception.members[observer].get("light_sources", {}):
            var source: Dictionary = perception.members[observer].light_sources[identity]
            if source.revision != revisions[identity]: continue
            if not sources.has(identity):
                sources[identity] = source
            else:
                var merged: Dictionary = sources[identity].duplicate()
                # Live descriptors carry no cell map. Only archived nonempty
                # footprints need the historical equal-revision union.
                if not source.get("affected_tiles", {}).is_empty():
                    merged.affected_tiles = merged.get("affected_tiles", {}).duplicate()
                    merged.affected_tiles.merge(source.affected_tiles, true)
                for field in ["anchor_entity_uuid", "anchor_item_uuid"]:
                    if merged.get(field) == null: merged[field] = source.get(field)
                sources[identity] = merged
    var removals = {}
    for identity in revisions:
        if not sources.has(identity): removals[identity] = revisions[identity]
    return {"light_sources":sources, "light_source_removals":removals}

static func _view_retained(perception: Dictionary, observer: String) -> Variant:
    if perception.members.is_empty(): return null
    var anchor: Dictionary = perception.members.get(observer, perception.members.values()[0])
    var owners: Dictionary = _tile_owners(perception)
    var result: Dictionary = anchor.duplicate()
    result.visible = []; result.seen = []; result.effective_light_levels = {}; result.hazardous_cells = {}
    result.paths_dirty = false
    for key in owners:
        var owner: Array = owners[key]
        # An admitted integer point already is the cell its key names; only
        # another spelling round-trips through the key's integers.
        var point: Array = owner[1]
        if _integer_cell(point): result.visible.append(point)
        else:
            var components = key.split(",")
            result.visible.append([int(components[0]), int(components[1])])
        var member: Dictionary = perception.members[owner[0]]
        if member.effective_light_levels.has(key): result.effective_light_levels[key] = member.effective_light_levels[key]
        if member.hazardous_cells.has(key): result.hazardous_cells[key] = member.hazardous_cells[key]
    result.visible = points_union([], result.visible)
    for member in perception.members.values():
        result.seen = points_union(result.seen, member.seen)
        result.paths_dirty = result.paths_dirty or member.paths_dirty
    result.entities = _contacts_retained(perception, false)
    result.objects = _contacts_retained(perception, true)
    result.spatial_effects = effects(perception)
    result.merge(_light_sources_retained(perception), true)
    return result

# Only an owned event fold that already composed a sensory view may reuse these
# cell collections. Initial observer resets still recompute the full union.
# Contacts/effects stay exhaustive; observations/spatial facts may alter them.
static func _view_after(perception: Dictionary, observer: String, previous: Variant, event: Dictionary, cells: Dictionary = {}, retained:bool=false, wire_cells:Dictionary={}) -> Variant:
    if previous == null or event.initial or perception.members.is_empty():
        return _view_retained(perception, observer)
    var anchor: Dictionary = perception.members.get(observer, perception.members.values()[0])
    var result: Dictionary = anchor.duplicate()
    result.effective_light_levels = previous.effective_light_levels
    result.hazardous_cells = previous.hazardous_cells
    # The member fold already owns sorted, deduplicated cell collections.
    # A retained one-member view has no union/winner work to repeat. Its raw
    # light maps still pass through the visible-key projection below.
    var direct:bool=retained and perception.members.size()==1
    var composed:Dictionary={}
    if not direct:
        composed=cells.get("view",{})
        if composed.is_empty() or not is_same(composed.source,previous):
            composed = _indexed_senses(previous)
            cells.view = composed
    var affected = {}
    for point in event.visible_cells_added + event.visible_cells_removed:
        affected[point_key(point)] = point
    # The member fold already validated these wire keys. A key that already
    # holds an integer point (usually a cell disclosed above) names that cell.
    for field in ["effective_light_levels_changed", "hazardous_cells_changed"]:
        for key in event[field]:
            if _integer_cell(affected.get(key)): continue
            var cell: Array = _wire_cell(key, wire_cells)
            affected[cell[0]] = cell[1]
    if not affected.is_empty():
        result.effective_light_levels = result.effective_light_levels.duplicate()
        result.hazardous_cells = result.hazardous_cells.duplicate()
    var observers: Array = perception.members.keys()
    observers.sort()
    # Sorted observer members and their visible columns, looked up once.
    var members: Array = []
    var columns: Array = []
    for identity in observers:
        members.append(perception.members[identity])
        columns.append(_member_cells(perception.members[identity],identity,cells).visible.columns)
    var added: Array = []
    var removed: Array = []
    for key in affected:
        var point: Array = affected[key]
        var owner: Variant = null
        var brightness: Variant = null
        for index in members.size():
            var column: Variant = columns[index].get(point[0])
            if column == null or not column.has(point[1]): continue
            var level: Variant = members[index].effective_light_levels.get(key, 1)
            if owner == null or level > brightness:
                owner = index
                brightness = level
        result.effective_light_levels.erase(key)
        result.hazardous_cells.erase(key)
        if owner == null:
            if not direct and _has_cell(composed.visible,point): removed.append(point)
        else:
            if not direct and not _has_cell(composed.visible,point): added.append(point)
            var member: Dictionary = members[owner]
            if member.effective_light_levels.has(key): result.effective_light_levels[key] = member.effective_light_levels[key]
            if member.hazardous_cells.has(key): result.hazardous_cells[key] = member.hazardous_cells[key]
    if direct:
        result.visible=anchor.visible;result.seen=anchor.seen
        # This is the transaction's forked context. A future multi-member
        # projection builds its own composed index from its actual prior view.
        cells.erase("view")
    else:
        result.visible = _update_cells(composed.visible, added, removed)
        result.seen = _update_cells(composed.seen, event.seen_cells_added, [])
    result.paths_dirty = false
    for member in perception.members.values(): result.paths_dirty = result.paths_dirty or member.paths_dirty
    result.entities=anchor.entities if direct else _contacts_retained(perception,false)
    result.objects=anchor.objects if direct else _object_contacts_after(perception,previous.objects,event)
    # These independent operands only change through their disclosed after-
    # values (or a member reset). Contact-only events do not merge every optical
    # source again, and effects need recomposition only when their witness set
    # or their actual disclosed values can have changed.
    var effects_changed:bool=not event.spatial_effects_changed.is_empty() or not event.spatial_effects_removed.is_empty() \
        or not event.visible_cells_added.is_empty() or not event.visible_cells_removed.is_empty()
    result.spatial_effects=effects(perception) if effects_changed else previous.spatial_effects
    var optical_changed:bool=not event.get("light_sources_changed",{}).is_empty() or not event.get("light_sources_removed",{}).is_empty()
    if not optical_changed and previous.has("light_sources"):
        result.light_sources=previous.light_sources
        result.light_source_removals=previous.get("light_source_removals",{})
    else:result.merge(_light_sources_retained(perception),true)
    if not direct:composed.source=result
    return result

# Journal's last committed indexes are immutable. A candidate owns index shells
# and outer maps; only x-columns actually changed by its events are copied.
static func _fork_cells(previous: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {"members":{}, "composed":previous.get("composed",false)}
    for observer in previous.get("members",{}):
        result.members[observer] = _fork_indexed_senses(previous.members[observer])
    if previous.has("view"): result.view = _fork_indexed_senses(previous.view)
    return result

static func _fork_indexed_senses(previous: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return {"source":previous.source, "visible":_fork_cell_index(previous.visible),
        "seen":_fork_cell_index(previous.seen)}

static func _fork_cell_index(previous: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return {"columns":previous.columns.duplicate(), "ordered":previous.ordered, "private_columns":{}}

static func _own_column(indexed: Dictionary, x: int) -> void:
    if not indexed.has("private_columns") or indexed.private_columns.has(x): return
    if indexed.columns.has(x): indexed.columns[x] = indexed.columns[x].duplicate()
    indexed.private_columns[x] = true

static func _member_cells(senses: Dictionary, observer: String, cells: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not cells.has("members"): cells.members = {}
    var indexed: Dictionary = cells.members.get(observer,{})
    if indexed.is_empty() or not is_same(indexed.source,senses):
        indexed = _indexed_senses(senses)
        cells.members[observer] = indexed
    return indexed

static func _indexed_senses(senses: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return {"source":senses,"visible":_cell_index(senses.visible),"seen":_cell_index(senses.seen)}

static func _cell_index(points: Array) -> Dictionary:
    var columns = {}
    for point in points:
        if not columns.has(point[0]): columns[point[0]] = {}
        columns[point[0]][point[1]] = point
    return {"columns":columns,"ordered":_ordered_cells(columns)}

static func _has_cell(indexed: Dictionary, point: Array) -> bool:
    return indexed.columns.has(point[0]) and indexed.columns[point[0]].has(point[1])

static func _cell_lower_bound(points: Array, point: Array) -> int:
    var first = 0
    var last = points.size()
    while first < last:
        var middle: int = (first + last) >> 1
        var candidate: Array = points[middle]
        if candidate[0] < point[0] or (candidate[0] == point[0] and candidate[1] < point[1]):
            first = middle + 1
        else:
            last = middle
    return first
```
