```gdscript
static func _update_cells(indexed: Dictionary, added: Array, removed: Array) -> Array:
    var changed = false
    var columns: Dictionary = indexed.columns
    var ordered: Array = indexed.ordered
    var incremental: bool = (added.size() + removed.size()) * 8 < ordered.size()
    for point in removed:
        if not _has_cell(indexed,point): continue
        if incremental:
            if not changed: ordered = ordered.duplicate()
            ordered.remove_at(_cell_lower_bound(ordered,point))
        changed = true
        _own_column(indexed,point[0])
        columns[point[0]].erase(point[1])
        if columns[point[0]].is_empty(): columns.erase(point[0])
    # Bulk discoveries (a door, a first step) add hundreds of cells: the
    # membership test and column ownership are inlined below.
    var private: Variant = indexed.get("private_columns")
    for point in added:
        var x: Variant = point[0]
        var column: Variant = columns.get(x)
        if column != null and column.has(point[1]): continue
        if incremental and not changed: ordered = ordered.duplicate()
        changed = true
        if private != null and not private.has(x):
            if column != null:
                column = column.duplicate()
                columns[x] = column
            private[x] = true
        if column == null:
            column = {}
            columns[x] = column
        var owned: Array = point.duplicate()
        column[point[1]] = owned
        if incremental: ordered.insert(_cell_lower_bound(ordered,owned),owned)
    # Published arrays stay immutable. Small deltas use native array moves and
    # exact integer comparisons instead of rebuilding/sorting every known cell.
    if changed: indexed.ordered = ordered if incremental else _ordered_cells(columns)
    return indexed.ordered

static func _ordered_cells(columns: Dictionary) -> Array:
    var xs: Array = columns.keys()
    xs.sort()
    var result: Array = []
    for x in xs:
        var column: Dictionary = columns[x]
        var ys: Array = column.keys()
        ys.sort()
        for y in ys: result.append(column[y])
    return result
```


### A.10 — `sdk/journal.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:sdk/journal.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Worker-owned raw journal. Durable record first, atomic reducer publication next.
const Protocol = preload("res://sdk/protocol.gd")
const Reducer = preload("res://sdk/reducer.gd")
var protocol := Protocol.new()
var directory := ""
var state: Dictionary = {}
var cursor: Dictionary = {}
# Derived sensory indexes belong to this exact committed state. Candidate
# reductions fork them; failed folds/writes never publish their replacements.
var _sensory_context: Dictionary = {}
# Optional payload-free timing for the transport owner; no work history retained.
var profile_enabled := false
var last_profile: Dictionary = {}
# A historical reader opened without replay: open() already parsed packet 0
# to select its protocol. decode_record() admits that parse instead of a second.
var _opened_initialization: Array = []

func open(path: String, historical_recording: bool = false, replay_existing: bool = true) -> Dictionary:
	if not directory.is_empty(): return _failure("Journal already opened")
	var code := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(path)
	if code != OK: return _failure("Cannot create journal: " + error_string(code))
	directory = path
	# Explicit offline-only compatibility. Never change packet identities or
	# let a live connection silently accept a different protocol.
	if historical_recording and FileAccess.file_exists(_file(0)):
		var raw := FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(_file(0))
		var first := Protocol.parse_json(raw)
		if not first.ok: return first
		if not first.value is Dictionary: return _failure("Invalid recording initialization")
		if not protocol.check_identity(first.value.get("protocol",{})).ok:
			var matched := false
			for version in ["pre-optical-sources", "pre-compact-choices", "pre-tile-fields", "pre-source-lighting", "pre-container-loot"]:
				var base: String = "res://sdk/recordings/" + str(version) + "/"
				var archived := Protocol.new(base + "player-api-v1.schema.json", base + "protocol-identity.json")
				if archived.check_identity(first.value.get("protocol",{})).ok:
					protocol = archived
					matched = true
					break
			if not matched: return _failure("Unsupported recording protocol")
		if not replay_existing: _opened_initialization = [raw, first.value]
	return replay() if replay_existing else {"ok":true,"value":null}

## Offline decode of one recorded packet. Packet 0 reuses open()'s parse when
## its bytes are unchanged: decode() is that same parse plus schema admission.
func decode_record(sequence: int, raw: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
	if sequence == 0 and not _opened_initialization.is_empty():
		var opened: Array = _opened_initialization
		_opened_initialization = []
		if opened[0] == raw: return protocol._validate_schema("InitializationResponse", opened[1])
	return protocol.decode("InitializationResponse" if sequence == 0 else "PlayerOperation", raw)

func consume(packet: Dictionary, raw: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
	if directory.is_empty(): return _failure("Journal is not open")
	# Decode independently: consumers can also be called by offline tools.
	var admitted := protocol.decode("InitializationResponse" if packet.get("cursor", {}).get("sequence", -1) == 0 else "PlayerOperation", raw)
	if not admitted.ok: return admitted
	if not Protocol._equal(admitted.value, packet): return _failure("Packet differs from journal bytes")
	return _consume_admitted(admitted.value, raw)

func _consume_admitted(packet: Dictionary, raw: PackedByteArray, record_transitions: bool = false, canonical_server_operation: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
	last_profile = {"sequence":int(packet.get("cursor",{}).get("sequence",-1)), "phase_ms":{}, "reducer_ms":{}} if profile_enabled else {}
	# Internal transport/replay boundary: the caller owns these exact admitted
	# bytes. Public consume() above always decodes and compares independently.
	if directory.is_empty(): return _failure("Journal is not open")
	var identity_check := protocol.check_identity(packet.protocol)
	if not identity_check.ok: return identity_check
	var next: Dictionary = packet.cursor
	_opened_initialization.clear()
	if not cursor.is_empty():
		for key in ["game_id", "game_epoch", "audience_id"]:
			if next[key] != cursor[key]: return _failure("Journal audience/epoch mismatch")
		if next.sequence <= cursor.sequence:
			if FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(_file(next.sequence)) != raw: return _failure("Conflicting duplicate journal record")
			return {"ok": true, "value": cursor.duplicate(true)}
	if int(next.sequence) != (0 if cursor.is_empty() else int(cursor.sequence) + 1): return _failure("Journal sequence gap")
	var started: int = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile_enabled else 0
	var saved := _stage(int(next.sequence), raw)
	if profile_enabled: _profile_elapsed("stage", started)
	if not saved.ok: return saved
	started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile_enabled else 0
	var normalized: Dictionary = packet if canonical_server_operation and next.sequence > 0 else protocol._normalize_admitted("InitializationResponse" if next.sequence == 0 else "PlayerOperation", packet)
	if profile_enabled: _profile_elapsed("normalize", started)
	started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile_enabled else 0
	var reduced := _reduced_state(normalized, record_transitions)
	if profile_enabled: _profile_elapsed("reduce", started)
	if not reduced.ok: return reduced
	started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile_enabled else 0
	var target := _file(int(next.sequence))
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(target):
		var code := DirAccess.rename_absolute(target + ".tmp", target)
		if code != OK: return _failure("Cannot commit journal: " + error_string(code))
	state = reduced.value
	_sensory_context = reduced.get("sensory_context",{})
	cursor = packet.cursor.duplicate(true)
	var accepted := {"ok": true, "value": cursor.duplicate(true), "normalized": normalized}
	# Derived records cross the worker boundary only after durable publication.
	if reduced.has("transitions"): accepted.transitions = reduced.transitions
	if profile_enabled: _profile_elapsed("commit", started)
	return accepted

func replay(through_sequence: int = -1) -> Dictionary:
	# Replay is transactional: leave the prior snapshot intact on any bad record.
	var prior_state := state
	var prior_cursor := cursor
	var prior_context := _sensory_context
	state = {}
	cursor = {}
	_sensory_context = {}
	var files: Array[String] = []
	var expression := RegEx.new()
	expression.compile("^[0-9]{16}\\.json$")
	for filename in DirAccess.get_files_at(directory):
		if expression.search(filename) != null: files.append(filename)
	files.sort()
	for filename in files:
		var sequence := filename.trim_suffix(".json").to_int()
		if through_sequence >= 0 and sequence > through_sequence: break
		var raw := FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(directory.path_join(filename))
		var result := protocol.decode("InitializationResponse" if sequence == 0 else "PlayerOperation", raw)
		if result.ok and int(result.value.cursor.sequence) != sequence: result = _failure("Journal filename/cursor mismatch")
		if result.ok: result = _consume_admitted(result.value, raw)
		if not result.ok:
			state = prior_state
			cursor = prior_cursor
			_sensory_context = prior_context
			return result
	if through_sequence >= 0 and (cursor.is_empty() or cursor.sequence != through_sequence):
		state = prior_state
		cursor = prior_cursor
		_sensory_context = prior_context
		return _failure("Requested journal cursor is unavailable")
	return {"ok": true, "value": cursor.duplicate(true)}

func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	return state.duplicate(true)

func _reduced_state(packet: Dictionary, record_transitions: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
	var result: Dictionary
	if packet.cursor.sequence == 0:
		result = Reducer.reduce_initialization(packet.initialization, packet.content_additions)
	else:
		result = Reducer._reduce_operation_retained(state, packet, record_transitions, last_profile.reducer_ms if profile_enabled else null, _sensory_context)
	return result

func _file(sequence: int) -> String:
	return directory.path_join("%016d.json" % sequence)

func _stage(sequence: int, raw: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
	var target := _file(sequence)
	if FileAccess.file_exists(target):
		return {"ok": true} if FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(target) == raw else _failure("Conflicting journal file")
	var temporary := target + ".tmp"
	var file := FileAccess.open(temporary, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null: return _failure("Cannot write journal: " + error_string(FileAccess.get_open_error()))
	file.store_buffer(raw)
	file.flush()
	var code := file.get_error()
	file.close()
	if code != OK: return _failure("Cannot flush journal: " + error_string(code))
	return {"ok": true}

static func _failure(message: String) -> Dictionary:
	return {"ok": false, "error": {"kind": "journal", "message": message, "retryable": false}}

func _profile_elapsed(phase: String, started: int) -> void:
	last_profile.phase_ms[phase] = (Time.get_ticks_usec() - started) / 1000.0
```


### A.11 — `sdk/reducer.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:sdk/reducer.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Port of dnd/player/reduction.py. Inputs are decoded public after-values.
const Audience = preload("res://sdk/audience.gd")
const Transitions = preload("res://sdk/transitions.gd")
const STATE_PRESENTATION_KINDS = ["temporary_hit_points", "spatial", "turn", "sensory", "item_charge", "faction"]

static func success(value: Variant) -> Dictionary:
    return Audience.success(value)

static func failure(message: String) -> Dictionary:
    return Audience.failure(message)

static func content_key(descriptor: Dictionary) -> String:
    var ref: Dictionary = descriptor.ref
    return "%s:%s:%s@%d" % [ref.pack_id, ref.definition_kind, ref.content_id, ref.content_version]

static func resolution_key(reference: Dictionary) -> String:
    return reference.kind + "," + reference.lineage_uuid + ("," + reference.application_id if reference.kind == "application" else "")

static func copy_target(target: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Received dictionaries are mutable in Godot; detach before every transaction.
    return target.duplicate(true)

static func _retained_target(target: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Journal-only transaction: previous published states/captures are read-only.
    # Collection shells are private; an actor/senses record forks only at its
    # actual write. Installed record leaves are immutable or copied at insertion.
    # Public reducer calls still deep-detach.
    var result: Dictionary = target.duplicate()
    for key in ["actors", "tiles", "objects", "spatial_commit_cursors"]:
        result[key] = target[key].duplicate()
    return result

static func _actor_for_write(target:Dictionary,identity:Variant,retained:bool,loadout:bool=false)->Variant:
    var actor:Variant=target.actors.get(identity)
    if actor==null or not retained:return actor
    actor=actor.duplicate()
    if loadout:actor.visual_loadout=actor.visual_loadout.duplicate()
    target.actors[identity]=actor
    return actor

static func _senses_for_write(target:Dictionary,cells:Dictionary)->void:
    if target.senses==null:return
    var previous:Dictionary=target.senses
    target.senses=Transitions.snapshot_senses(previous)
    # Spatial/contact writes do not edit cell arrays. Keep the private derived
    # cell owner bound to the replacement shell instead of rebuilding its sets.
    if cells.has("view") and is_same(cells.view.source,previous):cells.view.source=target.senses

static func _ordered_rows(rows: Array, cursors: Dictionary, identity_field: String) -> Array:
    # Python's sort is stable; Godot's is not. Equal cursors retain wire order.
    var order: Array = range(rows.size())
    order.sort_custom(func(a, b):
        var first: int = cursors[rows[a][identity_field]]
        var second: int = cursors[rows[b][identity_field]]
        return a < b if first == second else first < second)
    var result: Array = []
    for index in order: result.append(rows[index])
    return result

static func apply_world_update(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary, disclosed: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    # Each row is keyed and detached once. The fold's captures and the
    # compiler's staged supports reuse this record: first copy per key, in
    # wire order, and the keys of the field changes below.
    var tiles: Dictionary = {}
    for row in update.tiles:
        var key: String = Audience.point_key(row.position)
        var tile: Dictionary = row.duplicate(true)
        target.tiles[key] = tile
        if not tiles.has(key): tiles[key] = tile
    var changes: Array = []
    # Each row is an after-value at this event, including explicit clears. Never
    # mutate a tile held by an earlier event or use a future discovery as its base.
    for row in update.get("tile_changes",[]):
        var key = Audience.point_key(row.position)
        if not target.tiles.has(key): return failure("Tile field update requires an already known tile")
        var tile: Dictionary = target.tiles[key].duplicate()
        tile.merge(row.changes.duplicate(true),true)
        target.tiles[key] = tile
        changes.append(key)
    for identity in update.objects_removed: target.objects.erase(identity)
    for row in update.objects: target.objects[row.item.item_uuid] = row.duplicate(true)
    target.connectors = update.connectors.duplicate(true)
    disclosed.tiles = tiles; disclosed.changes = changes
    return success(target)

static func _observe(target: Dictionary, observation: Dictionary, retained:bool=false,cells:Dictionary={}) -> void:
    var identity: String = observation.actor.uuid
    if target.actors.has(identity) and not target.actors[identity].present: return
    target.actors[identity] = observation.actor.duplicate(true)
    if observation.contact != null and target.senses != null:
        if retained:_senses_for_write(target,cells)
        target.senses.entities[identity] = observation.contact.duplicate(true)

static func stage_actors(target: Dictionary, observations: Array) -> Dictionary:
    var result = copy_target(target)
    for observation in observations:
        if not result.actors.has(observation.actor.uuid): _observe(result, observation)
    return success(result)

static func observe_actors(target: Dictionary, observations: Array) -> Dictionary:
    var result = copy_target(target)
    for observation in observations: _observe(result, observation)
    return success(result)

static func _lineage_audience(target: Dictionary, lineage: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var supplied = Audience.resolve(lineage.observer_uuid, lineage.audience)
    if not supplied.ok: return supplied
    var current = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
    if not current.ok: return current
    if target.generation != lineage.generation or target.observer_uuid != lineage.observer_uuid or current.value != supplied.value:
        return failure("player lineage belongs to a different observer or generation")
    return success(current.value)

static func stage_lineage(target: Dictionary, lineage: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var checked = _lineage_audience(target, lineage)
    if not checked.ok: return checked
    var staged = stage_actors(target, lineage.observations)
    var result: Dictionary = staged.value
    var connectors = {}
    for row in result.connectors: connectors[row.connector_uuid] = row
    for update in lineage.world_updates:
        for tile in update.tiles:
            var key = Audience.point_key(tile.position)
            if not result.tiles.has(key): result.tiles[key] = tile.duplicate(true)
        for object in update.objects:
            if not result.objects.has(object.item.item_uuid): result.objects[object.item.item_uuid] = object.duplicate(true)
        for connector in update.connectors:
            if not connectors.has(connector.connector_uuid): connectors[connector.connector_uuid] = connector.duplicate(true)
    result.connectors = connectors.values()
    return success(result)

static func apply_player_fact(target: Dictionary, fact: Dictionary, source_cursor: Variant = null) -> Dictionary:
    return _apply_player_fact_owned(target, fact, source_cursor, false)

static func _apply_player_fact_owned(target: Dictionary, fact: Dictionary, source_cursor: Variant, composed_senses: bool, cells: Dictionary = {}, actor_snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    var identity: Variant
    var actor: Variant
    match fact.kind:
        "faction":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            actor=_actor_for_write(target,fact.entity_uuid,retained)
            if actor!=null:actor.faction=fact.faction_after
        "spatial":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.entity_uuid
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,identity,retained)
            if fact.terminal_departure and actor != null:
                actor.present = false; actor.last_visual_position = null; actor.occupancy_layer = null
                if target.senses != null:
                    if retained:_senses_for_write(target,cells)
                    target.senses.entities.erase(identity)
                return success(target)
            if actor != null and fact.change_type == "entity_entered": actor.spatial_disposition = "present"
            if actor != null and fact.occupancy_layer != null: actor.occupancy_layer = fact.occupancy_layer
            var audience = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
            if not audience.ok: return audience
            if identity in audience.value.controlled and fact.change_type == "entity_entered":
                if target.senses != null and identity == target.observer_uuid:
                    if retained:_senses_for_write(target,cells)
                    target.senses.position = fact.position.duplicate()
                if actor != null: actor.last_visual_position = fact.position.duplicate()
        "item_charge":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.source_entity_uuid
            if not target.actors.has(identity): return failure("Missing actor: " + identity)
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,identity,retained,true)
            var audience = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
            if not audience.ok: return audience
            if actor.controlled_items == null or identity not in audience.value.controlled:
                return failure("item charges require the controlled actor's inventory")
            var items: Array = []
            for item in actor.controlled_items:
                if fact.item_destroyed and item.item_uuid == fact.item_uuid: continue
                if item.item_uuid == fact.item_uuid:
                    if retained:item=item.duplicate()
                    item.charges = fact.charges_after; item.stack_count = fact.stack_count_after
                items.append(item)
            actor.controlled_items = items
            var layers: Array = []
            for layer in actor.visual_loadout.layers:
                if not (fact.item_destroyed and layer.item_uuid == fact.item_uuid): layers.append(layer)
            actor.visual_loadout.layers = layers
        "sensory":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            var audience = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
            if not audience.ok: return audience
            var observed = Audience._observe_retained(target.perception, audience.value, fact, int(target.reducer_cursor if source_cursor == null else source_cursor), cells)
            if not observed.ok: return observed
            target.perception = observed.value
            target.senses = Audience._view_after(target.perception, target.observer_uuid, target.senses, fact, cells,retained,observed.wire_cells) if composed_senses else Audience._view_retained(target.perception, target.observer_uuid)
            if fact.observer_position_changed and target.actors.has(fact.observer_uuid):
                actor=_actor_for_write(target,fact.observer_uuid,retained)
                actor.last_visual_position = fact.observer_position.duplicate()
            for member in fact.entity_contacts_changed:
                var contact: Dictionary = fact.entity_contacts_changed[member]
                if contact.visual and target.actors.has(member) and target.actors[member].present:
                    if target.actors[member].last_visual_position!=contact.position:
                        actor=_actor_for_write(target,member,retained)
                        actor.last_visual_position = contact.position.duplicate()
        "attack":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            if target.actors.has(fact.source_entity_uuid):
                var stance = "none" if fact.attack_source_kind != "equipped" else ("ranged" if fact.weapon_slot in ["RANGED_MAIN", "RANGED_OFF"] else "melee")
                actor=_actor_for_write(target,fact.source_entity_uuid,retained,true)
                actor.visual_loadout.active_weapon_set = stance
        "damage", "heal":
            if fact.kind == "damage" and fact.stage != "applied": return success(target)
            if fact.kind == "heal" and fact.was_blocked: return success(target)
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.target_entity_uuid
            if not target.actors.has(identity): return failure("Missing actor: " + identity)
            if fact.resulting_normal_hp == null or fact.resulting_temporary_hp == null:
                return failure("applied damage requires exact committed HP" if fact.kind == "damage" else "healing requires exact committed HP")
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,identity,retained)
            actor.normal_hp = fact.resulting_normal_hp; actor.temporary_hp = fact.resulting_temporary_hp
            if fact.resulting_temporary_hp <= 0: actor.temporary_hp_grant = null
        "temporary_hit_points":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.entity_uuid
            if not target.actors.has(identity): return failure("Missing actor: " + identity)
            actor=_actor_for_write(target,identity,retained)
            actor.temporary_hp = fact.resulting_temporary_hp
            actor.temporary_hp_grant = fact.grant.duplicate(true) if fact.grant != null else null
        "life":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.entity_uuid
            if not target.actors.has(identity): return failure("Missing actor: " + identity)
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,identity,retained)
            actor.life_state = fact.new_state; actor.normal_hp = fact.normal_hit_points
            actor.remains_disposition = fact.remains_disposition
        "equipment":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,fact.source_entity_uuid,retained)
            if actor != null:
                actor.visual_loadout = fact.visual_loadout.duplicate(true)
                actor.armor_class = fact.armor_class
                actor.controlled_items = fact.controlled_items.duplicate(true) if fact.controlled_items != null else null
        "condition":
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            identity = fact.target_entity_uuid
            if not target.actors.has(identity): return failure("Missing actor: " + identity)
            actor = _actor_for_write(target,identity,retained)
            var condition: Dictionary = fact.condition
            var members = {}
            for row in actor.conditions: members[row.condition_uuid] = row
            if fact.event_type == "condition_removal": members.erase(condition.condition_uuid)
            elif condition.category != "internal": members[condition.condition_uuid] = condition.duplicate(true)
            actor.conditions = members.values()
            var stats: Variant = condition.resulting_stats
            if stats != null:
                actor.spatial_disposition = stats.spatial_disposition
                actor.normal_hp = stats.normal_hp
                actor.maximum_hp = stats.maximum_hp
                actor.armor_class = stats.armor_class
                if stats.resolved_size != null: actor.resolved_size = stats.resolved_size
            else:
                if condition.resulting_max_hp != null: actor.maximum_hp = condition.resulting_max_hp
                if condition.resulting_ac != null: actor.armor_class = condition.resulting_ac
        "turn":
            if fact.round_number != null: target.round_number = fact.round_number
            if fact.event_type in ["turn_start", "turn_end", "encounter_end"]:
                target.current_actor_uuid = fact.entity_uuid if fact.event_type == "turn_start" else null
    return success(target)

static func apply_committed_player_fact(target: Dictionary, fact: Dictionary, source_cursor: int, version_cursors: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return _apply_committed_player_fact_owned(target, fact, source_cursor, version_cursors, false)

static func _apply_committed_player_fact_owned(target: Dictionary, fact: Dictionary, source_cursor: int, version_cursors: Dictionary, composed_senses: bool, cells: Dictionary = {}, actor_snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    if fact.kind == "spatial" and fact.entity_uuid != null and fact.change_type in ["entity_entered", "entity_left"]:
        if fact.commit_event_uuid == null or not version_cursors.has(fact.commit_event_uuid):
            return failure("Spatial change at cursor %d lacks its recorded commit version" % source_cursor)
        var committed_at: int = version_cursors[fact.commit_event_uuid]
        var previous: int = target.spatial_commit_cursors.get(fact.entity_uuid, -1)
        if committed_at < previous and previous < source_cursor: return success(target)
        target.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid] = committed_at
    return _apply_player_fact_owned(target, fact, source_cursor, composed_senses, cells, actor_snapshots,retained)

static func reduce_nodes(target: Dictionary, nodes: Array, versions: Array, observations: Array, updates: Array) -> Dictionary:
    return _reduce_nodes_owned(copy_target(target), nodes, versions, observations, updates)

# Only a private transaction enters this fold. Intermediate failures discard
# its mutable containers without touching a previously published state.
static func _reduce_nodes_owned(result: Dictionary, nodes: Array, versions: Array, observations: Array, updates: Array, recorded: Variant = null, profile: Variant = null, cells: Dictionary = {},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    # Arbitrary public inputs first compose exhaustively. Only a context bound
    # to this exact committed state can carry that proof across operations.
    var composed_senses: bool = cells.get("composed",false)
    # A fold-local snapshot can serve adjacent event inputs/deltas until a
    # fact or observation edits actors. Mutation branches invalidate it before
    # writing; no snapshots or readiness survive this transaction boundary.
    var actor_snapshots:Dictionary={}
    var indexes = {}
    for row in versions: indexes[row.event_uuid] = row.source_index
    for observation in observations:
        if not indexes.has(observation.event_uuid): return failure("Observation has no recorded version")
    var pending = _ordered_rows(observations, indexes, "event_uuid")
    var next = 0
    var world_updates = {}
    for row in updates: world_updates[row.event_uuid] = row
    for node in nodes:
        if not indexes.has(node.uuid): return failure("Node has no recorded version")
        var admitted: Array = []
        while next < pending.size() and indexes[pending[next].event_uuid] <= indexes[node.uuid]:
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            _observe(result, pending[next],retained,cells)
            if recorded != null: admitted.append(pending[next])
            next += 1
        var started: int = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        var inputs: Dictionary = Transitions.actor_inputs(result,node,actor_snapshots,retained) if recorded != null else {}
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "actor_inputs", started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        var update: Variant = world_updates.get(node.uuid)
        var disclosed: Dictionary = {}
        if update != null:
            var updated = apply_world_update(result, update, disclosed)
            if not updated.ok: return updated
            if recorded != null: recorded.world[node.uuid] = disclosed
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "world", started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        if not node.canceled and node.fact != null:
            var folded = _apply_committed_player_fact_owned(result, node.fact, int(indexes[node.uuid]), indexes, composed_senses, cells, actor_snapshots,retained)
            if not folded.ok: return folded
            if node.fact.kind == "sensory":
                composed_senses = true
                cells.composed = true
        if profile != null:
            _profile_elapsed(profile, "facts", started)
            if not node.canceled and node.fact != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "fact_" + str(node.fact.kind), started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        if recorded != null:
            recorded.events.append({"event_uuid":node.uuid, "source_index":indexes[node.uuid],
                "actor_inputs":inputs, "delta":Transitions.capture_delta(result,node,admitted,update,actor_snapshots,retained,disclosed)})
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "captures", started)
    while next < pending.size():
        var observation: Dictionary = pending[next]
        _observe(result, observation,retained,cells)
        if recorded != null:
            recorded.trailing.actors[observation.actor.uuid] = result.actors[observation.actor.uuid] if retained else Transitions.snapshot_actor(result.actors[observation.actor.uuid])
            if observation.contact != null: recorded.trailing.set.senses = result.senses if retained else Transitions.snapshot_senses(result.senses)
        next += 1
    return success(result)

static func reduce_initialization(initialization: Dictionary, content_additions: Array = []) -> Dictionary:
    var audience = Audience.resolve(initialization.observer_uuid, initialization.audience)
    if not audience.ok: return audience
    var target = {"generation": initialization.generation, "observer_uuid": initialization.observer_uuid,
        "world": initialization.world.duplicate(true), "tiles": {}, "objects": {}, "connectors": [],
        "senses": null, "reducer_cursor": 0, "spatial_commit_cursors": {}, "actors": {},
        "current_actor_uuid": null, "round_number": 0, "hud_snapshot": null, "audience": audience.value,
        "perception": {"members": {}, "contact_cursors": {}, "effect_cursors": {}, "effect_absences": {}},
        "content": [], "combat_log_appends": []}
    var folded = _reduce_nodes_owned(target, initialization.nodes, initialization.version_rows, initialization.observations, initialization.world_updates)
    if not folded.ok: return folded
    target = folded.value
    target.reducer_cursor = initialization.end_cursor
    var hud: Variant = initialization.hud_snapshot
    if hud != null and (hud.generation != target.generation or hud.observer_uuid != target.observer_uuid or hud.revision > initialization.end_cursor):
        return failure("HUD facts belong to a different or future boundary")
    target.hud_snapshot = hud.duplicate(true) if hud != null else null
    target.content = content_additions.duplicate(true)
    target.content.sort_custom(func(a, b): return content_key(a) < content_key(b))
    return success(target)

static func reduce_lineage(target: Dictionary, lineage: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return _reduce_lineage_owned(copy_target(target), lineage)

static func _reduce_lineage_owned(target: Dictionary, lineage: Dictionary, recorded: Variant = null, profile: Variant = null, cells: Dictionary = {},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    var audience = _lineage_audience(target, lineage)
    if not audience.ok: return audience
    if lineage.end_cursor <= target.reducer_cursor:
        return failure("player lineage precedes this reduction position")
    var folded = _reduce_nodes_owned(target, lineage.events, lineage.version_rows, lineage.observations, lineage.world_updates, recorded, profile, cells,retained)
    if not folded.ok: return folded
    var result: Dictionary = folded.value
    result.reducer_cursor = lineage.end_cursor
    var hud: Variant = lineage.hud_snapshot
    if hud != null:
        if hud.generation != result.generation or hud.observer_uuid != result.observer_uuid or hud.revision > lineage.end_cursor or (result.hud_snapshot != null and hud.revision < result.hud_snapshot.revision):
            return failure("HUD facts belong to a different observer or generation")
        result.hud_snapshot = hud.duplicate(true)
    if recorded != null:
        recorded.trailing.set.reducer_cursor = result.reducer_cursor
        if hud != null: recorded.trailing.set.hud_snapshot = hud.duplicate(true)
    return success(result)

static func reduce_operation(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return _reduce_operation(target, update, false)

# Internal bounded handoff: callers retain these owned, read-only event records
# only after successful reduction (and journal commit when consuming live bytes).
static func _reduce_operation_recorded(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary, profile: Variant = null) -> Dictionary:
    return _reduce_operation(target, update, true, profile)

# Only Journal uses retained canonical inputs. Callers that may mutate arbitrary
# public results use the detached entrypoints above.
static func _reduce_operation_retained(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary, record_events: bool = false, profile: Variant = null, sensory_context: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    return _reduce_operation(target, update, record_events, profile, true, sensory_context)

static func _reduce_operation(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary, record_events: bool, profile: Variant = null, retained: bool = false, sensory_context: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    var records = {"lineages":[]} if record_events else {}
    var audience = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
    if not audience.ok: return audience
    if update.audience != audience.value:
        return failure("An operation cannot change its authorized audience")
    var started: int = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
    var result = _retained_target(target) if retained else copy_target(target)
    var cells = {}
    if retained and is_same(sensory_context.get("state"),target) and is_same(sensory_context.get("perception"),target.perception) and is_same(sensory_context.get("senses"),target.senses):
        cells = Audience._fork_cells(sensory_context.get("cells",{}))
    if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "copy", started)
    if not update.content_additions.is_empty():
        var content = {}
        for row in result.content: content[content_key(row)] = row
        for descriptor in update.content_additions:
            var key = content_key(descriptor)
            if content.has(key) and content[key] != descriptor:
                return failure("An admitted content identity changed its definition")
            content[key] = descriptor.duplicate(true)
        var identities: Array = content.keys()
        identities.sort(); result.content = []
        for key in identities: result.content.append(content[key])
    for lineage in update.lineages:
        if lineage.start_cursor != result.reducer_cursor:
            return failure("Operation occurrence sequence has a gap")
        var recorded: Variant = {"lineage_uuid":lineage.lineage_uuid, "start_cursor":lineage.start_cursor,
            "end_cursor":lineage.end_cursor, "events":[], "trailing":Transitions.empty_delta(), "world":{}} if record_events else null
        var folded = _reduce_lineage_owned(result, lineage, recorded, profile, cells if retained else {},retained)
        if not folded.ok: return folded
        result = folded.value
        if record_events: records.lineages.append(recorded)
    started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
    var hud: Variant = update.hud
    if hud != null:
        if hud.generation != result.generation or hud.observer_uuid != result.observer_uuid or hud.revision > result.reducer_cursor or (result.hud_snapshot != null and hud.revision < result.hud_snapshot.revision):
            return failure("HUD belongs to a different or future operation")
        result.hud_snapshot = hud.duplicate(true)
    var first: int = result.combat_log_appends.size()
    for i in range(update.combat_log_appends.size()):
        var row: Dictionary = update.combat_log_appends[i]
        if row.generation != result.generation or row.observer_uuid != result.observer_uuid or row.operation_end_cursor > result.reducer_cursor or row.encounter_log_index != first + i:
            return failure("Standalone log append is out of order or belongs to another audience")
    if not update.combat_log_appends.is_empty():
        if retained:result.combat_log_appends=result.combat_log_appends.duplicate()
        result.combat_log_appends.append_array(update.combat_log_appends.duplicate(true))
    var accepted = success(result)
    if record_events: accepted.transitions = records
    if retained:
        # Only a multi-member projection needs a second composed cell index.
        # A retained one-member view borrows its member's canonical collections.
        if cells.get("composed",false) and result.senses != null and result.perception.members.size()!=1:
            if not cells.has("view") or not is_same(cells.view.source,result.senses):
                cells.view = Audience._indexed_senses(result.senses)
        accepted.sensory_context = {"state":result, "perception":result.perception,
            "senses":result.senses, "cells":cells}
    if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "finalize", started)
    return accepted

static func state_before_event(before: Dictionary, lineage: Dictionary, event: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var first: Variant = null
    for row in lineage.version_rows:
        if row.lineage_uuid == event.lineage_uuid:
            if first == null or row.source_index < first: first = row.source_index
    if first == null: return failure("Event lineage has no recorded versions")
    var completed = {}
    for row in lineage.version_rows:
        if row.source_index < first: completed[row.event_uuid] = true
    var events: Array = []
    for row in lineage.events:
        if completed.has(row.uuid): events.append(row)
    if events.is_empty(): return success(copy_target(before))
    var part: Dictionary = lineage.duplicate(true)
    part.events = events; part.end_cursor = first
    part.observations = lineage.observations.filter(func(row): return completed.has(row.event_uuid))
    part.world_updates = lineage.world_updates.filter(func(row): return completed.has(row.event_uuid))
    return reduce_lineage(before, part)

static func lineage_branch(lineage: Dictionary, root: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var by_lineage = {}; var intervals = {}
    for node in lineage.events: by_lineage[node.lineage_uuid] = node
    for row in lineage.version_rows:
        var prior: Array = intervals.get(row.lineage_uuid, [row.source_index, row.source_index])
        intervals[row.lineage_uuid] = [mini(prior[0], row.source_index), maxi(prior[1], row.source_index)]
    if not intervals.has(root.lineage_uuid): return failure("Root lineage has no recorded versions")
    var bounds: Array = intervals[root.lineage_uuid]
    var pending: Array = [root.lineage_uuid]
    for node in lineage.events:
        if not intervals.has(node.lineage_uuid): return failure("Node lineage has no recorded versions")
        var interval: Array = intervals[node.lineage_uuid]
        if node.parent_lineage == null and bounds[0] <= interval[0] and interval[1] <= bounds[1]: pending.append(node.lineage_uuid)
    var selected = {}
    while not pending.is_empty():
        var identity: String = pending.pop_back()
        if selected.has(identity): continue
        if not by_lineage.has(identity): return failure("Child lineage has no disclosed node")
        selected[identity] = true
        pending.append_array(by_lineage[identity].children_lineages)
    var result: Dictionary = lineage.duplicate(true)
    result.root = root.duplicate(true)
    result.events = lineage.events.filter(func(node): return selected.has(node.lineage_uuid))
    result.version_rows = lineage.version_rows.filter(func(row): return selected.has(row.lineage_uuid))
    var identities = {}
    for row in result.version_rows: identities[row.event_uuid] = true
    result.start_cursor = result.version_rows[0].source_index
    result.end_cursor = result.version_rows[-1].source_index + 1
    result.observations = lineage.observations.filter(func(row): return identities.has(row.event_uuid))
    result.world_updates = lineage.world_updates.filter(func(row): return identities.has(row.event_uuid))
    result.hud_snapshot = null
    return success(result)

static func index_player_lineage(lineage: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {"by_lineage": {}, "by_uuid": {}, "source_order": {}, "owned": {}, "results": {}, "damage_requests": {}}
    for row in lineage.version_rows: result.source_order[row.event_uuid] = row.source_index
    for node in lineage.events:
        result.by_lineage[node.lineage_uuid] = node.duplicate(true)
        result.by_uuid[node.uuid] = node.duplicate(true)
    for node in lineage.events:
        var ancestors: Array = []
        var current: Dictionary = node
        while current.lineage_uuid not in ancestors:
            ancestors.append(current.lineage_uuid)
            var request: Variant = current.lineage_uuid if current.fact != null and current.fact.kind == "damage" and current.fact.stage == "taken" else result.damage_requests.get(current.lineage_uuid)
            if request != null:
                for identity in ancestors: result.damage_requests[identity] = request
                break
            if current.parent_lineage == null or not result.by_lineage.has(current.parent_lineage): break
            current = result.by_lineage[current.parent_lineage]
    for node in lineage.events:
        if not result.source_order.has(node.uuid): return failure("Node has no recorded version")
    var ordered = _ordered_rows(lineage.events.duplicate(true), result.source_order, "uuid")
    for node in ordered:
        if node.resolution_ref == null: continue
        var key = resolution_key(node.resolution_ref)
        if not result.owned.has(key): result.owned[key] = []
        result.owned[key].append(node)
        if not node.canceled and node.fact != null and (node.fact.kind == "object_damage" or (node.fact.kind == "damage" and node.fact.stage == "applied")):
            if not result.results.has(key): result.results[key] = []
            result.results[key].append(node)
    return success(result)

static func _profile_elapsed(profile: Dictionary, phase: String, started: int) -> void:
    profile[phase] = float(profile.get(phase, 0.0)) + (Time.get_ticks_usec() - started) / 1000.0
```


### A.12 — `sdk/transitions.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:sdk/transitions.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Passive event-time after-values collected inside an owned reducer transaction.
# No authoring, animation timing or scene resources belong at this boundary.
const Audience = preload("res://sdk/audience.gd")

static func empty_delta() -> Dictionary:
    return {"set":{},"actors":{},"tiles":{},"objects":{},"objects_removed":[],"spatial_commit_cursors":{}}

static func snapshot_senses(senses: Variant) -> Variant:
    if senses == null: return null
    # The reducer owns a detached transaction. Sensory folds replace the whole
    # view; spatial facts/observations only replace shell fields or entity-map
    # entries. Preserve those mutable containers, sharing their private leaves.
    var result: Dictionary = senses.duplicate()
    result.entities = senses.entities.duplicate()
    return result

static func snapshot_actor(actor: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # An installed actor owns its immutable appearance/condition/layer/item
    # metadata. Facts replace those leaves; only these shells are edited later.
    var result: Dictionary = actor.duplicate()
    result.visual_loadout = actor.visual_loadout.duplicate()
    if actor.controlled_items != null:
        var items: Array = []
        for item in actor.controlled_items: items.append(item.duplicate())
        result.controlled_items = items
    return result

static func _captured_actor(target:Dictionary, identity:String, snapshots:Dictionary,retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    # Retained canonical facts replace actor records before writing. The exact
    # before/after record is already immutable; detached public folds keep their
    # snapshot shells because they use the ordinary mutable transaction.
    if not snapshots.has(identity):snapshots[identity] = target.actors[identity] if retained else snapshot_actor(target.actors[identity])
    return snapshots[identity]

static func actor_inputs(target: Dictionary, node: Dictionary, snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {}
    if node.fact != null:
        for field in ["entity_uuid", "source_entity_uuid", "target_entity_uuid", "observer_uuid"]:
            var identity: Variant = node.fact.get(field)
            if identity != null and target.actors.has(identity) and not result.has(identity):
                result[identity] = _captured_actor(target,identity,snapshots,retained)
    return result

static func capture_delta(target: Dictionary, node: Dictionary, observations: Array, update: Variant, snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false,disclosed:Dictionary={}) -> Dictionary:
    var delta = empty_delta()
    var actors = {}
    for observation in observations: actors[observation.actor.uuid] = true
    var fact: Variant = node.fact
    if fact != null and not node.canceled:
        for field in ["entity_uuid","source_entity_uuid","target_entity_uuid","observer_uuid"]:
            if fact.get(field) != null: actors[fact[field]] = true
        if fact.kind == "sensory":
            for identity in fact.entity_contacts_changed: actors[identity] = true
            # Audience folds return a new perception snapshot without changing
            # its predecessor. This private event-time record is already owned.
            delta.set.perception = target.perception
        if fact.kind in ["sensory","spatial"]: delta.set.senses = target.senses if retained else snapshot_senses(target.senses)
        if fact.kind == "turn":
            delta.set.current_actor_uuid = target.current_actor_uuid
            delta.set.round_number = target.round_number
        if fact.kind == "spatial" and fact.entity_uuid != null and target.spatial_commit_cursors.has(fact.entity_uuid):
            delta.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid] = target.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid]
    for identity in actors:
        if target.actors.has(identity): delta.actors[identity] = _captured_actor(target,identity,snapshots,retained)
    for observation in observations:
        if observation.contact != null:
            delta.set.senses = target.senses if retained else snapshot_senses(target.senses)
    if update != null:
        # The fold already keyed this event's rows (Reducer.apply_world_update).
        # Without field changes or repeated keys, those copies are the after-values.
        if disclosed.changes.is_empty() and disclosed.tiles.size() == update.tiles.size():
            delta.tiles = disclosed.tiles.duplicate()
        else:
            for key in disclosed.tiles: delta.tiles[key] = target.tiles[key]
            for key in disclosed.changes: delta.tiles[key] = target.tiles[key]
        for object in update.objects: delta.objects[object.item.item_uuid] = target.objects[object.item.item_uuid]
        delta.objects_removed = update.objects_removed.duplicate()
        delta.set.connectors = target.connectors
    return delta
```

```gdscript
extends RefCounted
# Read the existing authoring owners; adapters return transient draw records.
const Placement = preload("res://placement.gd")
const NativeAuthoring = preload("res://presentation/native_authoring.gd")
const NativePresentationSources = preload("res://presentation/native_presentation_sources.gd")
const BodySources = preload("res://presentation/body_sources.gd")
const AbilityDocuments = preload("res://presentation/ability_documents.gd")
## Environment runtime documents written by tools/build_presentation.gd from
## authoring/environment.tres. Each is cached in a catalog cache under its
## res:// path, so source_snapshot publishes it with the admitted documents.
const ENVIRONMENT := "res://build/presentation/environment/"
# Parsed authoring documents, shared by every catalog cache in the process
# (documents are immutable after admission; see source_snapshot). A document
# is reused only while its file holds the same bytes it was parsed from.
static var _documents:Dictionary={}
static var _documents_mutex:=Mutex.new()

static func media_path(path: String) -> String:
    # Project assets (res://assets/art/...) load by their res:// path.
    if path.begins_with("res://"): return path
    if path.begins_with("C:/"): return path
    var root: String = ProjectSettings.get_setting("source_data/media_root")
    var absolute = root.path_join(path.trim_prefix("/media/"))
    # Extended UNC keeps the original deep asset paths readable on Windows.
    if OS.get_name()=="Windows" and absolute.begins_with("//") and not absolute.begins_with("//?/"):
        return "//?/UNC/"+absolute.trim_prefix("//")
    return absolute

static func environment_file(path: String, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not cache.has(path):
        var record: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(path)
        if record == null: push_error("Missing environment build output (run tools/build_presentation.gd): " + path)
        cache[path] = record.value if record != null else {}
    return cache[path]

## Terrain views, wall and cliff pieces, fixtures and directional light.
static func environment_world(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return environment_file(ENVIRONMENT + "world.res", cache)

## Every single image the world draws by id, the flame animation and the water look.
static func environment_resources(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return environment_file(ENVIRONMENT + "resources.res", cache)

## Door, prop and trap owners, bank and library paths, wall destructions, chest rests.
static func environment_index(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return environment_file(ENVIRONMENT + "index.res", cache)

## Torch colour and item ids, optical lifts and the fallback cookie (no catalog cache: immutable).
static func environment_lighting() -> Dictionary:
    var record: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(ENVIRONMENT + "lighting.res")
    if record == null: push_error("Missing environment build output (run tools/build_presentation.gd): lighting.res")
    return record.value if record != null else {}

static func light_ranges() -> Resource:
    var ranges: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(ENVIRONMENT + "light_ranges.res")
    if ranges == null: push_error("Missing environment build output (run tools/build_presentation.gd): light_ranges.res")
    return ranges

## Measured energy and emission centre per flame frame, keyed by its image path.
static func fixture_optics() -> Dictionary:
    var facts: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(ENVIRONMENT + "fixture_optics.res")
    if facts == null: push_error("Missing environment build output (run tools/build_presentation.gd): fixture_optics.res")
    return facts.frames if facts != null else {}

## The blood residue's region particles (residue.blood). Preparation loads it;
## sampling only reads what preparation admitted.
static func residue_asset(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var path := ENVIRONMENT + "residues/blood.res"
    if not cache.has(path):
        var asset: Resource = ResourceLoader.load(path)
        if asset == null: push_error("Missing environment build output (run tools/build_presentation.gd): " + path); return {}
        cache[path] = asset.value
    return cache[path]

static func prepared_residue_asset(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return cache.get(ENVIRONMENT + "residues/blood.res", {})

static func read_file(relative_path: String, cache: Dictionary) -> Variant:
    if not cache.has(relative_path):
        # Spells, conditions, actions, attacks and their contexts come from the
        # abilities build under the same document names.
        if AbilityDocuments.owns(relative_path):
            var owned: Variant = AbilityDocuments.read(relative_path)
            if owned == null:
                NativeAuthoring._error(cache, "Abilities build has no record table: " + AbilityDocuments.file(relative_path))
                owned = {}
            cache[relative_path] = owned
        else:
            var root: String = ProjectSettings.get_setting("source_data/authoring_root")
            cache[relative_path] = NativeAuthoring.overlay(relative_path, _document(root.path_join(relative_path)), cache)
    return cache[relative_path]

static func _document(path:String)->Variant:
    var raw:=FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(path)
    _documents_mutex.lock();var known:Array=_documents.get(path,[]);_documents_mutex.unlock()
    if not known.is_empty() and known[0]==raw:return known[1]
    var parsed:Variant=JSON.parse_string(raw.get_string_from_utf8())
    _documents_mutex.lock();_documents[path]=[raw,parsed];_documents_mutex.unlock()
    return parsed

static func asset(asset_id:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var selected:Resource=NativePresentationSources.asset(asset_id,cache)
    return {} if selected==null else selected.value

static func prepared_asset(asset_id:String,cache:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    var selected:Resource=NativePresentationSources.prepared_asset(asset_id,cache)
    return {} if selected==null else selected.value

static func source_pointer(document: String, pointer: String, cache: Dictionary) -> String:
    return NativeAuthoring.source_pointer(document, pointer, read_file(document, cache))

static func source_snapshot(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Effective source documents are immutable after admission. Give each worker
    # its own cache shell, without reloading selected Resources or sharing derived
    # caches. Qualification belongs to import tools and tests.
    # Pin the source revision before dispatch. A later explicit reload may
    # select another index, while this worker/display keeps these references.
    NativePresentationSources.admission(cache)
    BodySources.admission(cache)
    var snapshot = {}
    for path in cache:
        if path is String and (path.ends_with(".json") or path.begins_with(ENVIRONMENT)) and not path.begins_with("__"):
            snapshot[path] = cache[path]
    if cache.has(NativePresentationSources.CACHE_KEY):
        snapshot[NativePresentationSources.CACHE_KEY]=NativePresentationSources.snapshot(cache[NativePresentationSources.CACHE_KEY])
    if cache.has("__body_source_admission"):
        snapshot.__body_source_admission=cache.__body_source_admission
    if cache.has("native_references_validated"):
        snapshot.native_references_validated = cache.native_references_validated
    if cache.has("native_authoring_errors"):
        snapshot.native_authoring_errors = cache.native_authoring_errors.duplicate()
    return snapshot

static func invalidate_source_indexes()->void:
    NativePresentationSources.invalidate()
    AbilityDocuments.invalidate()
    BodySources.invalidate()
    _documents_mutex.lock();_documents={};_documents_mutex.unlock()

static func adopt_snapshot(cache:Dictionary,offered:Dictionary)->void:
    # Documents belong to the admitted revision. Lazy source references can
    # grow on either worker: merge their immutable shells without discarding
    # already prepared references or allowing a different revision to take over.
    for key in offered:
        if not cache.has(key):cache[key]=offered[key]
    for key in ["__body_source_admission",NativePresentationSources.CACHE_KEY]:
        if not offered.has(key) or not cache.has(key) or is_same(cache[key],offered[key]):continue
        var current:Dictionary=cache[key];var incoming:Dictionary=offered[key]
        if current.index==null or incoming.index==null or current.index.revision!=incoming.index.revision:continue
        var loaded:Dictionary=current.loaded.duplicate()
        loaded.merge(incoming.loaded,false)
        cache[key]=NativePresentationSources.make_admission(current.index,loaded)

static func validate_native(cache: Dictionary) -> Array:
    # Passive metadata only. No texture decoding, scene creation or shader upload.
    for document in ["catalog/condition_recipes.json", "catalog/body_action_recipes.json", "catalog/resources.json"]:
        read_file(document, cache)
    if not cache.has("native_references_validated"):
        var built:Resource=BodySources.index(cache)
        var rigs:Dictionary={} if built==null else built.rigs
        for recipe in cache["catalog/body_action_recipes.json"].values():
            if not recipe.has("_resource_source"):continue
            var clip:Dictionary=rigs.get(recipe.rigId,{}).get("clips",{}).get(recipe.actor.clip,{})
            if clip.is_empty():NativeAuthoring._error(cache,"Selected action has no source clip: "+recipe._resource_source)
            else:
                for marker in recipe.anchors:
                    if marker.frame>clip.frames:NativeAuthoring._error(cache,"Selected action marker exceeds source duration: "+recipe._resource_source)
        for recipe in cache["catalog/condition_recipes.json"].values():
            for pose in recipe.get("persistent",{}).get("activityPoses",[]):
                var clip:Dictionary=rigs.get(pose.rigId,{}).get("clips",{}).get(pose.clip,{})
                if clip.is_empty():
                    NativeAuthoring._error(cache,"Selected activity pose has no source clip: "+pose.rigId+"/"+pose.clip)
                elif pose.sampling=="hold" and pose.frame>=clip.frames:
                    NativeAuthoring._error(cache,"Selected held frame exceeds source clip: "+pose.rigId+"/"+pose.clip)
        cache.native_references_validated=true
    return cache.get("native_authoring_errors", [])

static func bank_for(row: Dictionary, broken: bool, cache: Dictionary) -> String:
    var index = environment_index(cache)
    var state: String = row.get("state", "default")
    if row.kind == "wall":
        return index.wall_destructions[row.material] if broken else ""
    if row.kind not in ["prop", "door", "trap"]: return ""
    var group: String = {"prop": "props", "door": "doors", "trap": "traps"}[row.kind]
    var owner = index[group][row.asset]
    if row.kind == "door":
        if broken: return owner.destructions[state + "." + row.get("outcome", "clear")]
        return owner.openings["inward" if state == "open.inward" else "outward"]
    if broken:
        return owner.destructions.get(state, "")
    if row.kind == "trap": return owner.intact
    return owner.intact.get(state, owner.intact.values()[0])

static func bank_data(id: String, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    return environment_file(environment_index(cache).banks[id], cache)

static func frame_at(bank: Dictionary, time: float) -> int:
    if bank.has("sample_times_ms"):
        var result = 0
        for i in range(bank.sample_times_ms.size()):
            if bank.sample_times_ms[i] <= time * 1000 + 0.0001: result = i
        return result
    return clampi(int(floor(time * bank.fps + 0.00001)), 0, int(bank.frame_count) - 1)

static func duration(bank: Dictionary) -> float:
    return float(bank.duration_ms) / 1000.0

static func pose_for(bank: Dictionary, direction: String, quarter: int) -> String:
    var view = Placement.pose(direction, quarter)
    var orientation = ["east", "north", "west", "south"].find(direction)
    if bank.has("camera_quarter_by_pose"):
        var wanted_quarter = posmod(quarter + orientation, 4)
        for candidate in bank.camera_quarter_by_pose:
            if bank.camera_quarter_by_pose[candidate] == wanted_quarter: return candidate
    var surfaces: Dictionary = bank.surface_frames_by_pose
    if surfaces[view][0].geometry.basis == "object_local":
        var object_rotation = Basis(Vector3.UP, -orientation * PI / 2)
        var wanted = (Basis(Vector3.UP, quarter * PI / 2) * Vector3(1, 1, 1)).normalized()
        var best = -2.0
        for candidate in bank.rows:
            var alignment = (object_rotation * local_ray(surfaces[candidate][0].geometry)).normalized().dot(wanted)
            if alignment > best: best = alignment; view = candidate
    return view

static func local_ray(geometry: Dictionary) -> Vector3:
    var rows: Array = geometry.sourceToLocal
    var ray: Array = geometry.rayDirection
    return Vector3(rows[0][0]*ray[0]+rows[0][1]*ray[1]+rows[0][2]*ray[2],
        rows[1][0]*ray[0]+rows[1][1]*ray[1]+rows[1][2]*ray[2], rows[2][0]*ray[0]+rows[2][1]*ray[1]+rows[2][2]*ray[2])

static func break_duration(row: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> float:
    var bank = bank_for(row,true,cache)
    return duration(bank_data(bank,cache)) if not bank.is_empty() else 0.0

static func owner_for(row: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if row.kind not in ["prop","door","trap"]: return {}
    return environment_index(cache)[{"prop":"props","door":"doors","trap":"traps"}[row.kind]][row.asset]

static func door_frame(row: Dictionary, quarter: int, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var owner = owner_for(row,cache)
    var boundary = Placement.pose(row.orientation,quarter)
    if not owner.frame_resource_by_pose.is_empty():
        return environment_resources(cache).resources[owner.frame_resource_by_pose[boundary]]
    var bank = bank_data(bank_for(row,false,cache),cache)
    var pose = pose_for(bank,row.orientation,quarter)
    if not bank.has("frame_regions_by_pose"): return {}
    var region: Dictionary = bank.frame_regions_by_pose[pose]
    var result: Dictionary = bank.surface_frames_by_pose[pose][0].duplicate(true)
    result.merge({"path":region.path,"rect":region.rect,"native_size":bank.cell,
        "pivot":bank.get("physical_source_contact_by_pose",bank.pivots_by_pose)[pose],"scale":bank.scale})
    return result

static func receiving_normal(record: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not record.has("normal"): return record
    # Delivery-selected receiving detail, never depth/support or paint alpha.
    # This raw file key lets media preparation publish the lookup to the scene
    # cache before first use, like the other immutable source documents.
    var normals: Dictionary = environment_file(ENVIRONMENT + "receiving_normals.res", cache).normals
    var original_path: String = record.normal.region.path
    if not normals.has(original_path): return record
    var selected: Dictionary = normals[original_path]
    var result = record.duplicate()
    result.normal = record.normal.duplicate()
    result.normal.region = record.normal.region.duplicate()
    result.normal.region.path = selected.path
    result.normal.receiving_qualification = selected.qualification
    result.normal.original_path = original_path
    return result

static func environment(row: Dictionary, quarter: int, cache: Dictionary, phase: int = 0, time: float = 0.0) -> Dictionary:
    # Live destroyed after-values and reconnected snapshots settle on the same
    # authored endpoint as native destruction playback. An explicit active
    # playback phase still selects its own intermediate samples.
    if phase==0 and row.get("destroyed",false): phase=2
    return texture_layout(receiving_normal(_environment_source(row,quarter,cache,phase,time),cache),cache)

static func _layout_region(region: Dictionary, layouts: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if not layouts.has(region.path): return region
    var layout: Dictionary = layouts[region.path]
    var rect: Array = region.rect
    var cell: Array = layout.cell
    var column = floori(float(rect[0])/cell[0])
    var row = floori(float(rect[1])/cell[1])
    var offset = Vector2i(int(rect[0])%int(cell[0]),int(rect[1])%int(cell[1]))
    # A source rectangle must remain entirely inside one unchanged source cell.
    # Reject invalid layouts instead of silently selecting the oversized source.
    if rect[0]<0 or rect[1]<0 or rect[2]<=0 or rect[3]<=0 or \
            offset.x+rect[2]>cell[0] or offset.y+rect[3]>cell[1] or \
            rect[0]+rect[2]>layout.source_size[0] or rect[1]+rect[3]>layout.source_size[1]: return {}
    var index: int = row*int(layout.source_columns)+column
    var result = region.duplicate()
    var local_index = index
    if layout.has("pages"):
        var per_page: int = layout.cells_per_page
        if per_page<=0: return {}
        var page = floori(float(index)/per_page)
        if page>=layout.pages.size(): return {}
        result.path = layout.pages[page]
        local_index = index%per_page
    else:
        # Existing version-one monolithic layouts remain valid until rebaked.
        result.path = layout.path
    result.rect = [(local_index%int(layout.columns))*int(cell[0])+offset.x,
        floori(float(local_index)/layout.columns)*int(cell[1])+offset.y,rect[2],rect[3]]
    return result

static func texture_layouts(cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    # Immutable source document owned by this catalog cache. A fresh catalog on
    # explicit Reload reads the new manifest; an existing world keeps its own.
    return environment_file(ENVIRONMENT + "texture_layouts.res", cache).layouts

static func texture_layout(record: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    if record.is_empty(): return record
    var layouts: Dictionary = texture_layouts(cache)
    var geometry: Dictionary = record.get("geometry_region",{})
    var normal: Dictionary = record.get("normal",{}).get("region",{})
    var remap_geometry = layouts.has(geometry.get("path",""))
    var remap_normal = layouts.has(normal.get("path",""))
    if not remap_geometry and not remap_normal: return record
    var result = record.duplicate()
    if remap_geometry:
        result.geometry_region = _layout_region(geometry,layouts)
        if result.geometry_region.is_empty():
            push_error("Invalid environment texture layout region: "+str(geometry))
            return {}
    if remap_normal:
        result.normal = record.normal.duplicate()
        result.normal.region = _layout_region(normal,layouts)
        if result.normal.region.is_empty():
            push_error("Invalid environment texture layout region: "+str(normal))
            return {}
    return result

static func _environment_source(row: Dictionary, quarter: int, cache: Dictionary, phase: int = 0, time: float = 0.0) -> Dictionary:
    var world = environment_world(cache)
    var direction: String = row.get("orientation", "east")
    var view = Placement.pose(direction, quarter)
    if row.kind == "resource": return environment_resources(cache).resources[row.asset]
    var bank_id = bank_for(row, phase > 0, cache)
    if not bank_id.is_empty():
        var bank = bank_data(bank_id, cache)
        view = pose_for(bank, direction, quarter)
        var index = environment_index(cache)
        if phase == 0 and row.kind == "prop" and index.rests.has(bank_id):
            # The rest pose shows the registered original art (the source's
            # rest_library); the reconstructed banks still play destruction.
            var library_id: String = index.rests[bank_id]
            var library = environment_file(index.library[library_id],cache)
            # Original sprite facing follows the existing Unity registration.
            # Reconstructed closed/open bank rays disagree on north/south and
            # must not select the original artwork's viewpoint.
            var original_view = Placement.pose(direction,quarter)
            for sample in library.samples:
                if sample.source_view != original_view: continue
                var original: Dictionary = sample.surface.duplicate(true)
                var rect: Array = sample.colour.rect
                original.merge({"path":sample.colour.path,"rect":rect,"native_size":[rect[2],rect[3]],
                    "pivot":sample.get("physical_source_contact_px",sample.pivot),"scale":sample.scale,
                    "frame":sample.frame_index,"bank":bank_id,"original_library":library_id})
                return original
        var frame = frame_at(bank, time) if phase == 1 else (int(bank.frame_count)-1 if phase == 2 else 0)
        var owner = owner_for(row,cache)
        if phase == 0 and row.kind == "trap": frame = int(owner.state_frames[row.get("state", "ready")])
        if phase == 0 and row.kind == "door" and row.get("state", "closed") != "closed": frame = int(bank.frame_count)-1
        var cell: Array = bank.cell
        var result: Dictionary = bank.surface_frames_by_pose[view][frame].duplicate(true)
        var region: Dictionary = bank.frames_by_pose[view][frame] if bank.has("frames_by_pose") else {"path":bank.path, "rect":[frame*cell[0],bank.rows.find(view)*cell[1],cell[0],cell[1]]}
        if row.kind == "door" and bank.has("leaf_path"):
            region = {"path":bank.leaf_path,"rect":[frame*cell[0],bank.rows.find(view)*cell[1],cell[0],cell[1]]}
        result.merge({"path":region.path, "rect":region.rect, "native_size":cell,
            "pivot":bank.get("physical_source_contact_by_pose", bank.pivots_by_pose)[view], "scale":bank.scale,
            "flat_ground":owner.get("flat_ground", false), "frame":frame, "bank":bank_id,
            "hidden":phase == 2 and bank.get("clear_at_end", false)})
        if phase == 0 and row.kind == "door" and bank.has("actor_depth") and bank.has("depth_frames_by_pose") and bank.has("ground_origins_by_pose"):
            # Legacy actor-depth is a separate RG16 little-endian painter-depth
            # registration, not the lighting packet's RG16BE ray depth. Split
            # this leaf around its own frame only; keep the authored contact.
            var registration: Dictionary = bank.actor_depth
            var depth_region: Dictionary = bank.depth_frames_by_pose[view][frame]
            result.door_partition = {"path":depth_region.path,"rect":depth_region.rect,
                "range":registration.depth_range,"cell":registration.cell,
                "scale":registration.pixels_per_unit_by_pose[view]*bank.scale,
                "offset":(bank.ground_origins_by_pose[view][1]-result.pivot[1])*bank.scale}
        if phase == 0 and owner.has("selection_masks_by_pose"):
            result.hit_mask = owner.selection_masks_by_pose[view]
        return result
    var views: Dictionary
    match row.kind:
        "terrain":
            if row.material == "water":
                var water = environment_resources(cache)
                var result: Dictionary = water.resources[water.water.mask].duplicate(true)
                result.water = water.water
                return result
            views = world.terrain[row.material]
        "wall":
            if row.boundaries.size() == 2:
                for candidate in world.wall_corner_faces:
                    var faces: Array = world.wall_corner_faces[candidate]
                    if row.boundaries.has(faces[0]) and row.boundaries.has(faces[1]):
                        # Source corner n is the right-hand junction, s the left.
                        # Authored face labels run opposite to sprite-view order.
                        view = Placement.POSES[posmod(quarter - Placement.POSES.find(candidate), 4)]
                views = world[row.material + "_wall_corner"]
            else:
                view = Placement.pose(row.boundaries[0], quarter)
                views = world[row.material + "_wall_straight"]
        "cliff":
            views = world.terrain_cliff.straight
            if row.get("boundaries", []).size() == 2:
                for candidate in world.terrain_cliff.corner_faces:
                    var faces: Array = world.terrain_cliff.corner_faces[candidate]
                    if row.boundaries.has(faces[0]) and row.boundaries.has(faces[1]):
                        view = Placement.POSES[posmod(Placement.POSES.find(candidate) + quarter, 4)]
                views = world.terrain_cliff.corner
    return environment_resources(cache).resources[views[view]]
```
