```gdscript
            if interval_end<=start:continue
            var sampled_owner:Dictionary=key.owner.duplicate()
            sampled_owner.end_ms=owner.end_ms
            for sample in NativePersistent.spatial_samples({id:sampled_owner},start,index.cache):
                var row={"id":life.id+":member:"+str(n)+":"+sample.id,"parent":life.id,
                    "kind":sample.kind,"label":str(sample.native_cue.role).capitalize(),
                    "start_ms":start,"end_ms":interval_end,"source_start_ms":sample.absolute_start_ms,
                    "owner":sampled_owner,"component":sample,"trace_track_id":sample.id,
                    "source":sample.source,"source_fps":sample.sample_hz,"status":sample.status,
                    "interval_causes":["event:"+str(key.source_event_uuid)] if not key.source_event_uuid.is_empty() else ["initial:"+str(id)],
                    "coverage":{"implementation":"resolved","source":sample.status,"prepared":"not_examined","rendered":"not_witnessed"}}
                index.rows.append(row)
                _persistent_native_channels(index.rows,row,sample)

static func _preview_states(output: Dictionary,state: Dictionary,actors: Dictionary,owners: Dictionary,at_ms: float,cache: Dictionary,source_event_uuid:String="")->void:
    for id in actors:
        var actor: Dictionary=actors[id]
        var resolved=Characters.resolve(actor,state,cache)
        if not resolved.ok or resolved.value==null:continue
        var row: Dictionary=resolved.value
        var rig:Dictionary=Compiler.Authoring.rigs(cache)[row.rig]
        var rest=Characters.rest_sample(actor,rig,cache)
        if not rest.ok:continue
        var pose={"rig":row.rig,"clip":rest.value.clip,"source_seconds":rest.value.source_seconds,
            "clock":"fixed" if actor.life_state in ["dead","dying","stable"] else "display"}
        var condition=Timeline.Conditions.pose(actor,row.rig,cache)
        if not condition.is_empty() and rig.clips.has(condition.clip):
            pose.clip=condition.clip;pose.clock="condition"
            pose.condition_pose=condition
            pose.owner_start_ms=owners.get(condition.condition_uuid,{}).get("start_ms",at_ms)
            pose.source_seconds=ConditionPose.source_seconds(condition,rig.clips[pose.clip],at_ms-pose.owner_start_ms)
        pose.fps=rig.clips[pose.clip].fps
        var local_owners={}
        for key in owners:
            if owners[key].actor_uuid==id:local_owners[key]=owners[key].duplicate()
        if not output.has(id):output[id]=[]
        output[id].append({"at_ms":at_ms,"actor":row,"actor_name":actor.get("name",""),"sampled_pose":pose,"pose_owner":condition.get("condition_uuid",""),"pose_actor":{"life_state":actor.life_state,"conditions":actor.get("conditions",[])},"condition_owners":local_owners,"source_event_uuid":source_event_uuid})

static func _observe_condition_history(history: Dictionary, intervals: Dictionary, parents: Dictionary,
        actors: Dictionary, at_ms: float, event: String, initial: bool=false)->void:
    for actor_id in actors:
        var live={}
        for condition in actors[actor_id].get("conditions",[]):
            var id: String=condition.condition_uuid
            live[id]=true
            if not history.has(id):parents[id]={"event_id":event,"cause_uuid":condition.get("event_uuid",""),"initial":initial}
            if not intervals.has(id):intervals[id]=[]
            var providers: Array=condition.get("state",{}).get("suppression_provider_uuids",[])
            var states: Array=intervals[id]
            if states.is_empty() or states[-1].providers!=providers or not is_inf(states[-1].end_ms):
                if not states.is_empty() and is_inf(states[-1].end_ms):states[-1].end_ms=at_ms
                states.append({"start_ms":at_ms,"end_ms":INF,"suppressed":not providers.is_empty(),
                    "providers":providers.duplicate(),"source_event":event})
        for owner in history.values():
            if owner.actor_uuid==actor_id and not live.has(owner.id) and intervals.has(owner.id):
                var states: Array=intervals[owner.id]
                if not states.is_empty() and is_inf(states[-1].end_ms):states[-1].end_ms=at_ms
                if is_inf(owner.end_ms):parents[owner.id].removal_event=event
    Timeline.Conditions.observe(history,actors,at_ms,initial)

static func restore(index: Dictionary, target_ms: float, token: Dictionary={}) -> RefCounted:
    var timeline = Timeline.new()
    var initial: Dictionary = index.initialization.duplicate()
    # Each playback owns mutable state containers. The retained prefix is immutable.
    initial.state = index.initialization.state.duplicate(true)
    timeline.accept(initial)
    var groups: Array = []
    for item in index.groups: groups.append(item.group)
    timeline.accept({"kind":"operation","groups":groups})
    for item in index.groups:
        if canceled(token): return null
        var boundary=minf(target_ms,item.start_ms+item.group.duration_ms)
        if boundary>timeline.display_ms: timeline.advance(boundary-timeline.display_ms)
        if boundary>=target_ms: break
    if canceled(token): return null
    timeline.advance(maxf(0.0,target_ms-timeline.display_ms))
    timeline.paused = true
    return timeline

static func restore_boundary(index:Dictionary,group_index:int,commit_prefix:int,token:Dictionary={})->RefCounted:
    # Diagnostic exact prefix, including several ordered cuts at one clock.
    # This truncated Timeline is for inspection; ordinary playback/seek uses
    # restore() and retains the complete future queue.
    if group_index<0 or group_index>=index.groups.size():return null
    var item:Dictionary=index.groups[group_index]
    if commit_prefix<0 or commit_prefix>item.group.commits.size():return null
    var prefix=index.duplicate();prefix.groups=index.groups.slice(0,group_index)
    var group:Dictionary=item.group.duplicate()
    group.commits=group.commits.slice(0,commit_prefix)
    group.operation_end=group.operation_end and commit_prefix==item.group.commits.size()
    prefix.groups.append({"start_ms":item.start_ms,"group":group})
    var at:float=item.start_ms+(group.commits.back().at_ms if not group.commits.is_empty() else 0.0)
    return restore(prefix,at,token)

static func step_time(index: Dictionary, row: Dictionary, time_ms: float, direction: int) -> float:
    var limit: float=index.get("presentation_end_ms",index.get("duration_ms",0.0))
    if not row.has("track"):
        var hz: float=row.get("source_fps",0)
        return clampf(time_ms+direction*1000.0/(hz if hz>0 else 60.0),0,limit)
    var track: Dictionary=row.track
    if (direction>0 and time_ms>=row.end_ms) or (direction<0 and time_ms<=row.start_ms):
        return clampf(time_ms+direction*1000.0/60.0,0,limit)
    var fps: float=row.get("source_fps",0)
    if fps<=0:
        fps=Compiler.Authoring.rigs(index.cache).get(track.rig,{}).get("clips",{}).get(track.clip,{}).get("fps",0)
    if fps<=0 or track.duration_ms<=0: return clampf(time_ms,0,limit)
    var keys: Array=track.get("source_time_keys",[[0.0,track.source_start_seconds],[1.0,track.source_end_seconds]])
    var fraction=clampf((time_ms-row.start_ms)/track.duration_ms,0,1)
    var current_frame=int(floor(Compiler.Tracks._source_at(keys,fraction)*fps))
    var result: float=row.end_ms if direction>0 else row.start_ms
    for i in range(1,keys.size()):
        var a: Array=keys[i-1];var b: Array=keys[i]
        if a[1]==b[1]: continue # a hold contains no source-frame transitions
        var first=int(ceil(minf(a[1],b[1])*fps))
        var last=int(floor(maxf(a[1],b[1])*fps))
        for frame in range(first,last+1):
            if frame==current_frame: continue
            var f=lerpf(a[0],b[0],inverse_lerp(a[1],b[1],frame/fps))
            var at: float=row.start_ms+f*track.duration_ms
            if direction>0 and at>time_ms+.000001: result=minf(result,at)
            elif direction<0 and at<time_ms-.000001: result=maxf(result,at)
    return clampf(result,0,limit)
```


### A.16 — `studio/replay_panes.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:studio/replay_panes.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Stable viewport owners for offline playback. Mutable render state is never shared.
const Play=preload("res://play.gd")
const BackgroundRelease=preload("res://presentation/background_release.gd")

static func viewport()->SubViewport:
    var view=SubViewport.new();view.size=Vector2i(1440,430);view.own_world_3d=true
    view.handle_input_locally=false;view.gui_disable_input=true
    view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
    return view

static func discard(pane:Dictionary)->void:
    if pane.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(pane.viewport):return
    pane.viewport.audio_listener_enable_3d=false
    if is_instance_valid(pane.world):
        pane.world.component_renderer.audio.set_enabled(false)
        pane.world.timeline.paused=true
        freeze(pane,true)
    # Its Play host's data is dropped on a worker after ordinary teardown.
    BackgroundRelease.release_after_exit(pane.viewport,[pane.get("index",{})])
    pane.viewport.queue_free()

static func freeze(pane:Dictionary,value:bool)->void:
    if pane.is_empty():return
    if value:
        if not pane.get("frozen",[]).is_empty():return
        pane.frozen=[]
        var views:Array=[pane.viewport]
        views.append_array(pane.viewport.find_children("*","SubViewport",true,false))
        for view in views:
            pane.frozen.append([view,view.render_target_update_mode])
            view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
        pane.world.process_mode=Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
    else:
        pane.world.process_mode=Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
        for item in pane.get("frozen",[]):
            if is_instance_valid(item[0]):item[0].render_target_update_mode=item[1]
        pane.frozen=[]

static func prepare(parent:Node,restored:RefCounted,source:Dictionary,reference:Node3D,
        spare:Dictionary,budget:int,share_sources:bool,retain_view:bool)->Dictionary:
    var pane={}
    if not spare.is_empty():
        if share_sources and is_same(spare.index,source):
            freeze(spare,false)
            spare.viewport.audio_listener_enable_3d=false
            spare.world.component_renderer.audio.set_enabled(false)
            if spare.world.try_reset_hidden_playback(restored):pane=spare
            else:discard(spare)
        else:discard(spare)
    var reused=not pane.is_empty()
    if not reused:
        var view=viewport();view.size=reference.get_viewport().size;parent.add_child(view)
        var host=Play.new();host.external_playback=true;host.external_clock=false
        host.component_renderer.audio.set_enabled(false)
        host.catalog_cache=Play.Catalog.source_snapshot(source.cache)
        host.media_warmup.budget_bytes=budget
        if share_sources:Play.MediaWarmup.share(host.media_warmup,reference.media_warmup)
        else:Play.MediaWarmup.physical(host.media_warmup).source_revision=Play.MediaWarmup.physical(reference.media_warmup).source_revision+1
        host.attach_media_sources()
        pane={"world":host,"viewport":view,"index":source,"frozen":[]}
    var owner:Node3D=pane.world
    owner.external_clock=false
    # Host rendering allowance is shared even during an authoring reload, when
    # source residency must deliberately remain independent.
    owner.preparation_admission=reference.preparation_admission
    Play.MediaWarmup.physical(owner.media_warmup).preparation_admission=reference.preparation_admission
    owner.native_startup_plan=source.native_startup_plan if source.has("native_startup_plan") else Play.NativeStartup.recording_plan(source.get("rows",[]))
    owner.native_startup_requested_ms=restored.display_ms
    owner.media_warmup.budget_bytes=budget
    owner.media_warmup.encounter_override=source.get("media_preload",{})
    if share_sources:
        owner.presentation_mutes=reference.presentation_mutes.duplicate()
        owner.presentation_solo=reference.presentation_solo.duplicate()
    owner.quarter=reference.quarter;owner.requested_quarter=reference.quarter
    owner.wall_mode=reference.wall_mode;owner.grid_visible=reference.grid_visible
    if not reused:pane.viewport.add_child(owner)
    owner.native_spell_hit_material=reference.native_spell_hit_material
    owner.camera.size=reference.camera.size if retain_view else 6.0
    owner.camera_focus=reference.camera_focus;owner.initial_focus=retain_view
    owner.playback_speed=reference.playback_speed
    owner.playback_end_ms=source.get("presentation_end_ms",source.duration_ms)
    owner.position_camera()
    if not reused:owner.install_playback(restored)
    pane.reused=reused
    return pane
```

### A.17 — `studio/study_catalog.gd`

Original: `9b73f29a849ac863fe528e5b16f9166e406768af:studio/study_catalog.gd`. Complete module, verbatim.


```gdscript
extends RefCounted
## Passive capability inventory. Expected work exists independently of playback.
const Audit=preload("res://studio/authoring_audit.gd")
const Conditions=preload("res://presentation/condition_coverage.gd")
const CONTENT="res://generated/studio_content_catalog.json"
const MIGRATION="res://generated/native_migration_inventory.json"
const SCENARIOS="res://authoring/studio/scenarios.json"
const SPELL_CASES="res://generated/studio_spell_case_inventory.json"

static func _read(path:String,cache:Dictionary,errors:Array)->Dictionary:
    var key="study:"+path
    if cache.has(key):return cache[key]
    if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
        errors.append("Study input missing: "+path);return {}
    var value=JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))
    if not value is Dictionary:
        errors.append("Study input is not an object: "+path);return {}
    cache[key]=value
    return value

static func _kind(entry:Dictionary)->String:
    var id:String=entry.id
    if id.begins_with("action.") or id.begins_with("reaction."):return "Action"
    if id.begins_with("spell."):return "Spell"
    if id.begins_with("condition."):return "Condition"
    return "Mechanic"

static func _entry(index:Dictionary,id:String,label:String,kind:String,source:String)->Dictionary:
    if not index.has(id):
        index[id]={"id":id,"label":label,"kind":kind,"source":source,"behavior_ids":[id] if kind in ["Action","Spell","Condition"] else [],
            "requirements":[],"scenarios":[]}
    return index[id]

static func _readable_label(entry:Dictionary)->String:
    var label:String=entry.label
    if label!=entry.id and not label.begins_with("action.") and not label.begins_with("condition.") and not label.begins_with("spell."):return label
    if entry.kind=="VFX":return label
    var parts=String(entry.id).split(".")
    var name=String(parts[-1]).replace("_"," ").capitalize()
    if parts.size()>3 and parts[1]=="class":name+=" · "+String(parts[2]).capitalize()
    return name

static func _requirements(entry:Dictionary,rows:Array)->void:
    var existing={}
    for row in entry.requirements:existing[row.id]=true
    for original in rows:
        if existing.has(original.id):continue
        var row:Dictionary=original.duplicate(true)
        row.label=row.get("label",str(row.get("phase",""))+" · "+str(row.get("mechanism",row.id)))
        row.rendered=false
        row.source=row.get("source",entry.source)
        row.reason=row.get("reason","")
        if not row.has("gap_kind"):
            if row.get("availability")=="missing":row.gap_kind="source"
            elif row.get("implementation")=="missing":row.gap_kind="renderer"
            elif row.get("status")=="explicit_none":row.gap_kind="explicit_none"
            else:row.gap_kind="unexercised"
        row.status=row.get("status","unexercised")
        entry.requirements.append(row);existing[row.id]=true

static func build(cache:Dictionary={},records:Array=[])->Dictionary:
    var errors:Array=[]
    var index={}
    var snapshot=_read(CONTENT,cache,errors)
    for n in snapshot.get("entries",[]).size():
        var definition:Dictionary=snapshot.entries[n]
        var kind:String={"action":"Action","reaction":"Action","spell":"Spell","condition":"Condition"}.get(definition.kind,"Mechanic")
        var entry=_entry(index,definition.id,definition.get("label",definition.id),kind,CONTENT+":/entries/"+str(n))
        entry.definition_ref=definition.get("definition_ref",{}).duplicate(true)
    var authored=Audit.build(cache)
    for original in authored.entries:
        var entry=_entry(index,original.id,original.label,_kind(original),original.source)
        entry.source=original.source
        _requirements(entry,original.requirements)
    var conditions=Conditions.build(cache)
    for original in conditions.entries:
        var entry=_entry(index,original.id,original.label,"Condition",original.source)
        # A legacy condition recipe may reuse an actual spell identity (False
        # Life). Keep its backend family while retaining both sets of sources.
        if entry.kind not in ["Action","Spell"]:
            entry.label=original.label;entry.source=original.source;entry.kind="Condition"
        entry.condition_source=original.source
        if original.id not in entry.behavior_ids:entry.behavior_ids.append(original.id)
        if original.has("indicator_assignments"):entry.indicator_assignments=original.indicator_assignments.duplicate(true)
        _requirements(entry,original.requirements)
    var migration=_read(MIGRATION,cache,errors)
    for n in migration.get("assets",[]).size():
        var asset:Dictionary=migration.assets[n]
        var entry=_entry(index,asset.asset_id,asset.asset_id,"VFX",MIGRATION+":/assets/"+str(n))
        var native:Dictionary=asset.get("native",{})
        entry.native=native.duplicate(true)
        entry.registration=asset.get("registration",{}).duplicate(true)
        var rows:Array=[]
        for ref in asset.get("references",[]):
            var enabled:bool=ref.get("enabled",true)
            var native_status:String=native.get("status","source_not_mapped")
            rows.append({"id":asset.asset_id+":"+str(ref.source),"label":str(ref.source),"source":ref.source,
                "status":"unexercised" if enabled else "explicit_none",
                "gap_kind":("unexercised" if native_status=="imported" else "native_migration") if enabled else "explicit_none",
                "reason":"Source assignment and native availability are separate from rendered evidence.",
                "native_status":native_status,"native_source_ids":native.get("source_ids",[]).duplicate(),
                "reference_kind":ref.get("kind",""),"gaps":asset.get("gaps",[]).duplicate(),"rendered":false})
        _requirements(entry,rows)
    var studies=_read(SCENARIOS,cache,errors)
    for n in studies.get("capabilities",[]).size():
        var definition:Dictionary=studies.capabilities[n]
        var entry=_entry(index,definition.id,definition.label,definition.get("kind","Mechanic"),definition.get("source",SCENARIOS+":/capabilities/"+str(n)))
        entry.label=definition.label
        for id in definition.get("behavior_ids",[]):
            if id not in entry.behavior_ids:entry.behavior_ids.append(id)
    var recorded={}
    for record in records:recorded[record.id]=record
    var counts={"capabilities":0,"actions":0,"spells":0,"conditions":0,"vfx":0,"mechanics":0,
        "scenarios":0,"recorded_scenarios":0,"partial_scenarios":0,"study_needed":0}
    var seen_scenarios={}
    var scenario_inputs:Array=[]
    for n in studies.get("scenarios",[]).size():
        var row:Dictionary=studies.scenarios[n].duplicate()
        row.source=SCENARIOS+":/scenarios/"+str(n)
        scenario_inputs.append(row)
    var spell_cases=_read(SPELL_CASES,cache,errors)
    for n in spell_cases.get("cases",[]).size():
        var record:Dictionary=spell_cases.cases[n]
        var source=SPELL_CASES+":/cases/"+str(n)
        scenario_inputs.append({"id":record.id,"code":record.spell_id,"label":record.label+" · "+record.interaction,
            "capability_ids":["spell."+record.spell_id],"source":source,
            "purpose":record.qualification,"setup":"Normal encounter spell grants; independent Amber and Blue public SDK recordings.",
            "sequence":record.get("sequence",[]),"participants":["caster","recipient"],
            "expectations":[{"id":record.id+":authority","label":"Preserve the recorded spell, recipient and owner outcomes",
                "phase":"Recorded sequence","participants":["caster","recipient"],"rule_sources":[source],
                "authority":"server","description":"The original event IDs, damage/heal after-values, and condition/spatial lifetimes remain inspectable. This case is not evidence for every variant or artistic approval.","source":source}],
            "recordings":[{"case_id":record.id,"evidence":"recorded","gaps":[],"reference":record.descriptor}],
            "coverage":{"recording":"recorded","native_render":"not_assessed_by_this_catalog","audio":"not_assessed_by_this_catalog"}})
    for original in scenario_inputs:
        if seen_scenarios.has(original.id):
            errors.append("Duplicate study scenario: "+str(original.id));continue
        seen_scenarios[original.id]=true
        var scenario:Dictionary=original.duplicate(true)
        scenario.source=original.source
        scenario.recordings=[]
        var available_recorded=false;var available_partial=false
        for reference in original.get("recordings",[]):
            var row:Dictionary=reference.duplicate(true)
            row.available=recorded.has(row.case_id)
            if row.available:
                row.record=recorded[row.case_id]
                available_recorded=available_recorded or row.get("evidence")=="recorded"
                available_partial=available_partial or row.get("evidence")=="partial"
            scenario.recordings.append(row)
        counts.scenarios+=1
        counts.recorded_scenarios+=int(available_recorded)
        counts.partial_scenarios+=int(available_partial)
        for id in scenario.get("capability_ids",[]):
            if not index.has(id):
                errors.append("Study scenario "+str(scenario.id)+" names undeclared capability "+str(id));continue
            index[id].scenarios.append(scenario)
    var capabilities:Array=index.values()
    for entry in capabilities:entry.label=_readable_label(entry)
    capabilities.sort_custom(func(a,b):
        if a.kind!=b.kind:return str(a.kind)<str(b.kind)
        if a.scenarios.is_empty()!=b.scenarios.is_empty():return not a.scenarios.is_empty()
        return str(a.label).nocasecmp_to(str(b.label))<0 if a.label!=b.label else str(a.id)<str(b.id))
    for entry in capabilities:
        counts.capabilities+=1
        var key:String={"Action":"actions","Spell":"spells","Condition":"conditions","VFX":"vfx","Mechanic":"mechanics"}.get(entry.kind,"mechanics")
        counts[key]+=1
        counts.study_needed+=int(entry.scenarios.is_empty())
    return {"capabilities":capabilities,"counts":counts,"errors":errors,
        "scope":"Current backend capabilities, authored requirements, condition owners and passive VFX inventory. Authored study sequences and available recordings are separate; source presence never proves rendered completion."}
```


### A.18 — `studio/study_library.gd`

```gdscript
extends Window
## A study exists independently of its recording and presentation implementation.
signal recording_selected(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary,record:Dictionary)
signal recording_unavailable
const Catalog=preload("res://studio/study_catalog.gd")
var report:Dictionary={}
var worker:Thread
var request:Dictionary={}
var generation=0
var installed_generation=-1
var search:LineEdit
var kind_picker:OptionButton
var tree:Tree
var title_label:Label
var purpose:Label
var sequence:RichTextLabel
var expectations:Tree
var requirements:Tree
var recording_picker:OptionButton
var open_button:Button
var recording_note:Label
var summary:Label
var selected_capability:Dictionary={}
var selected_scenario:Dictionary={}
var recording_options:Array=[]
var filtered:Array=[]
var pending_rows:Array=[]
var row_cursor=0
var preferred_id=""
var preferred_scenario=""
var refresh_pending=false
var error=""

func _ready()->void:
    title="Studio library · capabilities and study sequences"
    size=Vector2i(1140,680);min_size=Vector2i(820,500)
    close_requested.connect(hide)
    var outer=MarginContainer.new();outer.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT);add_child(outer)
    for side in ["left","right","top","bottom"]:outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_"+side,10)
    var box=VBoxContainer.new();outer.add_child(box)
    var tools=HBoxContainer.new();box.add_child(tools)
    kind_picker=OptionButton.new();tools.add_child(kind_picker)
    for kind in ["All","Action","Spell","Condition","Mechanic","VFX"]:kind_picker.add_item(kind)
    kind_picker.item_selected.connect(func(_i):refresh_pending=true)
    search=LineEdit.new();search.placeholder_text="Find a capability or interaction";search.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;tools.add_child(search)
    search.text_changed.connect(func(_text):refresh_pending=true)
    var copy=Button.new();copy.text="Copy study";tools.add_child(copy);copy.pressed.connect(copy_study)
    summary=Label.new();summary.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);box.add_child(summary)
    var split=HSplitContainer.new();split.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;box.add_child(split)
    tree=Tree.new();tree.hide_root=true;tree.columns=2;tree.column_titles_visible=true;tree.select_mode=Tree.SELECT_ROW;tree.allow_reselect=true
    tree.set_column_title(0,"Capability / interaction");tree.set_column_title(1,"Study / recording")
    tree.set_column_expand_ratio(0,3);tree.set_column_expand_ratio(1,2)
    tree.custom_minimum_size.x=350;tree.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_FILL;split.add_child(tree)
    tree.item_selected.connect(_selection)
    var details=VBoxContainer.new();details.custom_minimum_size.x=410;details.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;split.add_child(details)
    title_label=Label.new();title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",18);title_label.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;details.add_child(title_label)
    purpose=Label.new();purpose.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;purpose.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);details.add_child(purpose)
    var tabs=TabContainer.new();tabs.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;details.add_child(tabs)
    var study=VBoxContainer.new();study.name="Study sequence";tabs.add_child(study)
    sequence=RichTextLabel.new();sequence.custom_minimum_size.y=105;sequence.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;study.add_child(sequence)
    expectations=Tree.new();expectations.hide_root=true;expectations.columns=3;expectations.column_titles_visible=true
    for i in 3:expectations.set_column_title(i,["Phase","Participant","Expected presentation"][i])
    expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(0,1);expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(1,1);expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(2,3)
    expectations.custom_minimum_size.y=180;expectations.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;study.add_child(expectations)
    requirements=Tree.new();requirements.name="Authoring";requirements.hide_root=true;requirements.columns=2;requirements.column_titles_visible=true
    requirements.set_column_title(0,"Declared requirement");requirements.set_column_title(1,"Authoring / implementation")
    requirements.set_column_expand_ratio(0,3);requirements.set_column_expand_ratio(1,2);tabs.add_child(requirements)
    var recordings=HBoxContainer.new();details.add_child(recordings)
    recording_picker=OptionButton.new();recording_picker.fit_to_longest_item=false;recording_picker.clip_text=true;recording_picker.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;recordings.add_child(recording_picker)
    recording_picker.item_selected.connect(func(choice):_recording_changed(choice);open_selected_recording())
    open_button=Button.new();open_button.text="Open recording";open_button.disabled=true;recordings.add_child(open_button);open_button.pressed.connect(open_selected_recording)
    recording_note=Label.new();recording_note.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;recording_note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);details.add_child(recording_note)
    show_selection({}, {})

func open(cache:Dictionary,records:Array,capability_id:String="",scenario_id:String="")->void:
    generation+=1;preferred_id=capability_id;preferred_scenario=scenario_id
    request={"generation":generation,"cache":cache.duplicate(),"records":records}
    report={};error="";pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;tree.clear();show_selection({}, {})
    summary.text="Reading capability definitions, study sequences and authoring…"
    popup_centered(Vector2i(mini(1140,DisplayServer.window_get_size().x-40),mini(680,DisplayServer.window_get_size().y-40)))
    _start()

func _start()->void:
    if worker!=null or request.is_empty():return
    var job=request;request={};worker=Thread.new()
    var started=worker.start(_build.bind(job))
    if started!=OK:worker=null;error=error_string(started);summary.text=error

static func _build(job:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    return {"generation":job.generation,"report":Catalog.build(job.cache,job.records)}

func _process(_delta:float)->void:
    if worker!=null and not worker.is_alive():
        var result=worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
        if result.generation==generation:
            report=result.report;installed_generation=generation
            error="; ".join(report.get("errors",[]));refresh_pending=true
        _start()
    if refresh_pending and installed_generation==generation:
        refresh_pending=false;_filter()
    var started=Time.get_ticks_usec();var count=0
    while row_cursor<pending_rows.size() and count<24 and Time.get_ticks_usec()-started<2000:
        var entry:Dictionary=pending_rows[row_cursor];row_cursor+=1;count+=1
        var item=tree.create_item(entry.get("parent",tree.get_root()))
        item.set_text(0,entry.scenario.get("label",entry.capability.label));item.set_metadata(0,entry)
        if entry.scenario.is_empty():
            item.set_text(1,"Study needed" if entry.capability.scenarios.is_empty() else "%d studies"%entry.capability.scenarios.size())
            item.set_tooltip_text(0,str(entry.capability.id)+"\n"+str(entry.capability.get("source","")))
            item.collapsed=search.text.is_empty() and entry.capability.id!=preferred_id
            for scenario in entry.capability.scenarios:
                if search.text.is_empty() or _matches(entry.capability,scenario,search.text.to_lower()):
                    pending_rows.append({"capability":entry.capability,"scenario":scenario,"parent":item})
        else:
            item.set_text(1,recording_state(entry.scenario))
        if entry.capability.id==preferred_id and ((preferred_scenario.is_empty() and entry.scenario.is_empty()) or (not preferred_scenario.is_empty() and entry.scenario.get("id","")==preferred_scenario)):
            # Restoring a highlighted row is not a new user navigation request.
            tree.set_block_signals(true);item.select(0);tree.set_block_signals(false)
            show_selection(entry.capability,entry.scenario)
    if row_cursor==pending_rows.size() and not pending_rows.is_empty():pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0

func is_prepared()->bool:
    return installed_generation==generation and worker==null and request.is_empty() and pending_rows.is_empty() and not refresh_pending

static func _matches(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary,query:String)->bool:
    return query in (str(capability.id)+" "+str(capability.label)+" "+str(scenario.get("label",""))+" "+str(scenario.get("purpose",""))).to_lower()

func _filter()->void:
    filtered=[];pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;tree.clear();tree.create_item()
    show_selection({}, {})
    var kind=kind_picker.get_item_text(kind_picker.selected);var query=search.text.to_lower()
    for capability in report.get("capabilities",[]):
        if kind!="All" and capability.kind!=kind:continue
        if not query.is_empty() and not _matches(capability,{},query) and not capability.scenarios.any(func(s):return _matches(capability,s,query)):continue
        filtered.append(capability);pending_rows.append({"capability":capability,"scenario":{}})
    summary.text="%d capabilities · %d studies · %d need a study sequence"%[report.capabilities.size(),report.counts.scenarios,report.counts.study_needed]
    if not error.is_empty():summary.text+=" · Catalogue issues: "+error

static func recording_state(scenario:Dictionary)->String:
    var available=scenario.get("recordings",[]).filter(func(r):return r.get("available",false))
    if available.is_empty():return "Needs recording"
    return "Recorded" if available.any(func(r):return r.get("evidence")=="recorded") else "Partial recording"

func _selection()->void:
    var selected=tree.get_selected()
    if selected==null:return
    var data:Dictionary=selected.get_metadata(0)
    show_selection(data.capability,data.scenario)
    if data.scenario.is_empty():selected.collapsed=false
    elif not recording_options.is_empty():open_selected_recording()
    else:recording_unavailable.emit()

func show_selection(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary)->void:
    selected_capability=capability;selected_scenario=scenario
    title_label.text=scenario.get("label",capability.get("label","Choose a capability"))
    purpose.text=scenario.get("purpose", "Study sequences have not been authored yet." if not capability.is_empty() and capability.scenarios.is_empty() else "Select an interaction to inspect its sequence and expected presentation.")
    sequence.clear();expectations.clear();requirements.clear();recording_picker.clear();recording_options=[];open_button.disabled=true
    if scenario.is_empty():
        sequence.text="" if capability.is_empty() else "This capability remains visible independently of recordings or renderer support."
    else:
        var lines:Array[String]=[]
        var setup=scenario.get("setup","")
        if not str(setup).is_empty():lines.append("Setup: "+str(setup))
        for i in scenario.get("sequence",[]).size():lines.append(str(i+1)+". "+str(scenario.sequence[i]))
        sequence.text="\n".join(lines)
    var expected_root=expectations.create_item()
    for expected in scenario.get("expectations",[]):
        var item=expectations.create_item(expected_root)
        item.set_text(0,str(expected.get("phase","")));item.set_text(1,", ".join(expected.get("participants",[])));item.set_text(2,str(expected.label))
        var pointers=expected.get("authoring_sources",[])+expected.get("rule_sources",[])
        for i in 3:item.set_tooltip_text(i,str(expected.label)+"\n"+str(expected.get("description",""))+"\nParticipants: "+", ".join(expected.get("participants",[]))+"\n"+"\n".join(pointers))
        item.set_metadata(0,expected)
    var requirement_root=requirements.create_item()
    for requirement in capability.get("requirements",[]):
        var item=requirements.create_item(requirement_root)
        item.set_text(0,str(requirement.get("label",requirement.get("id",""))))
        var gap:String=requirement.get("gap_kind",requirement.get("status","unexercised"))
        var labels={"unexercised":"Assigned · unqualified","authoring_assignment":"Needs assignment","authoring_review":"Needs authoring decision","renderer":"Renderer missing","inspection":"Studio track missing","unassessed":"Not assessed","source":"Source missing","native_migration":"Native integration needed","explicit_none":"Explicitly disabled"}
        item.set_text(1,labels.get(gap,gap.replace("_"," ")))
        for i in 2:item.set_tooltip_text(i,str(requirement.get("source",""))+"\n"+str(requirement.get("reason","")))
        item.set_metadata(0,requirement)
    for binding in scenario.get("recordings",[]):
        if not binding.get("available",false):continue
        recording_options.append(binding)
        recording_picker.add_item(str(binding.record.label)+(" · partial" if binding.evidence=="partial" else ""))
    recording_picker.disabled=recording_options.is_empty()
    if recording_options.is_empty():
        recording_picker.add_item("No recording")
        recording_note.text="Record this sequence before evaluating its presentation." if not scenario.is_empty() else "Source assignments and a completed animation model are separate from a study sequence."
    else:_recording_changed(0)

func _recording_changed(choice:int)->void:
    open_button.disabled=choice<0 or choice>=recording_options.size()
    if open_button.disabled:return
    var selected:Dictionary=recording_options[choice]
    recording_note.text="\n".join(selected.get("gaps",[])) if selected.evidence=="partial" else "Recorded behavior; presentation implementation and visual qualification remain separate."

func open_selected_recording()->void:
    var i=recording_picker.selected
    if i<0 or i>=recording_options.size():return
    recording_selected.emit(selected_capability,selected_scenario,recording_options[i].record)
    hide()

func copy_study()->void:
    if selected_capability.is_empty():return
    var selected={"capability":selected_capability.id,"scenario":selected_scenario,"requirements":selected_capability.requirements}
    DisplayServer.clipboard_set(JSON.stringify(selected,"  "))

func _exit_tree()->void:
    if worker!=null:worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
```

```gdscript
func _queue(job:Dictionary,prepare_views:bool)->void:

func queue_prewarm(samples:Array)->Dictionary:

        if a.sample.sample_ms!=b.sample.sample_ms:return a.sample.sample_ms<b.sample.sample_ms

func _prewarm_group(row:Dictionary)->String:

    var clip:String=track.get("clip",row.get("selected_pose",{}).get("clip",row.get("sampled_pose",{}).get("clip","")))

func poll() -> bool:
    native_store.poll_retired()

                    active.configured=true;active.draws=0;active.drawn=false

        elif active.drawn:

            var next:Dictionary=pending.pop_front()

        if job.generation!=generation:return changed

            view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
            host.add_child(view)

func _start_native(job:Dictionary)->Dictionary:

func _sample_native(composite:Dictionary)->bool:
    # A live approach's constructor (tens to hundreds of ms for a condition
    # lifecycle) waits until the recording is paused, never during playback.
    if prewarm_suspended and composite.node.has_method("builds_live") and composite.node.builds_live():
        composite.started_ms=Time.get_ticks_msec();return false

    if not sampled.get("error","").is_empty():
        errors[composite.job.key]=sampled.error;requested.erase(composite.job.key);return true

        errors[composite.job.key]="Native source did not become ready within 15 seconds: "+str(composite.job.component.source_id)
        requested.erase(composite.job.key);return true

func _close_native(composite:Dictionary)->void:
    if composite.node is NativeSpellPreview and native_spares.size()<NATIVE_BATCH_LIMIT:
        composite.node.release();native_spares.append(composite.node);return

## Spell swatch viewports exist before playback: one parked swatch per frame
## until the batch size, while nothing else is queued.
func _prepare_spares()->void:
    if native_spares.size()+native_composites.size()>=NATIVE_BATCH_LIMIT or native_composites.size()>0:return
    var node:=NativeSpellPreview.new();host.add_child(node)
    node.configure_component({"finish_profile":{}})

## Spell swatch descriptors read their source files' stamps (tens of ms per
## spell). Resolve them when the recording is installed, not at first request.
func prepare_descriptors(rows:Array)->void:

        var component:Dictionary=row.get("component",{})
        if row.get("kind")!="native_effect" or not component.get("native_spell",false) or row.get("status")=="missing":continue

        if not native_descriptors.has(descriptor_key):native_descriptors[descriptor_key]=native_store.descriptor(component,maxf(1,hz))

func _primitive(job: Dictionary) -> void:
    var component: Dictionary=job.component

    view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE;host.add_child(view)

        label.add_theme_font_override("font",font);label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",component.style.fontSizePx)

func _compose(decoded: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var job: Dictionary=decoded.job
    var view=SubViewport.new();view.disable_3d=true;view.transparent_bg=true
    view.size=Vector2i(job.rig.cell_width,job.rig.cell_height);view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE;host.add_child(view)

        shader.set_shader_parameter("sheet",sprite.texture);shader.set_shader_parameter("frame_uv",Vector4(0,0,1,1))

        Palette.bind(shader,part.layer,job.facing,job.frame,aux,resources);Conditions.bind(shader,state,aux,resources)
        shader.set_shader_parameter("material_cell_size",Vector2(job.rig.cell_width,job.rig.cell_height))

        if job.scale_x<0: sprite.flip_h=true

func _composites_drawn()->void:
    for composite in composites:composite.drawn=true

func _drawn(key: String,epoch: int) -> void:
    if epoch==generation and not active.is_empty() and active.job.key==key: active.drawn=true

func _waveform(job: Dictionary) -> void:
    var record: Dictionary=Catalog.read_file("audio/waveforms.json",cache).get("clips",{}).get(job.row.component.get("clip"),{})
    if record.is_empty(): errors[job.key]="No decoded waveform";requested.erase(job.key);return
    var peaks: Array=record.peaks
    var output=Image.create_empty(peaks.size(),64,false,Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
    for x in peaks.size():
        var amplitude=clampi(roundi(peaks[x]*30),0,30)
        for y in range(32-amplitude,33+amplitude): output.set_pixel(x,y,Color("a1cfba"))
    _publish(job,output)

func _publish(job: Dictionary,output: Image) -> void:
    requested.erase(job.key)
    if job.generation!=generation or output==null or output.is_empty(): return
    if job.row.kind!="audio":
        var used=output.get_used_rect()
        if used.has_area():output=output.get_region(used.grow(3).intersection(Rect2i(Vector2i.ZERO,output.get_size())))
    var factor=minf(1.0,128.0/maxi(output.get_width(),output.get_height()))
    if factor<1:output.resize(maxi(1,roundi(output.get_width()*factor)),maxi(1,roundi(output.get_height()*factor)),Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
    _publish_texture(job.key,ImageTexture.create_from_image(output),output.get_data_size())

func _publish_texture(key:String,texture:Texture2D,bytes:int)->void:
    textures[key]=texture
    texture_bytes-=texture_sizes.get(key,0)
    texture_sizes[key]=bytes;texture_bytes+=bytes
    while textures.size()>limit or texture_bytes>texture_limit:
        var old=""
        for candidate in textures:
            if not pinned.has(candidate):old=candidate;break
        if old.is_empty():
            # Refuse an oversized visible demand explicitly instead of cycling
            # forever between missing pinned samples or growing without a cap.
            old=key;errors[key]="Visible source previews exceed the bounded thumbnail budget"
        texture_bytes-=texture_sizes[old];texture_sizes.erase(old);textures.erase(old)

func _clear_active() -> void:
    if active.has("node"):active.node.close();active.node.queue_free()
    if active.has("viewport"):active.viewport.queue_free()
    active={}

func reset() -> void:
    generation+=1;pending.clear();warm_pending.clear();warm_requested.clear();requested.clear();pinned.clear();textures.clear();texture_sizes.clear();texture_bytes=0;errors.clear();inactive.clear();cache.clear();_clear_active()
    for composite in native_composites:_close_native(composite)
    native_composites.clear()
    native_descriptors.clear();baked_requests.clear();native_store.reset()
    if RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.is_connected(_composites_drawn):RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.disconnect(_composites_drawn)
    for composite in composites:composite.viewport.queue_free()
    composites.clear()

func close() -> void:
    reset()
    for node in native_spares:
        if is_instance_valid(node):node.close();node.queue_free()
    native_spares.clear()
    if worker!=null:worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
    # Retired tracks drop their decoded source images on a worker, not in a frame.
    BackgroundRelease.release([images]);images={};image_bytes=0
```
