### A1. Complete original local row adapter — `9b73f29a:presentation/world.gd::rows` (reference; do not wholesale replace current content branches)

```gdscript
static func rows(state: Dictionary, cache: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var world = Catalog.environment_world(cache)
    var index = Catalog.environment_index(cache)
    var senses: Dictionary = state.get("senses",{}) if state.get("senses") != null else {}
    var result: Array = []
    var missing: Array = []
    for tile in state.tiles.values():
        var material: String = tile.surface.base_material
        if not world.terrain.has(material): missing.append("terrain:"+material); continue
        result.append({"id":tile.tile_uuid,"kind":"terrain","material":material,"position":tile.position,
            "base_height_steps":tile.elevation_steps,"layer":0,"orientation":"east","boundaries":[]})
    for id in state.objects:
        var object: Dictionary = state.objects[id]
        var place: Dictionary = object.placement
        var item: Dictionary = object.item
        var direction: String = place.get("boundary_direction") if place.get("boundary_direction") != null else (place.get("orientation") if place.get("orientation") != null else "east")
        var row = {"id":id,"position":place.position,"base_height_steps":place.base_height_steps,
            "orientation":direction,"boundaries":[direction] if place.kind=="boundary" else [],"layer":1,"item_id":item.item_id}
        if index.doors.has(item.item_id):
            var opened: bool = item.get("is_open",false)
            var swing: String = item.door_swing if item.get("door_swing") != null else "inward"
            if item.get("integrity")=="destroyed":
                # Destruction clears collision independently of the open flag.
                # The retained pre-destruction pose selects the authored wreck.
                var remnant: Dictionary = item.remnant_state if item.get("remnant_state") != null else {}
                opened = remnant.get("door_open",opened)
                if remnant.get("door_swing") != null: swing = remnant.door_swing
                row.destroyed = true
                row.outcome = item.destruction_outcome
            row.merge({"kind":"door","asset":item.item_id,"state":"open."+swing if opened else "closed"})
        elif index.props.has(item.item_id):
            var owner = index.props[item.item_id]
            # Prop owners name the backend field and use its JSON value as the
            # bank key (for example is_open -> "false" / "true" for chests).
            var mode := "default"
            if owner.has("state_field"):
                var value = item.get(owner.state_field)
                if value != null: mode = JSON.stringify(value) if value is bool else str(value)
            row.merge({"kind":"prop","asset":item.item_id,"state":mode})
        elif index.traps.has(item.item_id):
            row.merge({"kind":"trap","asset":item.item_id,"state":"activated" if item.get("is_engaged",false) else "ready"})
        elif item.get("boundary_structure") != null:
            var structure: Dictionary = item.boundary_structure
            # Doors and fences without art of their own draw the material's wall pieces (environment source stand-ins).
            if structure.structure in ["wall","retaining_wall","door","fence"] and world.has(structure.material+"_wall_straight"):
                row.merge({"kind":"wall","material":structure.material,"top_height_steps":place.top_height_steps})
            elif structure.structure in ["cliff","embankment"]:
                row.merge({"kind":"cliff","material":structure.material,"top_height_steps":place.top_height_steps})
            else: missing.append("structure:"+item.item_id); continue
        elif world.props.has(item.item_id):
            var prop: Dictionary = world.props[item.item_id]
            var views: Dictionary = prop.body_by_pose
            if prop.has("state_field") and item.get(prop.state_field,false): views = prop.get("active_body_by_pose",views)
            row.merge({"kind":"resource","views":views,"asset":views.e})
            if prop.has("lit_animation") and item.get("is_lit") == true and senses.get("objects",{}).get(id,{}).get("visual",false):
                row.lit_animation = prop.lit_animation
        else:
            missing.append("object:"+item.item_id)
            continue
        if item.get("integrity")=="destroyed" and row.kind in ["prop","wall"]:
            row.destroyed = true
            if item.get("destruction_outcome") != null: row.outcome = item.destruction_outcome
        result.append(row)
    return {"rows":result,"visual_rows":join_walls(result,world),"unresolved":missing}
```


### A2. Corrected complete mask-owner/residue closure — Astra correction 2, 22 October

The earlier A2 candidate decoded the entire encoded mask once **per residue request**. Neighbor-only lookup therefore did not remove the full byte decode from repeated local row calls. This revision reuses decoded bytes through the **existing** `World._mask_views`/`_mask_mutex` owner, with its existing four-entry FIFO bound and exact immutable mask identity. No second cache/index/owner is added.

Existing declarations remain exactly:

```gdscript
static var _mask_views:Array=[]
static var _mask_mutex:=Mutex.new()
```

Replace `visible_positions` in full and add `visible_mask_bytes` in the same module. Both attach bytes/optional read-only points to those same existing entries under the existing mutex. A residue-only lookup decodes bytes without materializing every visible point. A later ordinary all-points request reuses those bytes and preserves `Cells.mask_points`' exact x-then-y order. If the points request comes first, the residue lookup reuses its bytes. PackedByteArray returns use value/COW semantics; callers only read them. Capacity eviction can require a later decode, so the claim is one decode **per resident immutable-mask entry**, not permanent global residency.

### A2a. Complete proposed `presentation/world.gd::visible_positions`

```gdscript
static func visible_positions(state:Dictionary)->Array:
    var senses:Variant=state.get("senses")
    if senses==null:return []
    var mask:Dictionary=senses.get("visible",{})
    _mask_mutex.lock()
    var view:Dictionary={}
    for entry in _mask_views:
        if is_same(entry.mask,mask):view=entry;break
    if view.is_empty():
        view={"mask":mask}
        _mask_views.append(view)
        if _mask_views.size()>4:_mask_views.pop_front()
    if not view.has("points"):
        if not view.has("data"):view.data=Cells.bytes(mask.get("bits",""))
        var data:PackedByteArray=view.data
        var points:Array=[];var height:int=int(mask.get("height",0))
        # Exact Cells.mask_points ordering, borrowing the same decoded bytes
        # already retained for bounded neighbor queries when available.
        for i in range(int(mask.get("width",0))*height):
            if i/8<data.size() and (int(data[i/8])&(1<<(i%8)))!=0:
                points.append([int(mask.get("x0",0))+i/height,int(mask.get("y0",0))+i%height])
        points.make_read_only();view.points=points
    var result:Array=view.points
    _mask_mutex.unlock()
    return result
```

### A2b. Complete proposed `presentation/world.gd::visible_mask_bytes`

```gdscript
static func visible_mask_bytes(mask:Dictionary)->PackedByteArray:
    # Extend the existing four-entry immutable-mask owner. Do not create a
    # second population/cache or decode this whole mask for each residue row.
    _mask_mutex.lock()
    var view:Dictionary={}
    for entry in _mask_views:
        if is_same(entry.mask,mask):view=entry;break
    if view.is_empty():
        view={"mask":mask}
        _mask_views.append(view)
        if _mask_views.size()>4:_mask_views.pop_front()
    if not view.has("data"):view.data=Cells.bytes(mask.get("bits",""))
    var result:PackedByteArray=view.data
    _mask_mutex.unlock()
    return result
```

### A2c. Complete proposed `presentation/world.gd::residue_projection`

```gdscript
static func residue_projection(state:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->Array:
    var tiles:Dictionary=state.get("tiles",{})
    if tiles.is_empty():return []
    var profiles:Dictionary=Catalog.environment_index(cache).get("floor_residue_sources",{})
    if profiles.is_empty():return []
    var selected:Array=[]
    for key in tiles:
        for residue in tiles[key].get("residues",[]):
            if profiles.has(residue.residue_id) and float(residue.amount)>0.0 and residue.get("condition_uuid")!=null:
                selected.append(key)
                break
    if selected.is_empty():return []
    var senses:Variant=state.get("senses")
    var mask:Dictionary=senses.get("visible",Cells.EMPTY) if senses!=null else Cells.EMPTY
    # Exact Cells.contains bit addressing. The existing mask-view owner
    # decodes each immutable mask once while it remains in that bounded owner.
    var data:PackedByteArray=visible_mask_bytes(mask)
    var height:int=int(mask.get("height",0));var width:int=int(mask.get("width",0))
    var visible:Dictionary={}
    for key in selected:
        var position:Array=tiles[key].position
        for dx in [-1,0,1]:
            for dy in [-1,0,1]:
                if dx==0 and dy==0:continue
                var point:Array=[position[0]+dx,position[1]+dy]
                var x:int=int(point[0])-int(mask.get("x0",0))
                var y:int=int(point[1])-int(mask.get("y0",0))
                if x<0 or y<0 or x>=width or y>=height:continue
                var index:int=x*height+y
                if index/8<data.size() and (int(data[index/8])&(1<<(index%8)))!=0:
                    visible[cell_key(point)]=point
    var result:Array=[]
    for key in selected:result.append_array(residue_tile_rows(state,key,profiles,visible))
    return result
```

### A3. Corrected complete environment tile-removal closure — Astra correction 1, 22 October

Timeline/world dirty propagation alone is insufficient. Current `EnvironmentMedia.plan` and `finish_handoff` ignore `tiles_removed`; the retained source-selector/support index can therefore retain deleted terrain, residue source paths and tile-only spatial support while still naming the exact final canonical state as `final_owner`.

The full candidate closure below adds an optional trailing `_update(..., tiles_removed:Array=[])` parameter, preserving the existing six-argument helper API for any independent callers. Every production internal call is shown in the full functions: initial synchronization, group commits and handoff-tail commits. All delete `index.tiles`, `index.tile_sources` and `index.tile_paths` **before** final tile after-values. The same `index.tiles` is the actual support input to the unchanged spatial projection; there is no separate environment support cache to leave stale. Canonical objects with independent public object-anchor support are not fabricated away merely because a floor tile leaves.

Both pure-removal guards now admit the delta. This sets `applied_world_delta` for partial planning and prevents false `final_owner=origin_state` certification after an actual removal. `finish_handoff` clears the previous proof before applying its remaining canonical tail and publishes the supplied final canonical owner only after all admitted tail changes and the final path union are processed. The MediaWarmup caller already supplies `final_state` to `plan` only when `tail_groups` is empty, then calls `finish_handoff` on the actual remaining groups; that existing API and scheduling remain unchanged.

**Two different lifetimes stay distinct:** remove paths from the retained *final selector index*, never subtract them from immutable `required`, `upcoming` or an earlier `_timeline` entry that already needs them for an earlier cut in this operation. Those operation unions remain monotonic via the existing `_extend_paths`/`_first_use`/`_timeline` functions. A later group's initial `_all_paths` and the next operation's `final_owner` fast path see the actual deletion. Read-only path snapshots are replaced, not mutated. All source-role/fixture/path-record bookkeeping stays unchanged.

### A3a. Complete proposed `presentation/environment_media.gd::_update`

```gdscript
static func _update(index: Dictionary, tiles: Dictionary, objects: Dictionary, removed: Array,
        senses: Variant, cache: Dictionary, tiles_removed:Array=[]) -> Dictionary:
    var changed_paths = {}
    var contacts: Dictionary = senses.get("objects",{}) if senses != null else {}
    var cells = {}
    var floor_residues:Dictionary=Catalog.environment_index(cache).get("floor_residue_sources",{})
    # Erasure precedes final after-values, matching Compiler.apply_delta.
    # index.tiles is also the support map passed to spatial_projection below.
    for key in tiles_removed:
        index.tiles.erase(key)
        index.tile_sources.erase(key)
        index.tile_paths.erase(key)
        index.paths_dirty=true
    for key in tiles:
        var tile: Dictionary = tiles[key]
        var material: String = tile.surface.base_material
        index.tiles[key] = tile
        var residues:Array=[]
        for residue in tile.get("residues",[]):
            if floor_residues.has(residue.residue_id) and float(residue.amount)>0.0 and residue.get("condition_uuid")!=null:
                residues.append(residue.residue_id)
        # Terrain and authored residue atlases are selected by actual tile
        # after-values. Amount, support and neighbor masks change no file path.
        var selector:String=JSON.stringify([material,residues])
        if index.tile_sources.get(key)==selector: continue
        index.paths_dirty=true
        index.tile_sources[key] = selector
        var paths = {}
        _collect({"tiles":{key:tiles[key]},"objects":{},"senses":senses},paths,cache)
        index.tile_paths[key] = paths
        changed_paths.merge(paths)
        index.changed_row_builds += 1
    for id in removed:
        if not index.objects.has(id): continue
        var old_cell = _cell(index.objects[id])
        cells[old_cell] = true
        index.cells[old_cell].erase(id)
        index.objects.erase(id); index.visual.erase(id)
    for id in objects:
        var visual = contacts.get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
        if index.objects.get(id)==objects[id] and index.visual.get(id)==visual: continue
        if index.objects.has(id):
            var old_cell = _cell(index.objects[id])
            index.cells[old_cell].erase(id); cells[old_cell] = true
        var cell = _cell(objects[id])
        if not index.cells.has(cell): index.cells[cell] = {}
        index.cells[cell][id] = objects[id]
        index.objects[id] = objects[id]; index.visual[id] = visual
        cells[cell] = true
    # Sense-only commits can switch a registered fixture animation. No terrain
    # or wall-source selection depends on the full visible-tile list.
    if index.contacts != contacts:
        for id in index.objects:
            var visual = contacts.get(id,{}).get("visual",false)
            if index.visual.get(id)==visual: continue
            index.visual[id] = visual; cells[_cell(index.objects[id])] = true
    index.contacts = contacts;index.senses=senses
    var spatial_paths:Dictionary={}
    var spatial:Dictionary=WorldRows.spatial_projection({"tiles":index.tiles,"objects":index.objects,"senses":senses},cache)
    for row in spatial.rows:spatial_paths.merge(world_media_paths(row,cache))
    if index.get("spatial_paths",{}).keys()!=spatial_paths.keys():
        spatial_paths.make_read_only();index.spatial_paths=spatial_paths;index.paths_dirty=true
    changed_paths.merge(spatial_paths)
    for cell in cells:
        var members: Dictionary = index.cells[cell]
        if members.is_empty():
            index.cells.erase(cell)
            if index.cell_paths.erase(cell):index.paths_dirty=true
            continue
        var paths = {}
        _collect({"tiles":{},"objects":members,"senses":senses},paths,cache)
        var previous:Dictionary=index.cell_paths.get(cell,{})
        if previous.keys()!=paths.keys():
            paths.make_read_only();index.cell_paths[cell]=paths;index.paths_dirty=true
        changed_paths.merge(paths)
        index.changed_row_builds += members.size()
    return changed_paths
```

### A3b. Complete proposed `presentation/environment_media.gd::plan`

```gdscript
static func plan(state: Dictionary, groups: Array, cache: Dictionary, origin_state: Dictionary = {}, final_state: Dictionary = {}, partial: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
    var required = {}
    var upcoming = {}
    var environment_timeline = {}
    if state.is_empty(): return {"required":required,"upcoming":upcoming,"fixtures":{},"disclosed":{},"environment_timeline":environment_timeline,
        "required_records":[],"upcoming_records":[],"source_sizes":{},"source_headers":{}}
    var phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
    var phases = {"initial_update":0.0,"all_paths":0.0,"commit_updates":0.0}
    var index = _index(cache)
    index.plans += 1
    # Only the session's immutable canonical owner can prove continuity. A
    # shallow worker snapshot alone cannot prove the previous full operation
    # was planned. Optional/non-session/interleaved plans invalidate this proof.
    var skip_initial: bool = groups.size()<=2 and not origin_state.is_empty() and is_same(index.get("final_owner",{}),origin_state)
    index.erase("final_owner")
    var senses: Variant = state.senses
    if not skip_initial:
        var removed_tiles:Array=[]
        for key in index.tiles:
            if not state.tiles.has(key):removed_tiles.append(key)
        var removed: Array = []
        for id in index.objects:
            if not state.objects.has(id): removed.append(id)
        _update(index,state.tiles,state.objects,removed,senses,cache,removed_tiles)
    phases.initial_update = (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
    required = _all_paths(index)
    phases.all_paths += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    var disclosed: Dictionary = required
    var applied_world_delta:bool=false
    for group_index in range(groups.size()):
        var paths: Dictionary = required if group_index==0 else upcoming
        var initial: Dictionary = disclosed
        if group_index>0:
            phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
            initial = _all_paths(index)
            paths=_extend_paths(paths,initial)
            phases.all_paths += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
        phase_started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
        var group: Dictionary = groups[group_index]
        var first_use = {}
        for component in group.get("components",[]):
            if component.get("kind")!="world_activation" or component.get("status")=="missing":continue
            var component_paths:Dictionary=world_media_paths(component,cache)
            paths=_extend_paths(paths,component_paths)
            _first_use(initial,first_use,component_paths,float(component.get("start_ms",0.0)))
        for key in group.get("staged_tiles",{}):
            if not index.tiles.has(key):
                var staged_paths = {}
                _collect({"tiles":{key:group.staged_tiles[key]},"objects":{},"senses":senses},staged_paths,cache)
                paths=_extend_paths(paths,staged_paths)
                _first_use(initial,first_use,staged_paths,float(group.get("staged_tile_at_ms",{}).get(key,0.0)))
        for commit in group.get("commits",[]):
            var delta: Dictionary = commit.delta
            if delta.get("tiles",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("tiles_removed",[]).is_empty() and delta.get("objects",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects_removed",[]).is_empty() and not delta.get("set",{}).has("senses"): continue
            applied_world_delta=true
            senses = delta.get("set",{}).get("senses",senses)
            # Existing paths were included at group entry. Add only changed
            # closures, preserving the exhaustive within-group union.
            var changed_paths = _update(index,delta.get("tiles",{}),delta.get("objects",{}),delta.get("objects_removed",[]),senses,cache,delta.get("tiles_removed",[]))
            paths=_extend_paths(paths,changed_paths)
            _first_use(initial,first_use,changed_paths,float(commit.get("at_ms",0.0)))
        if group.has("id"): environment_timeline[group.id] = _timeline(initial,first_use)
        if group_index==0:required=paths
        else:upcoming=paths
        phases.commit_updates += (Time.get_ticks_usec()-phase_started)/1000.0
    if groups.size()<=2 and not final_state.is_empty() and not origin_state.is_empty(): index.final_owner = final_state
    elif partial and not origin_state.is_empty() and not applied_world_delta:
        # Initial synchronization establishes this exact canonical origin.
        # Staged source enumeration does not advance the index; the full
        # continuation can reuse it without walking the room again.
        index.final_owner=origin_state
    var fixtures = {}
    required.make_read_only();upcoming.make_read_only()
    for paths in [required,upcoming]:
        for path in paths:
            if cache.get("__live_fixture_frames",{}).has(path): fixtures[path] = true
    # The same producer owns finite physical source-role refs. An opening cut
    # borrows the previous complete map; only full continuation retires extras.
    var previous:Dictionary=cache.get("__environment_source_records",{})
    var retained:Dictionary=previous.duplicate() if partial else {}
    var reuse:Dictionary={"previous":cache.get("__environment_source_sets",[]),"current":[],"fixture_revision":int(cache.get("__live_fixture_revision",0)),"cache":cache}
    var required_set:Dictionary=_role_records(required,fixtures,previous,retained,reuse)
    var upcoming_set:Dictionary=_role_records(upcoming,fixtures,previous,retained,reuse)
    cache.__environment_source_sets=reuse.current
    var sizes:Dictionary=required_set.source_sizes
    var headers:Dictionary=required_set.source_headers
    if not upcoming_set.paths.is_empty():
        var previous_sizes:Dictionary=required_set.get("size_union",{})
        if is_same(previous_sizes.get("upcoming"),upcoming_set.source_sizes):
            sizes=previous_sizes.value;headers=previous_sizes.headers
        else:
            sizes=sizes.duplicate();sizes.merge(upcoming_set.source_sizes);sizes.make_read_only()
            headers=headers.duplicate();headers.merge(upcoming_set.source_headers);headers.make_read_only()
            required_set.size_union={"upcoming":upcoming_set.source_sizes,"value":sizes,"headers":headers}
    retained.make_read_only();cache.__environment_source_records=retained
    return {"required":required,"upcoming":upcoming,"required_records":required_set.records,"upcoming_records":upcoming_set.records,"source_sizes":sizes,"source_headers":headers,
        "required_family":required_set.family,"upcoming_family":upcoming_set.family,
        "fixtures":fixtures,"disclosed":disclosed,"environment_timeline":environment_timeline,
        "diagnostics":{"plans":index.plans,"changed_row_builds":index.changed_row_builds,"skipped_initial":skip_initial,"phases":phases}}
```

### A3c. Complete proposed `presentation/environment_media.gd::finish_handoff`

```gdscript
static func finish_handoff(groups:Array,final_state:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->void:
    if final_state.is_empty():return
    # The selected display prefix has its own immutable source cuts. Advance
    # only remaining authoritative world deltas in this private selector index
    # so the next operation can borrow its exact canonical starting owner.
    var index:Dictionary=_index(cache)
    index.erase("final_owner")
    var senses:Variant=index.senses
    for group in groups:
        for commit in group.get("commits",[]):
            var delta:Dictionary=commit.delta
            if delta.get("tiles",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("tiles_removed",[]).is_empty() and delta.get("objects",{}).is_empty() and delta.get("objects_removed",[]).is_empty() and not delta.get("set",{}).has("senses"):continue
            senses=delta.get("set",{}).get("senses",senses)
            _update(index,delta.get("tiles",{}),delta.get("objects",{}),delta.get("objects_removed",[]),senses,cache,delta.get("tiles_removed",[]))
    # Retain the selected final source union with its private canonical owner.
    # The next operation borrows it; it does not rebuild a room-sized union on
    # the opening path merely because this operation changed a few cells.
    _all_paths(index)
    index.final_owner=final_state
```

**Current caller closure (unchanged existing MediaWarmup functions):** `_plan_sources` at `presentation/media_warmup.gd:802–816` passes `request.final_state` to `EnvironmentMedia.plan` only when `tail_groups` is empty; its later `finish_handoff(tail, request.final_state, cache)` handles the remaining authoritative groups. No new callback, queue or readiness gate is introduced. `_update` has exactly three internal production call sites in the inspected source, all included above. `_all_paths` still rebuilds only when `paths_dirty` is set.

**Future assertions in the existing grouped metadata/fold/world cohort — not tests added or run here:**

- A pure removal (no tile/object after-value and no new senses) deletes all three retained tile fields, drops tile-only spatial support, marks paths dirty, and cannot be certified as unchanged partial origin.
- Earlier same-operation source use remains in `required`/the appropriate `upcoming` union and first-use schedule; final selector state and the next operation exclude the deleted unique path. Shared paths still required by other tiles/objects remain.
- Removal in the unselected handoff tail is consumed before `final_owner` publication; the next exact-origin fast path matches a fresh canonical final-state planner. Empty tail keeps the already-planned same final state; unknown/empty final state never creates a proof.
- Removal plus same-key after-value reselects only the final terrain/residue closure; ordered semantic re-entry still comes from the B1 fold/order proposal, not a guessed source path.
- Tile-independent actual object-anchor support remains valid; absent tile-only support is not borrowed from old `index.tiles` or future staged tiles.
- Repeated residue requests for the same resident immutable mask borrow the existing bytes without a new decode or full point population. Point-first and byte-first sequences produce exact unchanged bit membership/point order. A new mask identity with changed bits cannot borrow stale bytes; the existing four-entry bound and mutex protect concurrent ownership.
- Existing real Gallery exhaustive/path/source-role fixture controls remain. Its current `exhaustive` helper omits tile removals too, so future removal assertions must apply actual removals in that independent oracle before claiming parity; they must not regenerate expectations from this candidate.

These 22-October additions received independent SOURCE CLEAR for this exact A2/A3 closure after review against current World/Cells/EnvironmentMedia/MediaWarmup call sites. This is not parser, runtime or performance qualification. Prior 21-October evidence is not promoted. No product code, tests, jobs or saved runtime receipts changed.

The separate new `EnvironmentMedia._update` full spatial projection runs once per admitted update, rather than once per tiny `_collect`; its exclusive cost/nonempty Gallery workload was not measured. Do **not** delete it or gate it on an arbitrary object/visible-mask identity: source admission can depend on real current effect cells, support and exact object observations. First restore A2. A later exact metadata-input equality route must name the full current dependency tuple before replacing that once-per-update projection. Original contacts-changed iteration already existed at baseline and is not a newly introduced scan.

## B. Canonical fold: recover incident capture and actual mutation order

### B1. Existing sparse world repair stays

`24a993f0` already removed per-update full tile/object before/after scans by remembering only first preimages at existing mutation sites. Keep it. Baseline schema-14 `apply_world_update` is not a legal whole-function transplant: schema 16 has entered replacement, `tiles_removed`, item records, object membership, construction suppression and residue rows.

There remains an order seam: a held key erased and then re-added in one update has a final after-value but its canonical Dictionary insertion order changes. Final-value-only keyed output cannot reconstruct that change. Existing Timeline also omits removed tile dirty keys in two paths. The candidate carries actual mutation edges on **the existing internal transition delta**, using the same `{kind,id,remove}` shape already consumed by `world_changes.order`. This is not a new wire field or a persistent index. It keeps actual key chronology and exact final after-value references. Nothing is emitted from a failed private fold.

Complete closure: `_object`, `fold`, `Transitions.capture_delta`, `Compiler.apply_delta`, Timeline `_record_world_changes`, `_append_membership_order`, `_advance_immediate`, `_world_candidate`. Unchanged `_contents/_tiles` touched-preimage helpers remain required and are not rolled back. The order is derived at real writes, never inferred later from a recomputed full store.


### B1a. Proposed `sdk/fold_world.gd::_object`

```gdscript
static func _object(target:Dictionary,row:Dictionary,prior_objects:Dictionary,order:Array=[])->Dictionary:
    var identity:String=row.item_uuid;var previous:Variant=target.objects.get(identity);var members:Variant=row.members
    if members==null:
        if target.audience.observers.size()!=1:return failure("A seat with several observers names the members of each object row")
        members=1
    if not target.static.object_looks.has(identity):return failure("An object's first row requires its look")
    var at=placement(identity,row.placement,target.static.tiles) if row.placement!=null else success(previous.placement if previous!=null else null)
    if not at.ok:return at
    if at.value==null:return failure("An object's first row requires its placement")
    var item=floor_item(target.static.object_looks[identity],row.state,target.static.boundary_structures)
    if not item.ok:return item
    var merged=_merged_faces(previous.item.surface_residues if previous!=null else [],item.value.surface_residues,row.observed_faces)
    if not merged.ok:return merged
    item.value.surface_residues=merged.value
    var suppressions:Array=item.value.construction_suppressions.duplicate();var providers={}
    for value in suppressions:providers[value.provider_uuid]=true
    for value in previous.item.construction_suppressions if previous!=null else []:
        if not providers.has(value.provider_uuid):suppressions.append(value)
    item.value.construction_suppressions=suppressions
    if not prior_objects.has(identity):prior_objects[identity]=previous
    if previous==null:order.append({"kind":"objects","id":identity,"remove":false})
    target.objects[identity]={"placement":at.value,"item":item.value,"contained_items":previous.contained_items if previous!=null else null};target.object_members[identity]=members
    return success(target)
```


### B1b. Proposed `sdk/fold_world.gd::fold`

```gdscript
static func fold(target:Dictionary,update:Dictionary,disclosed:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    # Keep only the first value of rows this update actually writes or erases.
    # Final comparison handles repeated writes and remove/re-add without
    # copying or diffing the unrelated retained tile/object stores.
    var prior_tiles:Dictionary={};var prior_objects:Dictionary={};var order:Array=[]
    var result=static_rows(target,update)
    if not result.ok:return result
    for identity in update.get("objects_removed",[]):
        if not prior_objects.has(identity):prior_objects[identity]=target.objects.get(identity)
        if not target.objects.erase(identity):return failure("An object removal names an object the client holds")
        target.object_members.erase(identity)
        order.append({"kind":"objects","id":identity,"remove":true})
    for identity in update.get("connectors_removed",[]):
        if not target.connectors.erase(identity):return failure("A connector removal names a connector the client holds")
    var entered=Cells.point_set(Cells.mask_points(update.get("entered",{})))
    if not entered.is_empty():
        var unchanged=Cells.point_set(Cells.mask_points(update.get("tiles_unchanged",{})));var kept={}
        for key in unchanged:
            if not entered.has(key) or not target.tiles.has(key):return failure("An unchanged tile is an entered cell the client holds")
        for identity in update.get("objects_unchanged",[]):
            if not target.objects.has(identity):return failure("An unchanged object is one the client holds")
            kept[identity]=true
        for key in entered:
            if not unchanged.has(key) and target.tiles.has(key):
                if not prior_tiles.has(key):prior_tiles[key]=target.tiles[key]
                target.tiles.erase(key)
                order.append({"kind":"tiles","id":key,"remove":true})
        var tiles=tile_columns(update.get("tile_columns"),target.static.tiles,target.static.tile_looks)
        if not tiles.ok:return tiles
        for key in tiles.value:
            if not entered.has(key) or unchanged.has(key):return failure("Tile columns describe entered cells only, none of them unchanged")
            if not prior_tiles.has(key):prior_tiles[key]=target.tiles.get(key)
            if not target.tiles.has(key):order.append({"kind":"tiles","id":key,"remove":false})
            target.tiles[key]=tiles.value[key]
        var resent:Array=update.objects.item_uuids if update.get("objects")!=null else []
        for identity in target.objects.keys():
            var held:Dictionary=target.objects[identity];var touched=false
            for key in support_cells(held.placement):
                if entered.has(key):touched=true;break
            if not identity in resent and not kept.has(identity) and touched:
                if not prior_objects.has(identity):prior_objects[identity]=held
                target.objects.erase(identity);target.object_members.erase(identity)
                order.append({"kind":"objects","id":identity,"remove":true});continue
            var suppressions:Array=[];var changed=false
            for row in held.item.construction_suppressions:
                var points:Array=[]
                for point in row.positions:
                    if entered.has(Cells.key(point)):changed=true
                    else:points.append(point)
                var next:Dictionary=row.duplicate();next.positions=points;suppressions.append(next)
            if changed:
                if not prior_objects.has(identity):prior_objects[identity]=held
                var next:Dictionary=held.duplicate();next.item=held.item.duplicate();next.item.construction_suppressions=suppressions;target.objects[identity]=next
        for identity in target.connectors.keys():
            for point in target.connectors[identity].endpoints:
                if entered.has(Cells.key(point)):target.connectors.erase(identity);break
    var decoded=object_rows(update.get("objects"))
    if not decoded.ok:return decoded
    for row in decoded.value:
        result=_object(target,row,prior_objects,order)
        if not result.ok:return result
    result=_contents(target,update,prior_objects)
    if not result.ok:return result
    result=_tiles(target,update,prior_tiles)
    if not result.ok:return result
    for row in update.get("connectors",[]):target.connectors[row.connector_uuid]=row
    disclosed.tiles={};disclosed.tiles_removed=[];disclosed.objects={};disclosed.objects_removed=[]
    for key in prior_tiles:
        var current:Variant=target.tiles.get(key)
        if current==null:
            if prior_tiles[key]!=null:disclosed.tiles_removed.append(key)
        elif prior_tiles[key]==null or not is_same(prior_tiles[key],current):disclosed.tiles[key]=current
    for identity in prior_objects:
        var current:Variant=target.objects.get(identity)
        if current==null:
            if prior_objects[identity]!=null:disclosed.objects_removed.append(identity)
        elif prior_objects[identity]==null or not is_same(prior_objects[identity],current):disclosed.objects[identity]=current
    disclosed.changes=disclosed.tiles.keys();disclosed.order=order
    return success(target)
```


### B1c. Proposed `sdk/transitions.gd::capture_delta`

```gdscript
static func capture_delta(target:Dictionary,node:Dictionary,bodies:Array,update:Variant,_snapshots:Dictionary={},_retained:bool=false,disclosed:Dictionary={},changed_actors:Dictionary={},changed_items:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var delta=empty_delta();var identities=changed_actors.duplicate();var fact:Variant=node.get("fact")
    for record in bodies:identities[record.actor_uuid]=true
    if fact!=null and not node.get("canceled",false):
        for field in ["entity_uuid","source_entity_uuid","target_entity_uuid","observer_uuid"]:
            if fact.get(field)!=null:identities[fact[field]]=true
        if fact.kind=="actor_change":
            for change in fact.get("actors",[]):identities[change.actor_uuid]=true
        if fact.kind in ["sensory","spatial"]:
            delta.set.senses=target.senses
            for field in ["entity_members","object_contact_members","effect_members","light_sources","remembered_effects","spatial_content"]:delta.set[field]=target[field].duplicate()
        if fact.kind=="turn":delta.set.current_actor_uuid=target.current_actor_uuid;delta.set.round_number=target.round_number
        if fact.kind=="spatial" and fact.get("entity_uuid")!=null and target.spatial_commit_cursors.has(fact.entity_uuid):delta.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid]=target.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid]
    for identity in identities:
        if target.actors.has(identity):delta.actors[identity]=target.actors[identity]
    for identity in changed_items:delta.items[identity]=target.items[identity]
    if not bodies.is_empty():delta.set.static=target.static.duplicate()
    if update!=null:
        delta.world_order=disclosed.get("order",[])
        delta.tiles=disclosed.get("tiles",{});delta.tiles_removed=disclosed.get("tiles_removed",[]);delta.objects=disclosed.get("objects",{});delta.objects_removed=disclosed.get("objects_removed",[])
        delta.set.connectors=target.connectors.duplicate();delta.set.object_members=target.object_members.duplicate()
        delta.set.static=target.static.duplicate()
    return delta
```


### B1d. Proposed `presentation/compiler.gd::apply_delta`

```gdscript
static func apply_delta(target: Dictionary, delta: Dictionary) -> void:
    for key in delta.get("set", {}): target[key] = delta.set[key]
    # Each operation publishes only its new log rows. Replaying another
    # timeline must not mutate the retained delta or repeat previous history.
    if delta.has("log_appends"):
        target.combat_log_appends.append_array(delta.log_appends)
    for key in delta.get("objects_removed", []): target.objects.erase(key)
    for key in delta.get("tiles_removed", []): target.tiles.erase(key)
    # Preserve real erase/reinsert order even when a key has a final after-value.
    # Only fold-generated tile/object edges enter this internal metadata.
    for entry in delta.get("world_order",[]):
        var family:String=entry.kind
        var identity:String=entry.id
        if entry.remove:target[family].erase(identity)
        elif delta.get(family,{}).has(identity):
            target[family].erase(identity)
            target[family][identity]=delta[family][identity]
    for field in ["actors", "items", "tiles", "objects", "spatial_commit_cursors"]:
        var values:Dictionary=delta.get(field,{})
        if not values.is_empty():target[field].merge(values,true)
```


### B1e. Proposed `presentation/timeline.gd::_record_world_changes`

```gdscript
func _record_world_changes(delta: Dictionary) -> void:
    for key in delta.get("tiles",{}): world_changes.tiles[key] = true
    for key in delta.get("tiles_removed",[]): world_changes.tiles[key] = true
    for key in delta.get("objects",{}): world_changes.objects[key] = true
    for key in delta.get("objects_removed",[]): world_changes.objects[key] = true
    world_changes.senses = world_changes.senses or delta.get("set",{}).has("senses")
    world_changes.revision = world_revision
```


### B1f. Proposed `presentation/timeline.gd::_append_membership_order`

```gdscript
static func _append_membership_order(order: Array, delta: Dictionary, before: Dictionary) -> void:
    # Match Compiler.apply_delta's dictionary insertion/removal order. Dirty
    # keys alone cannot distinguish a replacement from a remove-and-reappend.
    if delta.has("world_order"):
        order.append_array(delta.world_order)
        return
    # Archived deltas retain the earlier keyed representation.
    var removed_tiles:Dictionary={}
    for id in delta.get("tiles_removed",[]):
        if before.tiles.has(id) and not removed_tiles.has(id):
            order.append({"kind":"tiles","id":id,"remove":true});removed_tiles[id]=true
    var removed: Dictionary = {}
    for id in delta.get("objects_removed",[]):
        if before.objects.has(id) and not removed.has(id):
            order.append({"kind":"objects","id":id,"remove":true})
            removed[id] = true
    for id in delta.get("tiles",{}):
        if removed_tiles.has(id) or not before.tiles.has(id): order.append({"kind":"tiles","id":id,"remove":false})
    for id in delta.get("objects",{}):
        if removed.has(id) or not before.objects.has(id): order.append({"kind":"objects","id":id,"remove":false})
```


### B1g. Proposed `presentation/timeline.gd::_advance_immediate`

```gdscript
func _advance_immediate(delta_ms: float) -> void:
    if paused or state.is_empty(): return
    waiting_for_media = false
    var first: Dictionary = current if not current.is_empty() else (queue[0] if not queue.is_empty() else {})
    if media_ready.is_valid() and not media_ready.call(first):
        waiting_for_media = true
        return
    var target = display_ms + maxf(0,delta_ms)
    while true:
        if current.is_empty():
            if queue.is_empty(): display_ms = target; return
            # Studio may space already compiled operations on this same display
            # clock. The interval contains only the prior real SDK state; no
            # group, event, actor sample or future commit is activated early.
            var start = maxf(display_ms,float(queue[0].get("preview_start_ms",display_ms)))
            if target < start:
                display_ms = target
                return
            display_ms = start
            # Preparation must precede even zero-duration groups and staging.
            # Waiting wall time is not added to the presentation clock later.
            if media_ready.is_valid() and not media_ready.call(queue[0]):
                waiting_for_media = true
                return
            current = queue.pop_front()
            group_start_ms = display_ms
            commit_index = 0
            EventTrace.activate(trace,current.get("events",[]),group_start_ms)
            _resolve_preparation_issue(current)
            _record_history_cut(group_start_ms,current,group_start_ms)
        var local = minf(target-group_start_ms,float(current.duration_ms))
        var commits: Array = current.commits
        while commit_index < commits.size() and float(commits[commit_index].at_ms) <= local + 0.000001:
            var delta: Dictionary = commits[commit_index].delta
            _append_membership_order(world_changes.order,delta,state)
            var captures:Dictionary=pose_admissions(commits[commit_index],state,condition_owners,current,group_start_ms,retained_directions,appearance_cache,retained_components)
            Compiler.apply_delta(state,delta)
            _observe_resource_owners(delta,group_start_ms+commits[commit_index].at_ms,commits[commit_index].get("condition_rows",[]),str(commits[commit_index].get("event_uuid","")),captures,commits[commit_index].get("item_rows",[]),commits[commit_index].get("creation_bindings",{}),commits[commit_index].get("spatial_rows",[]),commits[commit_index].get("grant_fact",{}))
            _record_history_cut(group_start_ms+commits[commit_index].at_ms,current,group_start_ms)
            if commits[commit_index].has("event_uuid"):
                EventTrace.commit(trace,int(current.operation_sequence),commits[commit_index].event_uuid)
            EventTrace.append_logs(trace,commits[commit_index].get("trace_logs",[]))
            if _world_delta(delta):
                world_revision += 1
                _record_world_changes(delta)
            commit_index += 1
            revision += 1
        EventTrace.tick(trace,current.get("events",[]),local)
        if target < group_start_ms+float(current.duration_ms):
            display_ms = target
            return
        display_ms = group_start_ms+float(current.duration_ms)
        if current.get("operation_end",false): sequence = int(current.operation_sequence)
        completed_group_count += 1
        completed_groups.append({"id":current.id,"at_ms":display_ms,"sequence":sequence})
        if completed_groups.size()>DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT: completed_groups.pop_front()
        _retain_completed_presentation()
        if retire_group.is_valid(): retire_group.call(current)
        current = {}
        _record_history_cut(display_ms,{},display_ms)
```


### B1h. Proposed `presentation/timeline.gd::_world_candidate`

```gdscript
func _world_candidate(plan: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var snapshot = state.duplicate()
    # These are the collections Compiler.apply_delta mutates. Their immutable
    # after-values remain shared; collection ownership never aliases live state.
    for field in ["actors","items","tiles","objects","spatial_commit_cursors","combat_log_appends"]:
        if state.has(field): snapshot[field] = state[field].duplicate()
    var changes = {"full":false,"tiles":{},"objects":{},"senses":false,"order":[]}
    var next_revision = revision; var next_world_revision = world_revision; var next_sequence = sequence
    var appearance_owners:Dictionary=Appearance.copy_owners(condition_owners)
    var capture_directions:Dictionary=retained_directions.duplicate()
    var capture_components:Array=retained_components.duplicate()
    for segment in plan.segments:
        for i in range(segment.first_commit,segment.end_commit):
            var delta: Dictionary = segment.group.commits[i].delta
            _append_membership_order(changes.order,delta,snapshot)
            var commit:Dictionary=segment.group.commits[i]
            var captures:Dictionary=pose_admissions(commit,snapshot,appearance_owners,segment.group,segment.start_ms,capture_directions,appearance_cache,capture_components)
            Compiler.apply_delta(snapshot,delta)
            Conditions.observe(appearance_owners,delta.get("actors",{}),segment.start_ms+commit.at_ms,false,commit.get("condition_rows",[]),captures,commit.get("creation_bindings",{}))
            for key in delta.get("tiles",{}): changes.tiles[key] = true
            for key in delta.get("tiles_removed",[]): changes.tiles[key] = true
            for id in delta.get("objects",{}): changes.objects[id] = true
            for id in delta.get("objects_removed",[]): changes.objects[id] = true
            changes.senses = changes.senses or delta.get("set",{}).has("senses")
            next_revision += 1
            if _world_delta(delta): next_world_revision += 1
        if segment.complete:
            var completed_at:float=float(segment.start_ms)+float(segment.group.duration_ms)
            capture_components=capture_components.filter(func(item):return _component_end_ms(item.component,float(item.group_start_ms))>completed_at)
            for component in segment.group.get("components",[]):
                if component.kind in ["sprite_layer","material_flash","body_surface"] and float(component.start_ms)+float(component.duration_ms)>float(segment.group.duration_ms):capture_components.append({"component":component,"group_start_ms":segment.start_ms})
            _directions(segment.group.get("actor_tracks",[]),INF,capture_directions)
            if segment.group.get("operation_end",false):next_sequence=int(segment.group.operation_sequence)
    var last: Dictionary = _world_plan_tail(plan)
    var group: Dictionary = {} if last.complete else last.group
    var supports = _tiles_for(group,last.local_ms,snapshot)
    var previous = staged_tiles()
    for key in previous:
        if not supports.has(key) or previous[key]!=supports[key]: changes.tiles[key] = true
    for key in supports:
        if not previous.has(key) or previous[key]!=supports[key]: changes.tiles[key] = true
    var presented = snapshot
    if not supports.is_empty():
        presented = snapshot.duplicate(); presented.tiles = snapshot.tiles.duplicate(); presented.tiles.merge(supports)
    changes.revision = next_world_revision
    # Construction needs only the same temporary outfit/hand layers. Sample
    # passive authored intervals; component_samples consumes audio/retention and
    # must never run against a future boundary.
    var layer_candidates:Array=retained_components.duplicate()
    for segment in plan.segments:
        for component in segment.group.get("components",[]):
            if component.kind=="sprite_layer":layer_candidates.append({"component":component,"group_start_ms":segment.start_ms})
    var actor_layers:Array=_actor_layers_at(layer_candidates,plan.display_ms)
    actor_layers.append_array(Appearance.components(appearance_owners,plan.display_ms,appearance_cache))
    return {"key":[initialization_revision,revision,last.group.get("operation_sequence",sequence),last.group.get("id",""),last.start_ms,last.end_commit,last.local_ms,last.complete],
        "preparation_key":[initialization_revision,world_revision,_support_signature(),last.group.get("operation_sequence",sequence),last.group.get("id",""),last.end_commit,last.local_ms,last.complete],
        "source_group_id":last.group.get("id",""),"source_local_ms":last.local_ms,"retained_boundary":plan.segments.is_empty(),
        "state":snapshot,"presentation_state":presented,"staged_tiles":supports,"staged_actors":_actors_for(group,last.local_ms),
        "actor_samples":_project_actor_samples(Tracks.samples(group.get("actor_tracks",[]),last.local_ms),snapshot.actors,appearance_owners),"actor_layers":actor_layers,
        "changes":changes,"display_ms":plan.display_ms,"revision":next_revision,"world_revision":next_world_revision,
        "sequence":next_sequence,"group_id":group.get("id",""),"operation_sequence":int(last.group.get("operation_sequence",sequence)),
        "resource_revision":resource_revision}
```


### B2. Actor/item captures: exact writer-local identities, not full-map diff per node

`119ddede` replaced the old incident-identity capture route with full `actors/items` shell copies before every occurrence plus full scans afterward. The current COW records already provide exact after-values; capture their actual writes. Optional operation-local changed-identity dictionaries are threaded through existing Bodies/Audience/Reducer helpers, then consumed by the already-existing `Transitions.capture_delta` arguments. No persistent registry, alternative reducer or authoring logic is added.

Every current writer is included below: body/item entry (including implicit item-effect clears), item member/state changes, actor change rows, scalar fact writes, observer/contact position changes and remembered-position clearing. Trailing body admission keeps its existing explicit trailing capture. An invalid operation still discards the private target and its dirty dictionaries. Public default calls remain valid; no caller is allowed to supply fake actor IDs. Current caster/application input joins, source cursors, lineage checks, exact grants, item rows and condition rows are kept.

### B3. Sensory reuse: restore exact accepted-state ownership, not schema-14 perception

The current retained reducer signature accepts `sensory_context` but discards it. Baseline `_reduce_operation` returned an owner bound to accepted state/perception/senses, and `_fork_cells` borrowed unchanged data. Restore that ownership pattern on the server-composed schema-16 mask. The candidate forks only the context shell when its accepted `state` is exactly the current input, checks exact mask identity before borrowing ordered points/membership, and duplicates membership before a real topology write. Unchanged masks skip decode/populate/sort. Real visible topology changes retain the current full fallback; light/hazard byte projection and remembered effects are not silently dropped or claimed O(changes).

This is the minimal current-contract reuse. Do not copy the old per-observer perception store, compose a second audience, drop light/hazard rows or relax membership errors. A later direct port of baseline column `_update_cells` is optional only if this retained route remains measured expensive; it must keep schema-16 integer mask order and the same independent oracle.


### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/fold_bodies.gd::enter_item`

```gdscript
static func enter_item(target:Dictionary,record:Dictionary,item_rows:Array=[],actor_uuid:String="",changed_items:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var prior:Dictionary=target.items.get(record.item_uuid,{});var look:Variant=record.get("look",prior.get("look"))
    if look==null:return failure("An item's first record requires its look")
    target.items[record.item_uuid]={"look":look,"profile":record.get("profile") if record.get("profile")!=null else prior.get("profile"),"state":record.get("state") if record.get("state")!=null else prior.get("state"),"effects":record.get("effects",[])}
    changed_items[record.item_uuid]=true
    var before:Array=prior.get("effects",[]);var after:Array=target.items[record.item_uuid].effects
    if not before.is_empty() or not after.is_empty():
        item_rows.append({"actor_uuid":actor_uuid,"item_uuid":record.item_uuid,"field":"item_record","record":record,"before":before,"after":after})
    return success(target)
```


### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/fold_bodies.gd::enter_body`

```gdscript
static func enter_body(target:Dictionary,record:Dictionary,item_rows:Array=[],changed_actors:Dictionary={},changed_items:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var prior:Dictionary=target.actors.get(record.actor_uuid,{})
    if not prior.get("present",true):return success(target)
    var birth:Variant=record.get("birth",prior if not prior.is_empty() else null)
    if birth==null:return failure("A body's first record requires its birth")
    var body:Dictionary=record.body;var loadouts:Dictionary=target.static.visual_loadouts
    if record.get("loadout")!=null:
        target.static=target.static.duplicate();loadouts=loadouts.duplicate();target.static.visual_loadouts=loadouts
        if loadouts.has(body.visual_loadout_id) and loadouts[body.visual_loadout_id]!=record.loadout:return failure("A visual loadout id names one value")
        loadouts[body.visual_loadout_id]=record.loadout
    if not loadouts.has(body.visual_loadout_id):return failure("A body requires its visual loadout")
    var actor={"uuid":record.actor_uuid,"name":birth.name,"character_body_id":birth.get("character_body_id"),"creature_content_ref":birth.get("creature_content_ref"),"appearance":birth.appearance,"structural_base_size":birth.get("structural_base_size"),"manifestation":birth.get("manifestation"),"visual_loadout":loadouts[body.visual_loadout_id],"last_visual_position":prior.get("last_visual_position"),"present":true}
    for field in ["normal_hp","maximum_hp","temporary_hp","life_state","armor_class"]:actor[field]=body[field]
    for field in BODY_DEFAULTS:actor[field]=body.get(field,BODY_DEFAULTS[field])
    target.actors[record.actor_uuid]=actor;changed_actors[record.actor_uuid]=true
    var recorded={}
    for item in record.get("items",[]):
        var entered=enter_item(target,item,item_rows,str(record.actor_uuid),changed_items)
        if not entered.ok:return entered
        recorded[item.item_uuid]=true
    var shown:Array=actor.controlled_items if actor.controlled_items!=null else []
    if actor.controlled_items==null:
        for layer in actor.visual_loadout.layers:shown.append(layer.item_uuid)
    for identity in shown:
        if not recorded.has(identity) and target.items.has(identity) and not target.items[identity].effects.is_empty():
            var item:Dictionary=target.items[identity].duplicate();var before:Array=item.effects
            item.effects=[];target.items[identity]=item;changed_items[identity]=true
            item_rows.append({"actor_uuid":str(record.actor_uuid),"item_uuid":identity,"field":"item_record","before":before,"after":item.effects})
    return success(target)
```

### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/fold_bodies.gd::changed_item`

```gdscript
static func changed_item(target:Dictionary,row:Dictionary,item_rows:Array=[],actor_uuid:String="",changed_items:Dictionary={})->void:
    var identity:Variant=row.get("item_uuid");var held:Variant=target.items.get(identity)
    if held==null:return
    var next:Dictionary=held.duplicate()
    match row.field:
        "item_effects":next.effects=row.effects
        "item_effect_duration":
            for effect in held.effects:
                if effect.effect_uuid==row.key:
                    var value:Dictionary=effect.duplicate();value.duration=row.duration;next.effects=upsert(held.effects,"effect_uuid",value);break
        "item_state":
            if held.state!=null:next.state=held.state.duplicate();next.state.merge(row.changes,true)
    target.items[identity]=next;changed_items[identity]=true
    if row.field in ["item_effects","item_effect_duration"]:
        item_rows.append({"actor_uuid":actor_uuid,"item_uuid":identity,"field":row.field,"row":row,"before":held.effects,"after":next.effects})
```


### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/fold_bodies.gd::actor_change`

```gdscript
static func actor_change(target:Dictionary,fact:Dictionary,condition_rows:Array=[],item_rows:Array=[],changed_actors:Dictionary={},changed_items:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    for record in fact.get("items",[]):
        var entered=enter_item(target,record,item_rows,"",changed_items)
        if not entered.ok:return entered
    for change in fact.get("actors",[]):
        if not target.actors.has(change.actor_uuid):return failure("An actor change requires its held body")
        var actor:Dictionary=target.actors[change.actor_uuid]
        var previous:Dictionary=actor
        if not actor.present:continue
        for row in change.rows:
            var next:Dictionary=actor.duplicate()
            match row.field:
                "normal_hp","maximum_hp","temporary_hp","temporary_hp_grant","armor_class","resolved_size","spatial_disposition":next[row.field]=row.value
                "active_weapon_set":next.visual_loadout=actor.visual_loadout.duplicate();next.visual_loadout.active_weapon_set=row.value
                "condition":
                    var before:Variant=member(actor,row.condition_uuid);var after:Variant=row.get("member")
                    next.conditions=remove(actor.conditions,"condition_uuid",row.condition_uuid) if after==null else upsert(actor.conditions,"condition_uuid",after)
```

```gdscript
static func clear_unseen_positions(target:Dictionary,changed_actors:Dictionary={})->void:
    if target.senses==null:return
    for identity in target.actors:
        var actor:Dictionary=target.actors[identity];var position:Variant=actor.last_visual_position
        if position!=null and actor.present and actor.life_state!="dead" and not identity in target.audience.controlled and not target.senses.entities.has(identity) and Cells.contains(target.senses.visible,position):
            actor=actor.duplicate();actor.last_visual_position=null;target.actors[identity]=actor;changed_actors[identity]=true
```

```gdscript
static func fold(target:Dictionary,fact:Dictionary,values:Dictionary,changed_actors:Dictionary={},cell_context:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var rows:Dictionary=values.rows;var uuids:Array=rows.get("uuids",[]);var held:Variant=target.senses
    if fact.get("initial",false):
        if held!=null:return failure("A seat's perception enters once")
        held={"position":fact.observer_position,"visible":Cells.EMPTY,"seen":Cells.EMPTY,"entities":{},"objects":{},"effective_light_levels":Cells.values([],{}),"hazardous_cells":Cells.values([],{}),"spatial_effects":{},"paths_dirty":false,"passive_perception":fact.passive_perception,"sense_modes_key":[],"sense_modes":[],"visual_access":fact.visual_access,"light_sources":{},"light_source_removals":{}}
    elif held==null:return failure("A sensory change requires the seat's entered perception")
    var added=_selected_cells(values.cells,fact.get("visible_cells_added",{}));var removed=_selected_cells(values.cells,fact.get("visible_cells_removed",{}))
    if not added.ok:return added
    if not removed.ok:return removed
    # Only a context forked from this exact accepted state's immutable mask
    # may borrow its ordered population and membership table.
    var indexed:bool=is_same(cell_context.get("mask"),held.visible) and cell_context.has("points") and cell_context.has("members")
    var prior_points:Array=cell_context.points if indexed else Cells.mask_points(held.visible)
    var prior_members:Dictionary=cell_context.members if indexed else Cells.point_set(prior_points)
    var topology_changed:bool=not removed.value.is_empty() or not added.value.is_empty()
    var visible:Dictionary=prior_members.duplicate() if topology_changed else prior_members
    for point in removed.value:visible.erase(Cells.key(point))
    for point in added.value:visible[Cells.key(point)]=point
    var points:Array=Cells.sorted_points(visible) if topology_changed else prior_points
    var result:Dictionary=held.duplicate()
    result.visible=Cells.mask(points) if topology_changed else held.visible
    result.seen=Cells.union_points(held.seen,added.value)
    var value_indices:PackedInt64Array=Cells.value_indices(prior_points,points)
    for pair in [["effective_light_levels","light_levels","effective_light_levels_changed"],["hazardous_cells","hazards","hazardous_cells_changed"]]:
        var changed=Cells.selected(values[pair[1]],fact.get(pair[2],{}))
        if not changed.ok:return changed
        if held[pair[0]].get("cells",{})==held.visible:
            result[pair[0]]=Cells.reindexed_values(held[pair[0]],prior_points.size(),points,changed.value,result.visible,value_indices)
        else:

            for row in changed.value:prior[Cells.key(row.position)]=row.value
            result[pair[0]]=Cells.values(points,prior,result.visible)
    for pair in [["entities","entity_members","entity_contacts_changed","entity_contacts_removed"],["objects","object_contact_members","object_contacts_changed","object_contacts_removed"]]:
        var contacts:Dictionary=held[pair[0]].duplicate();result[pair[0]]=contacts;var members:Dictionary=target[pair[1]];var named={}
        for index in fact.get(pair[3],[]):
            var identity:String=uuids[index]
            if named.has(identity) or not contacts.erase(identity):return failure("A removed contact is one the seat perceives, named once")
            named[identity]=true;members.erase(identity)
        named={}
        for index in fact.get(pair[2],[]):
            var identity:String=uuids[rows.contact_uuid_index[index]]
            if named.has(identity):return failure("A sensory fact names two rows of one identity in one list")
            named[identity]=true;var membership=_members(rows.get("contact_members",[]),index,target.audience.observers.size())
            if not membership.ok:return membership
            contacts[identity]=values.contacts[index];members[identity]=membership.value
    target.spatial_content.merge(fact.get("spatial_effect_content",{}),true)
    var effects:Dictionary=held.spatial_effects.duplicate();var left={};var named={}
    for index in fact.get("spatial_effects_removed",[]):
        var identity:String=uuids[index]
        if named.has(identity) or not effects.has(identity):return failure("A removed effect is one the seat perceives, named once")
        named[identity]=true;left[identity]=[effects[identity],Cells.point_set(effects[identity].positions)];effects.erase(identity);target.effect_members.erase(identity)
    named={}
    for index in fact.get("spatial_effects_patched",[]):
        var identity:String=uuids[rows.patch_uuid_index[index]]
        if named.has(identity) or not effects.has(identity):return failure("A patched effect is one the seat perceives, named once")
        named[identity]=true;var patch:Dictionary=rows.sighting_patches[index];var changed=_patch_effect(effects[identity],patch)
        if not changed.ok:return changed
        effects[identity]=changed.value
        if patch.get("members")!=null:target.effect_members[identity]=patch.members
        left[identity]=[changed.value,Cells.point_set(Cells.mask_points(patch.get("positions_removed",{})))]
    for index in fact.get("spatial_effects_added",[]):
        var identity:String=uuids[rows.sighting_uuid_index[index]]
        if effects.has(identity):return failure("An entering effect is one the seat does not perceive")
        if not target.spatial_content.has(identity):return failure("An entering effect's content was sent before or with it")
        var membership=_members(rows.get("sighting_members",[]),index,target.audience.observers.size())
        if not membership.ok:return membership
        effects[identity]=_effect(rows.sightings[index],target.spatial_content[identity]);target.effect_members[identity]=membership.value
    var retired={}
    for index in fact.get("spatial_effect_cells_retired",[]):

        retired[identity]=Cells.point_set(Cells.mask_points(rows.retired_cells[index]))
    for identity in left:

        if not parts[1].is_empty() or remembered!=null:
            var cells:Dictionary=parts[1].duplicate()
            if remembered!=null:cells.merge(Cells.point_set(remembered.positions),true)
            var next:Dictionary=parts[0].duplicate();next.positions=Cells.sorted_points(cells);next.visible_volume_positions=[];next.upper_volume_surfaces=[];target.remembered_effects[identity]=next
    for identity in target.remembered_effects.keys():
        var row:Dictionary=target.remembered_effects[identity];var current:Dictionary=effects.get(identity,{});var perceived=Cells.point_set(current.get("positions",[]));var gone:Dictionary=retired.get(identity,{});var kept:Array=[]
        for point in row.positions:
            var key=Cells.key(point)
            if not perceived.has(key) and not gone.has(key) and not (current.get("apparent_presence",row.apparent_presence) and visible.has(key)):kept.append(point)
        if kept.is_empty():target.remembered_effects.erase(identity)
        else:row=row.duplicate();row.positions=kept;target.remembered_effects[identity]=row
    result.spatial_effects=effects
    named={}
    for index in fact.get("light_sources_removed",[]):

        named[identity]=true
    for index in fact.get("light_sources_patched",[]):

        if not target.light_sources.has(identity):return failure("A patched light source is one the seat perceives")
        var next:Dictionary=target.light_sources[identity].duplicate()
        for field in patch.changes:

            else:next[field]=value
        target.light_sources[identity]=next
    for index in fact.get("light_sources_added",[]):
        var source:Dictionary=rows.light_sources[index];var identity:String=uuids[source.source]
        if target.light_sources.has(identity):return failure("An entering light source is one the seat does not perceive")
        target.light_sources[identity]=_light(source,uuids)
    if fact.get("observer_position")!=null:result.position=fact.observer_position
    result.paths_dirty=held.paths_dirty or fact.get("paths_dirty",false)
    for field in ["sense_modes","passive_perception","visual_access"]:
        if fact.get(field+"_changed",false) and fact.get(field)!=null:result[field]=fact[field]
    result.sense_modes_key=modes_key(result.sense_modes);target.senses=result
    if fact.get("observer_position")!=null and target.actors.has(target.observer_uuid):
        var actor:Dictionary=target.actors[target.observer_uuid].duplicate();actor.last_visual_position=fact.observer_position;target.actors[target.observer_uuid]=actor;changed_actors[target.observer_uuid]=true
    for index in fact.get("entity_contacts_changed",[]):

        if contact.visual and target.actors.has(identity) and target.actors[identity].present:
            var actor:Dictionary=target.actors[identity].duplicate();actor.last_visual_position=contact.position;target.actors[identity]=actor;changed_actors[identity]=true
    clear_unseen_positions(target,changed_actors)
```
