### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/reducer.gd::apply_player_fact`

```gdscript
static func apply_player_fact(target:Dictionary,fact:Dictionary,source_cursor:Variant=null,values:Dictionary={},condition_rows:Array=[],item_rows:Array=[],changed_actors:Dictionary={},changed_items:Dictionary={},sensory_cells:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var identity:Variant;var actor:Variant
    match fact.kind:
        "sensory":
            if values.is_empty():return failure("A sensory fact requires its group's rows")
            return Audience.fold(target,fact,values,changed_actors,sensory_cells)
        "actor_change":return Bodies.actor_change(target,fact,condition_rows,item_rows,changed_actors,changed_items)
        "faction":
            actor=_write_actor(target,fact.entity_uuid,changed_actors)
            if actor!=null:actor.faction=fact.faction_after
        "spatial":
            identity=fact.get("entity_uuid");actor=_write_actor(target,identity,changed_actors)
            if fact.get("terminal_departure",false) and actor!=null:
                actor.present=false;actor.last_visual_position=null;actor.occupancy_layer=null
                if target.senses!=null:
                    target.senses=target.senses.duplicate();target.senses.entities=target.senses.entities.duplicate();target.senses.entities.erase(identity);target.entity_members.erase(identity)
                return success(target)
            if actor!=null and fact.change_type=="entity_entered":actor.spatial_disposition="present"
            if actor!=null and fact.get("occupancy_layer")!=null:actor.occupancy_layer=fact.occupancy_layer
            if identity in target.audience.controlled and fact.change_type=="entity_entered":
                if actor!=null:actor.last_visual_position=fact.position
                if target.senses!=null and identity==target.observer_uuid:target.senses=target.senses.duplicate();target.senses.position=fact.position
        "item_charge":
            identity=fact.source_entity_uuid;actor=_write_actor(target,identity,changed_actors)
            if actor==null:return failure("Missing actor: "+str(identity))
            if actor.controlled_items==null or not identity in target.audience.controlled:return failure("item charges require the controlled actor's inventory")
            if fact.item_destroyed:
                actor.controlled_items=Bodies.remove(actor.controlled_items,"",fact.item_uuid);actor.visual_loadout=actor.visual_loadout.duplicate();actor.visual_loadout.layers=Bodies.remove(actor.visual_loadout.layers,"item_uuid",fact.item_uuid)
            elif fact.item_uuid in actor.controlled_items:
                var item:Dictionary=target.items[fact.item_uuid].duplicate()
                if item.state==null:return failure("item charges require the controlled item's state")
                item.state=item.state.duplicate();item.state.charges=fact.charges_after;item.state.stack_count=fact.stack_count_after;target.items[fact.item_uuid]=item;changed_items[fact.item_uuid]=true
        "attack":
            actor=_write_actor(target,fact.source_entity_uuid,changed_actors)
            if actor!=null:
                # AttackFact.weapon_set is a Python property, not a wire field.
                # Match that reference property on the actual declared source.
                var stance:String="none" if fact.get("attack_source_kind","equipped")!="equipped" else "ranged" if fact.weapon_slot in ["RANGED_MAIN","RANGED_OFF"] else "melee"
                actor.visual_loadout=actor.visual_loadout.duplicate();actor.visual_loadout.active_weapon_set=stance
        "damage","heal":
            if fact.kind=="damage" and fact.stage!="applied":return success(target)
            if fact.kind=="heal" and fact.get("was_blocked",false):return success(target)
            if fact.get("resulting_normal_hp")==null or fact.get("resulting_temporary_hp")==null:return failure("applied damage/healing requires exact committed HP")
            actor=_write_actor(target,fact.target_entity_uuid,changed_actors)
            if actor==null:return failure("Missing actor: "+str(fact.target_entity_uuid))
            actor.normal_hp=fact.resulting_normal_hp;actor.temporary_hp=fact.resulting_temporary_hp
            if actor.temporary_hp<=0:actor.temporary_hp_grant=null
        "temporary_hit_points":
            actor=_write_actor(target,fact.entity_uuid,changed_actors)
            if actor==null:return failure("Missing actor: "+str(fact.entity_uuid))
            actor.temporary_hp=fact.resulting_temporary_hp;actor.temporary_hp_grant=fact.get("grant")
        "life":
            actor=_write_actor(target,fact.entity_uuid,changed_actors)
            if actor==null:return failure("Missing actor: "+str(fact.entity_uuid))
            actor.life_state=fact.new_state;actor.normal_hp=fact.normal_hit_points;actor.remains_disposition=fact.get("remains_disposition","intact")
        "turn":
            if fact.get("round_number")!=null:target.round_number=fact.round_number
            if fact.event_type in ["turn_start","turn_end","encounter_end"]:target.current_actor_uuid=fact.entity_uuid if fact.event_type=="turn_start" else null
    return success(target)
```


### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/reducer.gd::apply_committed_player_fact`

```gdscript
static func apply_committed_player_fact(target:Dictionary,fact:Dictionary,source_cursor:int,occurrences:Variant,values:Dictionary={},condition_rows:Array=[],item_rows:Array=[],changed_actors:Dictionary={},changed_items:Dictionary={},sensory_cells:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    if fact.kind=="spatial" and fact.get("entity_uuid")!=null and fact.change_type in ["entity_entered","entity_left"]:
        var committed:Variant=fact.get("commit_occurrence")
        if committed==null or not committed in occurrences:return failure("Spatial change at cursor %d lacks its recorded commit version"%source_cursor)
        if committed<int(target.spatial_commit_cursors.get(fact.entity_uuid,-1)) and int(target.spatial_commit_cursors.get(fact.entity_uuid,-1))<source_cursor:return success(target)
        target.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid]=committed
    return apply_player_fact(target,fact,source_cursor,values,condition_rows,item_rows,changed_actors,changed_items,sensory_cells)
```


### B2/B3 correction 3 — capture work is conditional, 22 October

The earlier candidate collected actor inputs and indexed cast ownership even when
`recorded == null`, then discarded those presentation inputs. The corrected full
functions below guard the actor/item before-input helpers, the capture-only
`owners`/`casts` map and cast-input join, admitted-body capture accumulation and
operation transition-container allocation. The mandatory `node_lineages` inside
`check_spell_declarations` still runs: it validates canonical spell declarations,
whereas the guarded copy exists only to choose recorded actor inputs.

Canonical body/world/fact ordering, world-update indexing, composed sensory
values, declaration validation, writer-local changed-identity sets, sparse-world
preimages/order and accepted-state sensory ownership remain active without
recording. No fact writer, validation or current schema field is skipped. Full
node, lineage and operation functions follow; the retained-operation wrapper and
Bodies/Audience writer signatures keep their existing proposed contracts.

### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/reducer.gd::_reduce_nodes_owned`

```gdscript
static func _reduce_nodes_owned(result:Dictionary,nodes:Array,versions:Dictionary,bodies:Array,updates:Array,rows:Dictionary={},recorded:Variant=null,profile:Variant=null,resolutions:Array=[],sensory_cells:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    var composed=Audience.composed_values(rows)
    if not composed.ok:return composed
    var casts:Dictionary={}
    if recorded!=null:
        var owners:Array=node_lineages(nodes,versions)
        for i in range(nodes.size()):
            var declared:Variant=nodes[i].get("fact")
            if declared!=null and declared.kind=="spell" and declared.get("source_entity_uuid")!=null:casts[owners[i]]=declared.source_entity_uuid
    var order:Array=range(bodies.size());order.sort_custom(func(a,b):return a<b if bodies[a].occurrence==bodies[b].occurrence else bodies[a].occurrence<bodies[b].occurrence)
    var pending:Array=[]
    for index in order:pending.append(bodies[index])
    var next=0;var world_updates={}
    for update in updates:world_updates[int(update.occurrence)]=update
    for node in nodes:
        var admitted:Array=[];var item_rows:Array=[];var changed_items={};var changed_actors={}
        while next<pending.size() and pending[next].occurrence<=node.occurrence:
            var entered=Bodies.enter_body(result,pending[next],item_rows,changed_actors,changed_items)
            if not entered.ok:return entered
            if recorded!=null:admitted.append(pending[next])
            next+=1
        var started:int=Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile!=null else 0
        var inputs:Dictionary=Transitions.actor_inputs(result,node) if recorded!=null else {}
        if recorded!=null and node.get("resolution")!=null and not resolutions.is_empty():
            var source:Variant=casts.get(int(resolutions[node.resolution].lineage))
            if source!=null and result.actors.has(source):inputs[source]=result.actors[source]
        var item_inputs:Dictionary=Transitions.item_inputs(result,inputs) if recorded!=null else {}
        var update:Variant=world_updates.get(int(node.occurrence));var disclosed={}
        if update!=null:
            var folded=apply_world_update(result,update,disclosed)
            if not folded.ok:return folded
            if recorded!=null:recorded.world[int(node.occurrence)]=disclosed
        if profile!=null:_profile_elapsed(profile,"world",started)
        var condition_rows:Array=[];started=Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile!=null else 0
        if not node.get("canceled",false) and node.get("fact")!=null:
            var folded=apply_committed_player_fact(result,node.fact,int(node.occurrence),versions.get("occurrences",[]),composed.value,condition_rows,item_rows,changed_actors,changed_items,sensory_cells)
            if not folded.ok:return folded
        if profile!=null:_profile_elapsed(profile,"facts",started)
        if recorded!=null:
            recorded.events.append({"event_uuid":int(node.occurrence),"occurrence":int(node.occurrence),"source_index":int(node.occurrence),"actor_inputs":inputs,"item_inputs":item_inputs,"condition_rows":condition_rows,"item_rows":item_rows,"delta":Transitions.capture_delta(result,node,admitted,update,{},true,disclosed,changed_actors,changed_items)})
    while next<pending.size():
        var item_rows:Array=[]
        var entered=Bodies.enter_body(result,pending[next],item_rows)
        if not entered.ok:return entered
        if recorded!=null:
            recorded.trailing_item_rows.append_array(item_rows)
            recorded.trailing.set.static=result.static.duplicate()
            recorded.trailing.actors[pending[next].actor_uuid]=result.actors[pending[next].actor_uuid]
            for record in pending[next].get("items",[]):recorded.trailing.items[record.item_uuid]=result.items[record.item_uuid]
            for row in item_rows:recorded.trailing.items[row.item_uuid]=result.items[row.item_uuid]
        next+=1
    return success(result)
```


### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/reducer.gd::_reduce_lineage_owned`

```gdscript
static func _reduce_lineage_owned(target:Dictionary,lineage:Dictionary,recorded:Variant=null,profile:Variant=null,sensory_cells:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    if lineage.end_cursor<=target.reducer_cursor:return failure("player lineage precedes this reduction position")
    var folded=_reduce_nodes_owned(target,lineage.events,lineage.version_rows,lineage.get("bodies",[]),lineage.get("world_updates",[]),lineage.get("sensory_rows",{}),recorded,profile,lineage.get("resolutions",[]),sensory_cells)
    if not folded.ok:return folded
    target.reducer_cursor=lineage.end_cursor
    if recorded!=null:recorded.trailing.set.reducer_cursor=target.reducer_cursor
    return success(target)
```

### B2/B3 proposed `sdk/reducer.gd::_reduce_operation`

```gdscript
static func _reduce_operation(target:Dictionary,update:Dictionary,record_events:bool,profile:Variant=null,retained:bool=false,sensory_context:Dictionary={})->Dictionary:
    if update.generation!=target.generation or update.observer_uuid!=target.observer_uuid:return failure("An operation belongs to another observer or generation")
    var cells:Dictionary={}
    if retained and is_same(sensory_context.get("state"),target):cells=sensory_context.get("cells",{}).duplicate()
    var result=_retained_target(target) if retained else copy_target(target)
    var records:Variant={"lineages":[]} if record_events else null
    var content={}
    if not update.get("content_additions",[]).is_empty():
        for descriptor in result.content:content[content_key(descriptor)]=descriptor
        for descriptor in update.content_additions:
            var key=content_key(descriptor)
            if content.has(key) and content[key]!=descriptor:return failure("An admitted content identity changed its definition")
            content[key]=descriptor
        var keys=content.keys();keys.sort();result.content=[]
        for key in keys:result.content.append(content[key])
    for lineage in update.get("lineages",[]):
        if lineage.start_cursor!=result.reducer_cursor:return failure("Operation occurrence sequence has a gap")
        var checked=check_spell_declarations(lineage.events,lineage.version_rows,lineage.get("resolutions",[]))
        if not checked.ok:return checked
        var recorded:Variant={"lineage":int(lineage.lineage),"lineage_uuid":int(lineage.lineage),"start_cursor":lineage.start_cursor,"end_cursor":lineage.end_cursor,"events":[],"trailing":Transitions.empty_delta(),"trailing_item_rows":[],"world":{}} if record_events else null
        var folded=_reduce_lineage_owned(result,lineage,recorded,profile,cells)
        if not folded.ok:return folded
        if record_events:records.lineages.append(recorded)
    if update.get("hud")!=null:
        var applied=apply_hud(result,update.hud)
        if not applied.ok:return applied
    var first:int=result.combat_log_appends.size()
    for i in range(update.get("combat_log_appends",[]).size()):
        var row:Dictionary=update.combat_log_appends[i]
        if row.generation!=result.generation or row.observer_uuid!=result.observer_uuid or row.operation_end_cursor>result.reducer_cursor or row.encounter_log_index!=first+i:return failure("Standalone log append is out of order or belongs to another audience")
    if not update.get("combat_log_appends",[]).is_empty():result.combat_log_appends=result.combat_log_appends.duplicate();result.combat_log_appends.append_array(update.combat_log_appends)
    var accepted=success(result)
    if record_events:accepted.transitions=records
    if retained:accepted.sensory_context={"state":result,"senses":result.senses,"cells":cells}
    return accepted
```


### B4. Original Opus capture/context code, complete functions

These are the exact original functions whose complexity/ownership is being recovered. They are not a schema-14 reducer replacement. The full adapted current closure is above; version rows, conditions/items, masks and grants must not be converted back to the older shape.


### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/transitions.gd::_captured_actor`

```gdscript
static func _captured_actor(target:Dictionary, identity:String, snapshots:Dictionary,retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    # Retained canonical facts replace actor records before writing. The exact
    # before/after record is already immutable; detached public folds keep their
    # snapshot shells because they use the ordinary mutable transaction.
    if not snapshots.has(identity):snapshots[identity] = target.actors[identity] if retained else snapshot_actor(target.actors[identity])
    return snapshots[identity]
```


### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/transitions.gd::actor_inputs`

```gdscript
static func actor_inputs(target: Dictionary, node: Dictionary, snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {}
    if node.fact != null:
        for field in ["entity_uuid", "source_entity_uuid", "target_entity_uuid", "observer_uuid"]:
            var identity: Variant = node.fact.get(field)
            if identity != null and target.actors.has(identity) and not result.has(identity):
                result[identity] = _captured_actor(target,identity,snapshots,retained)
    return result
```


### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/transitions.gd::capture_delta`

```gdscript
static func capture_delta(target: Dictionary, node: Dictionary, observations: Array, update: Variant, snapshots:Dictionary={},retained:bool=false,disclosed:Dictionary={}) -> Dictionary:
    var delta = empty_delta()
    var actors = {}
    for observation in observations: actors[observation.actor.uuid] = true
    var fact: Variant = node.fact
    if fact != null and not node.canceled:
        for field in ["entity_uuid","source_entity_uuid","target_entity_uuid","observer_uuid"]:
            if fact.get(field) != null: actors[fact[field]] = true
        if fact.kind == "sensory":
            for identity in fact.entity_contacts_changed: actors[identity] = true
            # Audience folds return a new perception snapshot without changing
            # its predecessor. This private event-time record is already owned.
            delta.set.perception = target.perception
        if fact.kind in ["sensory","spatial"]: delta.set.senses = target.senses if retained else snapshot_senses(target.senses)
        if fact.kind == "turn":
            delta.set.current_actor_uuid = target.current_actor_uuid
            delta.set.round_number = target.round_number
        if fact.kind == "spatial" and fact.entity_uuid != null and target.spatial_commit_cursors.has(fact.entity_uuid):
            delta.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid] = target.spatial_commit_cursors[fact.entity_uuid]
    for identity in actors:
        if target.actors.has(identity): delta.actors[identity] = _captured_actor(target,identity,snapshots,retained)
    for observation in observations:
        if observation.contact != null:
            delta.set.senses = target.senses if retained else snapshot_senses(target.senses)
    if update != null:
        # The fold already keyed this event's rows (Reducer.apply_world_update).
        # Without field changes or repeated keys, those copies are the after-values.
        if disclosed.changes.is_empty() and disclosed.tiles.size() == update.tiles.size():
            delta.tiles = disclosed.tiles.duplicate()
        else:
            for key in disclosed.tiles: delta.tiles[key] = target.tiles[key]
            for key in disclosed.changes: delta.tiles[key] = target.tiles[key]
        for object in update.objects: delta.objects[object.item.item_uuid] = target.objects[object.item.item_uuid]
        delta.objects_removed = update.objects_removed.duplicate()
        delta.set.connectors = target.connectors
    return delta
```


### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/reducer.gd::_reduce_nodes_owned`

```gdscript
static func _reduce_nodes_owned(result: Dictionary, nodes: Array, versions: Array, observations: Array, updates: Array, recorded: Variant = null, profile: Variant = null, cells: Dictionary = {},retained:bool=false) -> Dictionary:
    # Arbitrary public inputs first compose exhaustively. Only a context bound
    # to this exact committed state can carry that proof across operations.
    var composed_senses: bool = cells.get("composed",false)
    # A fold-local snapshot can serve adjacent event inputs/deltas until a
    # fact or observation edits actors. Mutation branches invalidate it before
    # writing; no snapshots or readiness survive this transaction boundary.
    var actor_snapshots:Dictionary={}
    var indexes = {}
    for row in versions: indexes[row.event_uuid] = row.source_index
    for observation in observations:
        if not indexes.has(observation.event_uuid): return failure("Observation has no recorded version")
    var pending = _ordered_rows(observations, indexes, "event_uuid")
    var next = 0
    var world_updates = {}
    for row in updates: world_updates[row.event_uuid] = row
    for node in nodes:
        if not indexes.has(node.uuid): return failure("Node has no recorded version")
        var admitted: Array = []
        while next < pending.size() and indexes[pending[next].event_uuid] <= indexes[node.uuid]:
            actor_snapshots.clear()
            _observe(result, pending[next],retained,cells)
            if recorded != null: admitted.append(pending[next])
            next += 1
        var started: int = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        var inputs: Dictionary = Transitions.actor_inputs(result,node,actor_snapshots,retained) if recorded != null else {}
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "actor_inputs", started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        var update: Variant = world_updates.get(node.uuid)
        var disclosed: Dictionary = {}
        if update != null:
            var updated = apply_world_update(result, update, disclosed)
            if not updated.ok: return updated
            if recorded != null: recorded.world[node.uuid] = disclosed
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "world", started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        if not node.canceled and node.fact != null:
            var folded = _apply_committed_player_fact_owned(result, node.fact, int(indexes[node.uuid]), indexes, composed_senses, cells, actor_snapshots,retained)
            if not folded.ok: return folded
            if node.fact.kind == "sensory":
                composed_senses = true
                cells.composed = true
        if profile != null:
            _profile_elapsed(profile, "facts", started)
            if not node.canceled and node.fact != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "fact_" + str(node.fact.kind), started)
        started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
        if recorded != null:
            recorded.events.append({"event_uuid":node.uuid, "source_index":indexes[node.uuid],
                "actor_inputs":inputs, "delta":Transitions.capture_delta(result,node,admitted,update,actor_snapshots,retained,disclosed)})
        if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "captures", started)
    while next < pending.size():
        var observation: Dictionary = pending[next]
        _observe(result, observation,retained,cells)
        if recorded != null:
            recorded.trailing.actors[observation.actor.uuid] = result.actors[observation.actor.uuid] if retained else Transitions.snapshot_actor(result.actors[observation.actor.uuid])
            if observation.contact != null: recorded.trailing.set.senses = result.senses if retained else Transitions.snapshot_senses(result.senses)
        next += 1
    return success(result)
```

### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/reducer.gd::_reduce_operation`

```gdscript
static func _reduce_operation(target: Dictionary, update: Dictionary, record_events: bool, profile: Variant = null, retained: bool = false, sensory_context: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
    var records = {"lineages":[]} if record_events else {}
    var audience = Audience.resolve(target.observer_uuid, target.audience)
    if not audience.ok: return audience
    if update.audience != audience.value:
        return failure("An operation cannot change its authorized audience")
    var started: int = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
    var result = _retained_target(target) if retained else copy_target(target)
    var cells = {}
    if retained and is_same(sensory_context.get("state"),target) and is_same(sensory_context.get("perception"),target.perception) and is_same(sensory_context.get("senses"),target.senses):
        cells = Audience._fork_cells(sensory_context.get("cells",{}))
    if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "copy", started)
    if not update.content_additions.is_empty():
        var content = {}
        for row in result.content: content[content_key(row)] = row
        for descriptor in update.content_additions:
            var key = content_key(descriptor)
            if content.has(key) and content[key] != descriptor:
                return failure("An admitted content identity changed its definition")
            content[key] = descriptor.duplicate(true)
        var identities: Array = content.keys()
        identities.sort(); result.content = []
        for key in identities: result.content.append(content[key])
    for lineage in update.lineages:
        if lineage.start_cursor != result.reducer_cursor:
            return failure("Operation occurrence sequence has a gap")
        var recorded: Variant = {"lineage_uuid":lineage.lineage_uuid, "start_cursor":lineage.start_cursor,
            "end_cursor":lineage.end_cursor, "events":[], "trailing":Transitions.empty_delta(), "world":{}} if record_events else null
        var folded = _reduce_lineage_owned(result, lineage, recorded, profile, cells if retained else {},retained)
        if not folded.ok: return folded
        result = folded.value
        if record_events: records.lineages.append(recorded)
    started = Time.get_ticks_usec() if profile != null else 0
    var hud: Variant = update.hud
    if hud != null:
        if hud.generation != result.generation or hud.observer_uuid != result.observer_uuid or hud.revision > result.reducer_cursor or (result.hud_snapshot != null and hud.revision < result.hud_snapshot.revision):
            return failure("HUD belongs to a different or future operation")
        result.hud_snapshot = hud.duplicate(true)
    var first: int = result.combat_log_appends.size()
    for i in range(update.combat_log_appends.size()):
        var row: Dictionary = update.combat_log_appends[i]
        if row.generation != result.generation or row.observer_uuid != result.observer_uuid or row.operation_end_cursor > result.reducer_cursor or row.encounter_log_index != first + i:
            return failure("Standalone log append is out of order or belongs to another audience")
    if not update.combat_log_appends.is_empty():
        if retained:result.combat_log_appends=result.combat_log_appends.duplicate()
        result.combat_log_appends.append_array(update.combat_log_appends.duplicate(true))
    var accepted = success(result)
    if record_events: accepted.transitions = records
    if retained:
        # Only a multi-member projection needs a second composed cell index.
        # A retained one-member view borrows its member's canonical collections.
        if cells.get("composed",false) and result.senses != null and result.perception.members.size()!=1:
            if not cells.has("view") or not is_same(cells.view.source,result.senses):
                cells.view = Audience._indexed_senses(result.senses)
        accepted.sensory_context = {"state":result, "perception":result.perception,
            "senses":result.senses, "cells":cells}
    if profile != null: _profile_elapsed(profile, "finalize", started)
    return accepted
```


### Original `9b73f29a:sdk/audience.gd::_fork_cells`

```gdscript
static func _fork_cells(previous: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
    var result = {"members":{}, "composed":previous.get("composed",false)}
    for observer in previous.get("members",{}):
        result.members[observer] = _fork_indexed_senses(previous.members[observer])
    if previous.has("view"): result.view = _fork_indexed_senses(previous.view)
    return result
```

## C. Item source observation and material ownership

### C1. Restore relevance before item membership scans

`native_items.gd` did not exist at baseline. `78be810b` introduced broad nonempty-owner observation, `c80cffc5` added intrinsic owners but improved repeated membership scans into one `locations()` pass, `0fdaa552` added real item membership rows, and `291e092c` added global authored coatings. Preserve those selected resources, exact item/member UUIDs and all equipment slots. Do not restore creation-only ownership, discard ranged/offhand sources or turn real intrinsic effects off.

The complete minimal guard below removes only unrelated tile/object/turn commits once owners exist; any actor, item, senses or audience change retains observation. This does not claim incremental per-actor observation: real actor damage/full after-values still trigger the shared current scan. Compiler's broad relevance guard and Timeline's separate actual commit phase remain. `samples()` already uses stored owner locations; do not label it a per-frame membership rebuild.


### C1 complete proposed `presentation/native_items.gd::interested`

```gdscript
static func interested(owners:Dictionary,delta:Dictionary,cache:Dictionary)->bool:
    if not owners.is_empty():
        # Location depends only on actors/loadouts/inventory and the current
        # observed/controlled actor membership, never unrelated floor objects.
        return not delta.get("actors",{}).is_empty() or not delta.get("items",{}).is_empty() \
            or delta.get("set",{}).has("senses") or delta.get("set",{}).has("audience")
    var entries:Dictionary=definitions(cache)
    if not entries.is_empty() and delta.get("set",{}).has("senses"):return true
    if not entries.is_empty() and not delta.get("items",{}).is_empty():return true
    for actor in delta.get("actors",{}).values():
        for layer in actor.get("visual_loadout",{}).get("layers",[]):
            if entries.has(layer.item_id):return true
    return false

## One membership pass at a canonical change, shared by all effects on an item.
## Cached item metadata alone cannot establish current presence/disclosure.
```


### C2. Withdraw this source's actual equipped material lease on hide

Current `Effects.hide` hides an occurrence subtree and withdraws actor context but leaves materials applied to the separate actor weapon mesh. Endpoint refusal in `NativeSpellRenderer.sample` can reach hide before input sampling, so the source may neither receive an invalid binding nor run its release path. Root visibility is insufficient for those external material claims.

`ba5d0262` introduced the hide/provider behavior after baseline. Later equipped consumers (`d4eb31de`, `2bb7ede2`, `291e092c`) expose this gap. Delivered `treatment.gd::set_weapon_binding({})` calls the source `_hide`, and `direct_blade_material.gd::_release_material` checks its exact weak owner before restoring shader parameters. The candidate uses that **existing public invalid-binding operation**, never clears another source's materials and never edits sealed code. It erases the client delivery key so an identical valid packet is actually re-sent on genuine re-admission. It does not retire the canonical item/member, reset clocks, resample a fake age or call `clear()` (which permanently retires the source).

Source limits: verify every selected delivered weapon-binding implementation's public invalid-binding behavior in the grouped proof. Direct primary material release is source-proven; unrelated occurrence child meshes are already hidden by the parent and are not authority to mutate external materials. If a future wrapper does not forward invalid binding, it needs that concrete public source boundary addressed rather than direct shader reset code.

## D. Cold metadata: old code is available, unsafe rollback is not the plan

`f489896f` replaced direct `CACHE_MODE_REUSE` body metadata reads with an explicit physical owner plus `CACHE_MODE_IGNORE` reads on a new Thread per cold leaf; `5b12fdf6` serialized passive reads across domains. Current cache hits do not repeat that work, and immutable body/clip ownership is retained by admitted index. The workaround's own source names a real WorkerThreadPool/nested ResourceLoader dependency and token-lifetime hazard. Do not remove its shared owner, change cache modes, bypass a real loader token, or restore native admission's `has_cached -> load()` shortcut just to remove a cost.

**Conditional recovery path, not ready code:** retain the current one physical immutable owner keyed by actual admitted body index. Recover Opus's one source read per immutable path and its direct cache route only after establishing a safe caller/loader boundary for this pinned engine. Prefer moving the existing metadata preparation job's finite closure through one already-existing reader lifetime over one thread start/join per leaf, with the current cancellation and revision owner. No new global worker manager, no second queue, no main-thread cold load, no all-library preload and no recursive descriptor scan. The current call chain discovers some clip metadata incrementally, so a complete batching closure cannot be asserted from a list of top-level paths alone.

The following are **literal original functions**, provided as requested. They are not unconditional replacements. A future implementation must either prove these exact loads safe under the current pinned caller/engine or provide the complete minimally adapted loader/owner closure before product application. Thread/mutex/loader exclusive milliseconds have not been isolated. The earlier 97–130 ms canceled selection leaves are not proof all that time is this wrapper.

```gdscript
static func _current_index(path:String)->Index:
```

### D original `9b73f29a:presentation/body_sources.gd::_load` — conditional rollback reference

```gdscript
static func _load(path:String,cache:Dictionary,kind:String)->Resource:
    if path.is_empty():return null
    var current:Dictionary=admission(cache)
    var measured:bool=cache.has("__actor_source_profile")
    if current.loaded.has(path):
        if measured:
            var admission_metrics:Dictionary=cache.__actor_source_profile
            var field:String=kind+"_cache_hits"
            admission_metrics[field]=int(admission_metrics.get(field,0))+1
        return current.loaded[path]
    # Revision-specific paths are immutable. Share this physical metadata owner;
    # no scene, Texture2D or mutable occurrence dependency is present here.
    var started:int=Time.get_ticks_usec() if measured else 0
    var resource=ResourceLoader.load(path,"",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE)
    if measured:
        # Native CACHE_REUSE may return a previously loaded Resource or wait
        # for another loader. This measures that call, not disk-cold I/O.
        var elapsed:int=Time.get_ticks_usec()-started
        var metrics:Dictionary=cache.__actor_source_profile
        var prefix:String=kind+"_resource_load_"
        metrics[prefix+"calls"]=int(metrics.get(prefix+"calls",0))+1
        metrics[prefix+"usec"]=int(metrics.get(prefix+"usec",0))+elapsed
        if not metrics.has(prefix+"paths"):metrics[prefix+"paths"]={}
        var row:Dictionary=metrics[prefix+"paths"].get(path,{"calls":0,"usec":0})
        row.calls+=1;row.usec+=elapsed
        metrics[prefix+"paths"][path]=row
    if resource==null:return null
    var loaded:Dictionary=current.loaded.duplicate();loaded[path]=resource;loaded.make_read_only()
    var next={"index":current.index,"loaded":loaded};next.make_read_only();cache[KEY]=next
    return resource
```


## E. Preparation, source ownership and actor history

### E1. Keep Opus fast paths that survived; do not rewrite them

Current native physical source/admitted material caches, due-group component reuse, shared immutable quads, private actor/environment preparation workers, prepared membership keys, native scene proxy uniform ledgers, light table/cookie ownership, unchanged-actor shadow reuse and Blood's field/kernel/uniform/upload caches remain. The old staged binary index and source-opening handoff also remain. They do not need another abstraction. Retain actual preparation epochs, private materials, full-interest cancellation and exact final membership publication.

**Never restore baseline native admission wholesale.** Baseline `prepare` had `ResourceLoader.has_cached(path) -> load(path)`, which can observe a resource still loading under a different owner. Current admission requires its actual requested threaded token to reach LOADED, validates revision, then retains the draw/compiler fence. Current 82a optional source jobs additionally retain exact owner identity through cancel/drain, urgent foreground handoff and same-owner expansion (`step_owned_source` before new path admission). Bypassing this can recreate deadlocks/native lifetime faults. `can_mutate` may poll completion, but normal progressive source work is owner-stepped, not query-driven. Mixed Baked recorded loading is a separate real owner/queue; its unchanged source route does not prove a mixed performance result.

### E2. Full viewport history is new cost; modes must remain distinct

`ba5d0262` is **not** an ancestor of `9b73f29a`; it is dated 19-Oct23:26 after first Sol migration at16:55. Baseline Mirror Image selected finite reference staging/recorded package content with no actual `actor_context` input. Do not call the current actual-actor provider an inherited seven-pass baseline path.

Current active Mirror with three copies uses 1 live colour +3×(colour+depth) **seven full-viewport UPDATE_ALWAYS passes**. Mirror skips immutable captures. Delayed non-Mirror histories use actual one-shot colour/depth and optional dependency captures; completed viewports are disabled and unused per-copy passes are disabled. Do not claim seven continuously updating immutable histories, a byte total without actual formats, or measured GPU milliseconds without a saved receipt.

### E3. Bounded design path for the unsliced prefix — not yet executable replacement

`native_inputs.gd::prepare_history` gathers actual recorded predecessor frames, including the source's 60 Hz points; `seed_history` realizes all retained predecessors in one loop from `sample -> sync`. That realization has no internal per-unit allowance. By contrast, current renderer allocation already loops `prepare_actor_context` inside the remaining shared allowance and rejects sampling until allocated.

Use the **existing handle, existing prepare loop and the existing shared frame allowance** for the missing realization stage: retain an index into that exact already-admitted capture array; advance complete private predecessor requests in original order under the allowance; retain each actual request/draw identity; let ordinary sample only verify completion and bind the real current packet. On cancellation/view/epoch change, the existing exact owned captures must suspend/close/drain as today. Never sample displayed occurrences at historical ages, rebuild a new timeline, reduce facts a second time, drop predecessors, use a frame-count sleep or advance a fake clock.

**Exact design work still required before executable code:** show that the delivered helper permits this partial-prefix ownership across frames without an interleaved current sample changing its view/elapsed history; define target-prefix immutability when display time advances while preparing; show placement of prefix work in the current prepare call after topology allocation and before optical publication without starving it behind the same pending gate. This note does not pretend adding a cursor inside `seed_history` alone solves those ordering issues. No candidate calls an invented `prepare_prefix` Factory API.

### E4. Full-view cost reduction has a public source boundary

An actor-bounds crop must preserve exact source texel density, alpha, depth encoding, original optical transforms, receiver depth, occlusion, native hit/material dependencies and public copy placement for all camera modes. Current public actor context explicitly supplies viewport-sized capture and the delivered source maps full-screen textures. The client cannot silently crop/downsample or reinterpret that mapping, reuse a current body as immutable history, or change Mirror/delayed visual semantics. Inspect any actually delivered 1dcd source contract during later intake. If it offers no equivalent bounded registration, document the exact source equations/input contract and ask Factory for an equivalent public bounded capture path; do not invent a mandatory API name or new renderer. Until then this is a real unmeasured source cost/remaining design item, not a reason to remove the selected effect.

For completeness the exact client functions defining this unresolved boundary are copied below. They are **current source references**, not a new repair or a proposal to restore them from baseline. The allocation/source/membership safety repairs already qualified must survive any future bounded realization.


### E current `presentation/native_inputs.gd::actor_context` — unresolved budget/source boundary reference

```gdscript
static func actor_context(world:Node,actor:String,receiver_depth:Texture2D)->Dictionary:
    var visual:Dictionary=world.visual_actors.get(actor,{})
    if not Sockets.displayed(visual):return {"ready":false,"reason":"actor_not_displayed"}
    if not world.camera is Camera3D or receiver_depth==null:return {"ready":false,"reason":"actor_context_receiver_not_prepared"}
    var pose:Dictionary=visual.get("sampled_pose",{})
    if pose.is_empty():return {"ready":false,"reason":"actor_pose_not_sampled"}
    var layers:Array=[];var revision:Array=[]
    for entry in visual.entries:
        if entry.role=="shadow" or not entry.node.is_visible_in_tree():continue
        var effect:Dictionary=entry.actor_layer.get("effect",{})
        if not effect.is_empty() and effect.get("kind")!="condition_appearance":continue
        layers.append({"slot":entry.actor_layer.slot,"node":entry.node,"material":entry.material,
            "received_material":entry.material,"pivot":entry.pivot,"ground_pixels":entry.get("geometry_ground_pixels",19.0)})
        revision.append([entry.node.get_instance_id(),entry.material.get_instance_id(),entry.get("source_version",0),entry.get("source_binding_revision",0)])
    if layers.is_empty():return {"ready":false,"reason":"actor_layers_not_displayed"}
    var dependencies:Array=[]
    var flash:Dictionary=Construction.Conditions.material(actor,world.displayed_components).get("flash",{})
    if not flash.get("native_hit",{}).is_empty() and world.native_spell_hit_material:
        var native:Dictionary=world.component_renderer.native_hits.history_material(flash)
        if not native.ready:return native
        dependencies.append(native.dependency)
    return {"ready":true,"packet":{"actor_uuid":actor,"camera":world.camera,"receiver_depth":receiver_depth,
        "depth_encoding":"rgb24_reversed_z","capture_size":Vector2i(world.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size),
        "origin":Sockets.Placement.contact(visual.row),"layers":layers,"pose_key":pose.key,
        "material_revision":revision,"material_dependencies":dependencies,
        "capture_identity":{"actor_uuid":actor,"display_ms":world.timeline.display_ms,
            "native_results":dependencies.map(func(value):return value.identity)}}}
```

```gdscript
static func capture_view_key(world:Node)->Array:
    var camera:Camera3D=world.camera

    # new private pixels without changing the original logical departure.
    return [Vector2i(world.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size),camera.global_transform,
        camera.projection,camera.keep_aspect,camera.size,camera.near,camera.far,
```

### E current `presentation/native_inputs.gd::prepare_history` — unresolved budget/source boundary reference

```gdscript
func prepare_history(world:Node,handle:Dictionary,component:Dictionary,admit:bool=true)->Dictionary:
    var owner:String=str(component.get("condition_uuid",""))
    if not world.timeline.condition_owners.has(owner):return {"ready":true,"pending":false}
    var key:Array=history_key(world,handle,component)
    if handle.get("history_seeded_key",[])==key or handle.get("history_sources_ready_key",[])==key:return {"ready":true,"pending":false}
    if not admit:return {"ready":false,"pending":true}
    var at:float=world.timeline.display_ms
    if handle.get("history_prepare_key",[])!=key:
        var maximum:float=0.0
        for specification in handle.occurrence.parameters.actor_history.specifications:maximum=maxf(maximum,float(specification.get("delay",0.0)))
        var delays:Array=[0.0,maximum]
        for step in range(1,ceili(maximum*60.0)):delays.append(float(step)/60.0)
        for specification in handle.occurrence.parameters.actor_history.specifications:
            var delay:float=float(specification.get("delay",0.0))
            if delay not in delays:delays.append(delay)
        var observed:Dictionary=world.timeline.history_captures(recipient(component),owner,at,delays)
        if not observed.ready:return {"ready":false,"pending":false,"reason":observed.reason}
        handle.history_prepare_key=key;handle.history_captures=observed.captures
        handle.history_allocation_step=0;handle.erase("history_allocated")
        handle.history_capture_range={"from_ms":observed.get("available_from_ms",at),"to_ms":at,"complete_window":observed.get("complete_window",false)}
        handle.history_active_sources={}
    var sources:Dictionary=handle.get("history_sources",{})
    handle.history_sources=sources
    var representatives:Dictionary={}
    for capture in handle.history_captures:
        var source_key:Array=_history_source_key(capture)
        if representatives.has(source_key):continue
        representatives[source_key]=true
        handle.history_active_sources[source_key]=true
        if not sources.has(source_key):sources[source_key]={"occurrence":handle.occurrence,"clip":handle.clip,"root":handle.root}
        var row:Dictionary=sources[source_key]
        row.history_draw_captures=handle.history_captures.filter(func(value):return _history_source_key(value)==source_key)
        var bound:Dictionary=component.duplicate(false);bound.logical_pose=row.get("departure_capture",capture)
        var prepared:Dictionary=prepare_departure(world,row,bound)
        if not prepared.ready:return prepared
    handle.history_sources_ready_key=key
    return {"ready":true,"pending":false}
```


### E current `presentation/native_inputs.gd::seed_history` — unresolved budget/source boundary reference

```gdscript
func seed_history(world:Node,handle:Dictionary,component:Dictionary,receiver_depth:Texture2D)->Dictionary:
    var key:Array=history_key(world,handle,component)
    if handle.get("history_seeded_key",[])==key:return {"ready":true}
    # A normal admission starts with real current observations. The source
    # correctly omits delayed copies until their original predecessors exist.
    if float(component.get("age_ms",INF))<=1000.0/60.0:
        handle.history_seeded_key=key;return {"ready":true}
    var prepared:Dictionary=prepare_history(world,handle,component)
    if not prepared.ready:return prepared
    var helper:RefCounted=handle.occurrence.actor_history
    if handle.get("history_requested_key",[])!=key:
        for capture in handle.get("history_captures",[]):
            var source:Dictionary=handle.history_sources[_history_source_key(capture)]
            var packet:Dictionary=_private_layer_context(world,source,capture,receiver_depth)
            if not packet.ready:return packet
            if not handle.occurrence.call(handle.clip.input_setters.actor_context,packet.packet):return {"ready":false,"reason":"actor_history_prefix_not_accepted"}
            # Only private original layers and the capture sampler see these
            # historical ages. No displayed occurrence is rewound.
            var seconds:float=maxf(0.0,float(capture.sample_ms)-float(capture.admitted_at_ms))/1000.0
            helper.sample(seconds)
            if helper.history.is_empty():helper.sample(seconds)
        handle.history_requested_key=key
    else:
        # The exact active owner can return after an optical withdrawal while
        # its immutable prefix draws are still unfinished. Re-arm those same
        # requests; replaying historical source samples would change ownership.
        for poses in helper.history.values():
            for pose in poses:
                if pose.has("capture"):HistoryOwner.Capture.resume(pose.capture)
    var status:Dictionary=capture_status(handle)
    if not status.ready:return status
    handle.history_seeded_key=key
    for source_key in handle.get("history_sources",{}).keys():
        if not handle.history_active_sources.has(source_key):
            release_departure(handle.history_sources[source_key]);handle.history_sources.erase(source_key)
    return {"ready":true}
```

```gdscript
extends Window
## A study exists independently of its recording and presentation implementation.
signal recording_selected(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary,record:Dictionary)
signal recording_unavailable
const Catalog=preload("res://studio/study_catalog.gd")
var report:Dictionary={}
var worker:Thread
var request:Dictionary={}
var generation=0
var installed_generation=-1
var search:LineEdit
var kind_picker:OptionButton
var tree:Tree
var title_label:Label
var purpose:Label
var sequence:RichTextLabel
var expectations:Tree
var requirements:Tree
var recording_picker:OptionButton
var open_button:Button
var recording_note:Label
var summary:Label
var selected_capability:Dictionary={}
var selected_scenario:Dictionary={}
var recording_options:Array=[]
var filtered:Array=[]
var pending_rows:Array=[]
var row_cursor=0
var preferred_id=""
var preferred_scenario=""
var refresh_pending=false
var error=""

func _ready()->void:
    title="Studio library · capabilities and study sequences"
    size=Vector2i(1140,680);min_size=Vector2i(820,500)
    close_requested.connect(hide)
    var outer=MarginContainer.new();outer.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT);add_child(outer)
    for side in ["left","right","top","bottom"]:outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_"+side,10)
    var box=VBoxContainer.new();outer.add_child(box)
    var tools=HBoxContainer.new();box.add_child(tools)
    kind_picker=OptionButton.new();tools.add_child(kind_picker)
    for kind in ["All","Action","Spell","Condition","Mechanic","VFX"]:kind_picker.add_item(kind)
    kind_picker.item_selected.connect(func(_i):refresh_pending=true)
    search=LineEdit.new();search.placeholder_text="Find a capability or interaction";search.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;tools.add_child(search)
    search.text_changed.connect(func(_text):refresh_pending=true)
    var copy=Button.new();copy.text="Copy study";tools.add_child(copy);copy.pressed.connect(copy_study)
    summary=Label.new();summary.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);box.add_child(summary)
    var split=HSplitContainer.new();split.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;box.add_child(split)
    tree=Tree.new();tree.hide_root=true;tree.columns=2;tree.column_titles_visible=true;tree.select_mode=Tree.SELECT_ROW;tree.allow_reselect=true
    tree.set_column_title(0,"Capability / interaction");tree.set_column_title(1,"Study / recording")
    tree.set_column_expand_ratio(0,3);tree.set_column_expand_ratio(1,2)
    tree.custom_minimum_size.x=350;tree.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_FILL;split.add_child(tree)
    tree.item_selected.connect(_selection)
    var details=VBoxContainer.new();details.custom_minimum_size.x=410;details.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;split.add_child(details)
    title_label=Label.new();title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",18);title_label.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;details.add_child(title_label)
    purpose=Label.new();purpose.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;purpose.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);details.add_child(purpose)
    var tabs=TabContainer.new();tabs.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;details.add_child(tabs)
    var study=VBoxContainer.new();study.name="Study sequence";tabs.add_child(study)
    sequence=RichTextLabel.new();sequence.custom_minimum_size.y=105;sequence.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;study.add_child(sequence)
    expectations=Tree.new();expectations.hide_root=true;expectations.columns=3;expectations.column_titles_visible=true
    for i in 3:expectations.set_column_title(i,["Phase","Participant","Expected presentation"][i])
    expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(0,1);expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(1,1);expectations.set_column_expand_ratio(2,3)
    expectations.custom_minimum_size.y=180;expectations.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;study.add_child(expectations)
    requirements=Tree.new();requirements.name="Authoring";requirements.hide_root=true;requirements.columns=2;requirements.column_titles_visible=true
    requirements.set_column_title(0,"Declared requirement");requirements.set_column_title(1,"Authoring / implementation")
    requirements.set_column_expand_ratio(0,3);requirements.set_column_expand_ratio(1,2);tabs.add_child(requirements)
    var recordings=HBoxContainer.new();details.add_child(recordings)
    recording_picker=OptionButton.new();recording_picker.fit_to_longest_item=false;recording_picker.clip_text=true;recording_picker.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;recordings.add_child(recording_picker)
    recording_picker.item_selected.connect(func(choice):_recording_changed(choice);open_selected_recording())
    open_button=Button.new();open_button.text="Open recording";open_button.disabled=true;recordings.add_child(open_button);open_button.pressed.connect(open_selected_recording)
    recording_note=Label.new();recording_note.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART;recording_note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",12);details.add_child(recording_note)
    show_selection({}, {})

func open(cache:Dictionary,records:Array,capability_id:String="",scenario_id:String="")->void:
    generation+=1;preferred_id=capability_id;preferred_scenario=scenario_id
    request={"generation":generation,"cache":cache.duplicate(),"records":records}
    report={};error="";pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;tree.clear();show_selection({}, {})
    summary.text="Reading capability definitions, study sequences and authoring…"
    popup_centered(Vector2i(mini(1140,DisplayServer.window_get_size().x-40),mini(680,DisplayServer.window_get_size().y-40)))
    _start()

func _start()->void:
    if worker!=null or request.is_empty():return
    var job=request;request={};worker=Thread.new()
    var started=worker.start(_build.bind(job))
    if started!=OK:worker=null;error=error_string(started);summary.text=error

static func _build(job:Dictionary)->Dictionary:
    return {"generation":job.generation,"report":Catalog.build(job.cache,job.records)}

func _process(_delta:float)->void:
    if worker!=null and not worker.is_alive():
        var result=worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
        if result.generation==generation:
            report=result.report;installed_generation=generation
            error="; ".join(report.get("errors",[]));refresh_pending=true
        _start()
    if refresh_pending and installed_generation==generation:
        refresh_pending=false;_filter()
    var started=Time.get_ticks_usec();var count=0
    while row_cursor<pending_rows.size() and count<24 and Time.get_ticks_usec()-started<2000:
        var entry:Dictionary=pending_rows[row_cursor];row_cursor+=1;count+=1
        var item=tree.create_item(entry.get("parent",tree.get_root()))
        item.set_text(0,entry.scenario.get("label",entry.capability.label));item.set_metadata(0,entry)
        if entry.scenario.is_empty():
            item.set_text(1,"Study needed" if entry.capability.scenarios.is_empty() else "%d studies"%entry.capability.scenarios.size())
            item.set_tooltip_text(0,str(entry.capability.id)+"\n"+str(entry.capability.get("source","")))
            item.collapsed=search.text.is_empty() and entry.capability.id!=preferred_id
            for scenario in entry.capability.scenarios:
                if search.text.is_empty() or _matches(entry.capability,scenario,search.text.to_lower()):
                    pending_rows.append({"capability":entry.capability,"scenario":scenario,"parent":item})
        else:
            item.set_text(1,recording_state(entry.scenario))
        if entry.capability.id==preferred_id and ((preferred_scenario.is_empty() and entry.scenario.is_empty()) or (not preferred_scenario.is_empty() and entry.scenario.get("id","")==preferred_scenario)):
            # Restoring a highlighted row is not a new user navigation request.
            tree.set_block_signals(true);item.select(0);tree.set_block_signals(false)
            show_selection(entry.capability,entry.scenario)
    if row_cursor==pending_rows.size() and not pending_rows.is_empty():pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0

func is_prepared()->bool:
    return installed_generation==generation and worker==null and request.is_empty() and pending_rows.is_empty() and not refresh_pending

static func _matches(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary,query:String)->bool:
    return query in (str(capability.id)+" "+str(capability.label)+" "+str(scenario.get("label",""))+" "+str(scenario.get("purpose",""))).to_lower()

func _filter()->void:
    filtered=[];pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;tree.clear();tree.create_item()
    show_selection({}, {})
    var kind=kind_picker.get_item_text(kind_picker.selected);var query=search.text.to_lower()
    for capability in report.get("capabilities",[]):
        if kind!="All" and capability.kind!=kind:continue
        if not query.is_empty() and not _matches(capability,{},query) and not capability.scenarios.any(func(s):return _matches(capability,s,query)):continue
        filtered.append(capability);pending_rows.append({"capability":capability,"scenario":{}})
    summary.text="%d capabilities · %d studies · %d need a study sequence"%[report.capabilities.size(),report.counts.scenarios,report.counts.study_needed]
    if not error.is_empty():summary.text+=" · Catalogue issues: "+error

static func recording_state(scenario:Dictionary)->String:
    var available=scenario.get("recordings",[]).filter(func(r):return r.get("available",false))
    if available.is_empty():return "Needs recording"
    return "Recorded" if available.any(func(r):return r.get("evidence")=="recorded") else "Partial recording"

func _selection()->void:
    var selected=tree.get_selected()
    if selected==null:return
    var data:Dictionary=selected.get_metadata(0)
    show_selection(data.capability,data.scenario)
    if data.scenario.is_empty():selected.collapsed=false
    elif not recording_options.is_empty():open_selected_recording()
    else:recording_unavailable.emit()

func show_selection(capability:Dictionary,scenario:Dictionary)->void:
    selected_capability=capability;selected_scenario=scenario
    title_label.text=scenario.get("label",capability.get("label","Choose a capability"))
    purpose.text=scenario.get("purpose", "Study sequences have not been authored yet." if not capability.is_empty() and capability.scenarios.is_empty() else "Select an interaction to inspect its sequence and expected presentation.")
    sequence.clear();expectations.clear();requirements.clear();recording_picker.clear();recording_options=[];open_button.disabled=true
    if scenario.is_empty():
        sequence.text="" if capability.is_empty() else "This capability remains visible independently of recordings or renderer support."
    else:
        var lines:Array[String]=[]
        var setup=scenario.get("setup","")
        if not str(setup).is_empty():lines.append("Setup: "+str(setup))
        for i in scenario.get("sequence",[]).size():lines.append(str(i+1)+". "+str(scenario.sequence[i]))
        sequence.text="\n".join(lines)
    var expected_root=expectations.create_item()
    for expected in scenario.get("expectations",[]):
        var item=expectations.create_item(expected_root)
        item.set_text(0,str(expected.get("phase","")));item.set_text(1,", ".join(expected.get("participants",[])));item.set_text(2,str(expected.label))
        var pointers=expected.get("authoring_sources",[])+expected.get("rule_sources",[])
        for i in 3:item.set_tooltip_text(i,str(expected.label)+"\n"+str(expected.get("description",""))+"\nParticipants: "+", ".join(expected.get("participants",[]))+"\n"+"\n".join(pointers))
        item.set_metadata(0,expected)
    var requirement_root=requirements.create_item()
    for requirement in capability.get("requirements",[]):
        var item=requirements.create_item(requirement_root)
        item.set_text(0,str(requirement.get("label",requirement.get("id",""))))
        var gap:String=requirement.get("gap_kind",requirement.get("status","unexercised"))
        var labels={"unexercised":"Assigned · unqualified","authoring_assignment":"Needs assignment","authoring_review":"Needs authoring decision","renderer":"Renderer missing","inspection":"Studio track missing","unassessed":"Not assessed","source":"Source missing","native_migration":"Native integration needed","explicit_none":"Explicitly disabled"}
        item.set_text(1,labels.get(gap,gap.replace("_"," ")))
        for i in 2:item.set_tooltip_text(i,str(requirement.get("source",""))+"\n"+str(requirement.get("reason","")))
        item.set_metadata(0,requirement)
    for binding in scenario.get("recordings",[]):
        if not binding.get("available",false):continue
        recording_options.append(binding)
        recording_picker.add_item(str(binding.record.label)+(" · partial" if binding.evidence=="partial" else ""))
    recording_picker.disabled=recording_options.is_empty()
    if recording_options.is_empty():
        recording_picker.add_item("No recording")
        recording_note.text="Record this sequence before evaluating its presentation." if not scenario.is_empty() else "Source assignments and a completed animation model are separate from a study sequence."
    else:_recording_changed(0)

func _recording_changed(choice:int)->void:
    open_button.disabled=choice<0 or choice>=recording_options.size()
    if open_button.disabled:return
    var selected:Dictionary=recording_options[choice]
    recording_note.text="\n".join(selected.get("gaps",[])) if selected.evidence=="partial" else "Recorded behavior; presentation implementation and visual qualification remain separate."

func open_selected_recording()->void:
    var i=recording_picker.selected
    if i<0 or i>=recording_options.size():return
    recording_selected.emit(selected_capability,selected_scenario,recording_options[i].record)
    hide()

func copy_study()->void:
    if selected_capability.is_empty():return
    var selected={"capability":selected_capability.id,"scenario":selected_scenario,"requirements":selected_capability.requirements}
    DisplayServer.clipboard_set(JSON.stringify(selected,"  "))

func _exit_tree()->void:
    if worker!=null:worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
```

```gdscript
    var bottom=HBoxContainer.new();box.add_child(bottom);recording_picker=OptionButton.new();recording_picker.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;recording_picker.fit_to_longest_item=false;recording_picker.clip_text=true;bottom.add_child(recording_picker)
    recording_picker.item_selected.connect(func(_choice):_open())
    var copy_button=Button.new();copy_button.text="Copy details";bottom.add_child(copy_button);copy_button.pressed.connect(copy_study)
    open_button=Button.new();open_button.text="Play";open_button.disabled=true;bottom.add_child(open_button);open_button.pressed.connect(_open)
    prefix_button=Button.new();prefix_button.text="Inspect failed prefix";prefix_button.disabled=true;bottom.add_child(prefix_button);prefix_button.pressed.connect(_inspect_prefix)
func open(_cache:Dictionary,_records:Array,preferred:String="",scenario:String="")->void:
    search.set_block_signals(true);search.text="";search.set_block_signals(false)
    kind_picker.select(0);status_picker.select(0)
    _request_catalog(preferred,scenario)
    popup_centered(Vector2i(mini(1120,DisplayServer.window_get_size().x-40),mini(640,DisplayServer.window_get_size().y-40)))

func _request_catalog(preferred:String,scenario:String)->void:
    generation+=1;preferred_id=preferred;preferred_scenario=scenario
    request={"generation":generation}
    report={};error="";pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;published_rows={};preferred_item=null
    tree.clear();recording_options=[];recording_picker.clear();selected_capability={};selected_scenario={}
    open_button.disabled=true;prefix_button.disabled=true;prefix_record={};prefix_perspectives=[];detail.text=""
    summary.text="Reading capability definitions, cases and retained evidence…"
    _start()

func _reload_catalog()->void:
    var preferred:String="";var scenario:String=""
    if tree.get_selected()!=null:
        var selected:Variant=tree.get_selected().get_metadata(0)
        if selected is Dictionary:
            preferred=str(selected.capability.get("key",selected.capability.id))
            scenario=str(selected.case.get("id",""))

func _start()->void:
    if worker!=null or request.is_empty():return

    if started!=OK:

static func _build(job:Dictionary)->Dictionary:

func _process(_delta:float)->void:

    if refresh_pending and installed_generation==generation:
        refresh_pending=false;_filter()
    var started:int=Time.get_ticks_usec();var count:int=0
    rebuilding=true
    while row_cursor<pending_rows.size() and count<24 and Time.get_ticks_usec()-started<2000:
        var entry:Dictionary=pending_rows[row_cursor];row_cursor+=1;count+=1

    if row_cursor==pending_rows.size() and not pending_rows.is_empty():
        pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0
        if preferred_item!=null:

func _refresh(preferred:String="",scenario:String="")->void:
    if preferred.is_empty() and tree.get_selected()!=null:
        var previous:Variant=tree.get_selected().get_metadata(0)
        if previous is Dictionary:
            preferred=str(previous.capability.get("key",previous.capability.id));scenario=str(previous.case.get("id",""))

func _filter()->void:
    rebuilding=true;tree.clear();tree.create_item();pending_rows=[];row_cursor=0;published_rows={};preferred_item=null
    var query:String=search.text.strip_edges().to_lower()
    var category:String=kind_picker.get_item_text(kind_picker.selected)
    selected_capability={};selected_scenario={};recording_options=[];recording_picker.clear()
    open_button.disabled=true;prefix_button.disabled=true;prefix_record={};prefix_perspectives=[];detail.text=""
    var categories:Dictionary={};var groups:Dictionary={}
    var count:int=0;var recorded:int=0;var evidenced:int=0;var awaiting_review:int=0
    for entry in report.get("entries",[]):
        if not Library.matches(entry,query,category if kind_picker.selected>0 else "",str(status_picker.get_item_metadata(status_picker.selected))):continue
        var category_key:String="category:"+str(entry.category)
        if not categories.has(category_key):
            categories[category_key]=true
            pending_rows.append({"kind":"category","key":category_key,"parent":"","label":entry.category})
        var group_key:String="group:"+str(entry.category)+":"+str(entry.group)
        if not groups.has(group_key):
            groups[group_key]=true
            pending_rows.append({"kind":"group","key":group_key,"parent":category_key,"label":entry.group,
                "collapsed":query.is_empty() and entry.kind!="spell"})
        var capability_key:String="capability:"+str(entry.key)
        pending_rows.append({"kind":"capability","key":capability_key,"parent":group_key,
            "capability":entry,"case":{},"collapsed":query.is_empty()})
        count+=1
        if entry.scenario_status=="recorded":recorded+=1
        if not entry.get("output_witnesses",[]).is_empty():evidenced+=1
        if entry.approval_status=="needs_review":awaiting_review+=1
    summary.text="%d / %d capabilities · %d recorded · %d with linked evidence · %d awaiting art review"%[count,report.get("entries",[]).size(),recorded,evidenced,awaiting_review]
    rebuilding=false

func _publish_row(row:Dictionary)->void:
    var parent:TreeItem=published_rows.get(row.parent,tree.get_root())
    var item:TreeItem=tree.create_item(parent);published_rows[row.key]=item
    if row.kind in ["category","group"]:
        item.set_text(0,row.label);item.set_selectable(0,false);item.collapsed=row.get("collapsed",false);return
    var entry:Dictionary=row.capability
    var record:Dictionary=row.case
    item.set_metadata(0,{"capability":entry,"case":record})
    if row.kind=="case":
        item.set_text(0,record.label);item.set_text(2,record.scenario_status.replace("_"," "))
        item.set_text(3,_output_label(record));item.set_tooltip_text(3,_evidence_text(record.witnesses))
        if preferred_id in [str(entry.key),str(entry.id)] and record.id==preferred_scenario:
            preferred_item=item;parent.collapsed=false
        return
    item.set_text(0,entry.label);item.set_text(1,entry.source_status.replace("_"," "))
    item.set_text(2,entry.scenario_status.replace("_"," "));item.set_text(3,_output_label(entry));item.set_text(4,entry.approval_status.replace("_"," "))
    item.set_tooltip_text(3,_evidence_text(entry.get("witnesses",[])))
    if entry.approval_status=="rejected":item.set_custom_color(4,Color("eeaa9c"))
    item.set_tooltip_text(0,entry.id+("\nTyped source; not listed in the server snapshot. Runtime availability unverified." if entry.get("inventory_origin")=="typed_source" else ""))
    item.collapsed=row.collapsed
    if preferred_id in [str(entry.key),str(entry.id)] and preferred_item==null:preferred_item=item
    # Preserve Opus child enqueueing inside the bounded parent publication,
    # rather than eagerly flattening every linked case during filtering.
    for child_record in entry.cases:
        pending_rows.append({"kind":"case","key":str(row.key)+":case:"+str(child_record.id),
            "parent":row.key,"capability":entry,"case":child_record})

static func _output_label(owner:Dictionary)->String:
    if not owner.get("current_output_witnesses",[]).is_empty():return "Engine/package receipts"
    if not owner.get("matching_package_output_witnesses",[]).is_empty():return "Package receipts"
    if not owner.get("output_witnesses",[]).is_empty():return "Historical / unknown receipts"
    if not owner.get("reader_witnesses",[]).is_empty() or not owner.get("command_witnesses",[]).is_empty():return "Safety/command receipts only"
    if not owner.get("audio_witnesses",[]).is_empty():return "Audio transport receipts only"
    return "Not assessed"

static func _evidence_text(witnesses:Array)->String:
    if witnesses.is_empty():return "No saved output evidence is linked. Recording/source presence does not qualify rendered pixels or audible output."
    var lines:Array=[]
    for witness in witnesses:
        lines.append("%s · %s\n%s\nPackage: %s (%s)\nEngine: %s (%s)\n%s"%[str(witness.get("kind","output")).replace("_"," "),witness.get("status","reported"),witness.get("report",""),str(witness.get("factory_version","not recorded")),witness.get("package_scope","identity not recorded"),JSON.stringify(witness.get("engine",{})),witness.get("engine_scope","identity not recorded"),witness.get("qualifies","")])
    return "\n\n".join(lines)
func _selected(open_recording:bool=true)->void:
    if rebuilding:return
    var item=tree.get_selected()
    if item==null:return
    var selected:Variant=item.get_metadata(0)
    if not selected is Dictionary:return
    selected_capability=selected.capability;recording_options=[];recording_picker.clear();selected_scenario={}
    prefix_record={};prefix_perspectives=[];prefix_button.disabled=true;prefix_button.text="Inspect failed prefix";prefix_button.tooltip_text="Select a failed case with an actual initialized journal prefix."
    var candidates:Array=[selected.case] if not selected.case.is_empty() else selected_capability.cases
    for record in candidates:
        if record.ready:recording_options.append(record);recording_picker.add_item(record.label)
    recording_picker.disabled=recording_options.is_empty();open_button.disabled=recording_options.is_empty()
    if recording_options.is_empty():recording_picker.add_item("No current recording")
    detail.text="Art: %s   ·   Scenario: %s   ·   Presentation: %s   ·   Review: %s"%[selected_capability.source_status.replace("_"," "),selected_capability.scenario_status.replace("_"," "),selected_capability.presentation_status.replace("_"," "),selected_capability.approval_status.replace("_"," ")]
    if not str(selected_capability.get("source_path","")).is_empty():detail.text+="\nSource: "+str(selected_capability.source_path)
    if selected_capability.get("inventory_origin")=="typed_source":detail.text+="\nTyped source is not listed in the server snapshot; runtime availability remains unverified."
    var witnesses:Array=selected.case.get("witnesses",[]) if not selected.case.is_empty() else selected_capability.get("witnesses",[])
    detail.tooltip_text=_evidence_text(witnesses)
    if not witnesses.is_empty():detail.text+="\n%d linked native/audio/safety receipts · hover Output evidence for their scope and paths."%witnesses.size()
    if not selected.case.is_empty():detail.text+="\nCaptured engine: "+str(selected.case.get("capture_engine",{}).get("commit","not recorded"))+" · "+str(selected.case.get("engine_status","unverified"))
    if not selected.case.is_empty() and not str(selected.case.get("reason","")).is_empty():detail.text+="\n"+str(selected.case.reason)
    elif recording_options.is_empty():
        for record in candidates.slice(0,3):
            if not str(record.get("reason","")).is_empty():detail.text+="\n"+record.label+": "+str(record.reason)
    if not selected.case.is_empty() and selected.case.scenario_status in ["failed","stale"]:
        var prefix:Dictionary=Library.failed_prefix(selected.case)
        prefix_button.disabled=not prefix.available
        if prefix.available:
            prefix_record=selected.case;prefix_perspectives=prefix.perspectives
            prefix_button.text="Inspect historical original" if selected.case.scenario_status=="stale" else "Inspect failed prefix"
            prefix_button.tooltip_text="Inspect this exact original through the strict current SDK reader. Its failed/stale status and missing lifecycle requirements remain unchanged."
            detail.text+="\nAn original prefix is available for inspection; scenario status remains "+str(selected.case.scenario_status)+"."
        if not prefix.errors.is_empty():
            detail.text+="\nPrefix admission: "+"; ".join(prefix.errors)
            prefix_button.tooltip_text+="\n"+"; ".join(prefix.errors)
    if open_recording:
        if not recording_options.is_empty():_open()
        else:recording_unavailable.emit()
func _open()->void:
    if recording_picker.selected<0 or recording_picker.selected>=recording_options.size():return
    var record:Dictionary=recording_options[recording_picker.selected];selected_scenario=Library.scenario(record);recording_selected.emit(selected_capability,selected_scenario,record);hide()
func _inspect_prefix()->void:
    if prefix_button.disabled or prefix_record.is_empty() or prefix_perspectives.is_empty():return
    var scenario:Dictionary=Library.scenario(prefix_record)
    scenario.inspection_mode="failed_prefix";scenario.recording_status=str(prefix_record.scenario_status)
    scenario.recording_failure=str(prefix_record.get("reason",""))
    scenario.label=("Historical original · " if prefix_record.scenario_status=="stale" else "Failed prefix · ")+str(scenario.label)
    selected_scenario=scenario
    failed_prefix_selected.emit(selected_capability,scenario,prefix_record,str(prefix_perspectives[0].id));hide()
func copy_study()->void:
    if not selected_capability.is_empty():DisplayServer.clipboard_set(JSON.stringify({"capability":selected_capability.id,"kind":selected_capability.kind,"source_path":selected_capability.get("source_path",""),"inventory_origin":selected_capability.get("inventory_origin",""),"runtime_availability":selected_capability.get("runtime_availability","unknown"),"cases":selected_capability.cases,"source":selected_capability.source_status,"scenario":selected_capability.scenario_status,"presentation":selected_capability.presentation_status,"approval":selected_capability.approval_status,"witnesses":selected_capability.get("witnesses",[])},"  "))

func _exit_tree()->void:
    generation+=1;request={}
    if worker!=null:worker.wait_to_finish();worker=null
```
